jobs.title: Embedded Engineer I
jobs.description:
Orbital Robotics is looking for engineers with experience developing embedded software for safety critical systems. While we are deploying spacecraft with robotic arms to space, any engineer with experience on robotic systems, autonomous vehicles, or avionics will be a great fit.

**Responsibilities**

* Implement, test, and deploy real-time embedded C/C++ software from bare-metal bring-up to production hardware, and contribute to its architecture.
* Develop device drivers and high-speed communication protocols to integrate actuators, motor controllers, and complex sensor payloads.
* Optimize low-level firmware and RTOS to meet the strict timing and latencies required for high-bandwidth robotic control, dynamic movement, and manipulation.
* Contribute to the design of fault-tolerant software architectures and safety systems that handle hardware degradation, thermal limits, and unexpected physical disturbances.
* Integrate and debug embedded systems directly on full-scale robots and hardware-in-the-loop test frameworks.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Due to ITAR regulations, must be a U.S. person (citizen, permanent resident, or designated asylee/refugee).
* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer science, physics, robotics, or related engineering discipline.
* Software development experience in C, C++ and Linux.
* 0-2 years of full-time, working experience in embedded systems.

**Desired Experience**
======================

**Firmware & Embedded Systems**

* **Bare-Metal & RTOS:** Experience implementing low-level software on bare-metal systems and RTOS.
* **Motor Control:** Experience with brushless motor controllers and FOC algorithm implementation.

**Safety-Critical & Real-Time Systems**

* **Safety-Critical Software:** Experience developing or deploying software for safety critical systems, including aircraft avionics or autonomous vehicles.
* **Real-Time Processors:** Experience targeting high-reliability, real-time processors used in automotive powertrain, aerospace avionics, or robotic actuation.

**ITAR Requirements**
---------------------

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Compensation Range: $90K - $145K

jobs.description:
York Space Systems was founded to radically improve spacecraft affordability and reliability, transforming, and enabling next- generation space mission operations worldwide. Today, York is one of the most innovative aerospace companies, specializing in end-to-end customer solutions and the rapid production of spacecraft platforms. York’s complete Space Segment Solution includes spacecraft production, payload integration, system integration & test, launch services, ground segment services, and mission operations, enabling customers to leverage York’s existing technology solutions to get to orbit rapidly and responsively. We’re looking to expand our team across the board.
  
  
York is seeking a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer who thrives working independently and is passionate about building software that pushes the bounds of what's possible. Our software is a modern web-based application (React/TypeScript, C# .NET) with a microservice infrastructure (Docker, Kafka, REST) that operators use to monitor and control constellations of spacecraft across several active missions.
  
In this role, you will be embedded at or near a Mission Operation Center (MOC) local to you, serving as the primary technical point of contact for that facility. You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy — often as a team of one or two — while staying closely integrated with our primary office in Denver, CO for feature development, technical direction, and longer-term project work.

About the Work
  
You'll work closely with satellite operators, customers, and the Denver engineering and UI/UX teams to tackle hard problems like:
  

* Collision avoidance, conjunction analysis, and orbit-raising maneuver planning
* Operation center failover and continuity of control
* Cross-satellite network maintenance and space-to-ground link management
* Ground station contact scheduling and pass optimization
* Multi-vehicle mission coordination

Your work will be deployed in a MOC where it will directly support active missions in orbit.
  
Prior space-industry experience is not required.
  
  
Position Details
  
**Team structure:** Field-based; typically 1–2 engineers on-site, integrated with a remote team of 6–8 developers
  
**Remote Policy:** On-Site

* Integrate remotely with the Denver ground software teams for feature development, longer-term technical work, sprint ceremonies, and cross-team coordination
* Develop key user-facing features to support both current and future missions using TypeScript, React, C#, MSSQL, InfluxDB, Kafka, and Python
* Translate designs and requirements into high-quality, maintainable code
* Build reusable components, shared libraries, and scalable services for use across the platform
* Engineer algorithms and business logic to promote scalability and automation
* Write unit and integration tests, including tests against simulation tools to validate behavior against realistic mission scenarios
* Write documentation for internal users and customers

Team Leadership

* Mentor junior engineers (on-site or remote) through code reviews, pair programming, and design discussions

* Communicate proactively and clearly with remote teammates. Written communication and async collaboration are essential in this role
* Help establish and advocate for engineering best practices across the team

Required Qualifications
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field

* Deep expertise in strongly typed backend languages, particularly C#, including multithreaded applications, concurrency patterns, and near-realtime data handling

jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer

Our talented people are at the core of our growth, constantly reinventing the Sonoco wheel with brilliant solutions every year. Today we are a world leader in global packaging solutions with diversified operations in over 34 countries. We're extremely proud of our portfolio of brands, our achievements in sustainability and industrialization and the groundbreaking work accomplished by our people.

Reporting directly to Sonoco Reels Division’s Sr. Director of Engineering, the Senior Controls Engineer will be responsible for leading the electrical and controls design effort in the Reels Division Automation Group. They will be responsible for the design, build, integration, installation, and support of innovative controls and automation solutions for high volume, diverse manufacturing technologies for all of Sonoco’s Reels facilities.

* Creates, changes and removes AD users, mailboxes and other resources as requested.
* Provides Tier 2 support for desktops and production software.
* Provides input for the hardware and software purchases.
* Manage vendor and maintenance agreements.
* Configures, maintains, and monitors company-wide backup solutions and backup storage infrastructure to ensure data protection and recovery readiness.
* Configures, maintains, and supports internal network and system monitoring solutions to proactively identify and resolve infrastructure issues.

Requirements:

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* + Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience

* Ability to work independently.
* Demonstrates organizational and project management skills.

jobs.description:
**Description**

  
  
Job Description

Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainable. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

**Your greatest work is ahead!**

The **Leidos Defense Electrical Systems Department** is seeking a talented **Lead Electrical Engineer** to join an experienced, high performing, multidisciplinary team to create unique solutions to complex engineering challenges in our Huntsville, AL location. The Electrical Systems Department is a design-focused group specializing in advanced hardware products. The individual selected for this position will be an electrical engineer with project engineering, design engineering, and production skillsets. The individual must be a self-starter with experience working with inter-disciplinary teams to solve challenging technical problems. The engineer will work closely with hardware integrated into a diverse range of aerospace and military systems including manned/unmanned ground/air vehicles, missiles, radars, and space systems.

The selected candidate will be expected to execute in a fast-paced, small team environment through all phases of the hardware life cycle from conceptual development and detailed design through manufacturing, qualification testing, and post-delivery support. With a product focus, the individual is also expected to actively partner with other engineers, project managers, technicians, and customers to develop solutions that adhere to a diverse set of requirements. The ideal candidate will thrive in a learning environment that encourages leadership and technical growth.

**If you are up for the challenge of joining this team, then apply today to be considered.**

**Leidos Defense Systems Sector** provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. * Supporting test and troubleshooting of RF, digital, and power electronics
* Leading Failure Review and Corrective Action committees for critical component failures
* Presenting to program leadership and customers in weekly meetings, quarterly IPRs, and CDRs
* Integrating LRUs into larger systems by collaborating with system design teams on design updates
* Coordinating with line management and program management to identify staffing opportunities and accelerate schedules

**Basic Qualifications**

* Candidate must possess a Bachelor's of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or equivalent degree from an ABET-accredited institution.
* Candidate must have at least twelve (12) years of experience in the design and test of electronics or ten (10) years with MS degree.
* Candidate must demonstrate experience in the design, test, and manufacture of analog/mixed-signal PCBs or integrated RF/microwave assemblies.
* Candidate must have demonstrated experience leading engineering teams through production transitions from LRIP to full-rate production
* Candidate must demonstrate proficiency in engineering leadership and team management
* Candidate must have hands-on laboratory experience with instrumentation, test equipment, and debug/test methods including use of network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, signal generators, etc.
* Position requires candidates to be capable of performing in a collaborative engineering environment working closely with multi-disciplinary teams.
* Candidate must have demonstrated experience effectively communicating within a team environment.
* Candidate must be a resident of the North Alabama area or willing to relocate to the Huntsville - North Alabama, AL area.
* Must have ability to obtain and maintain secret security clearance

System Analyst

Huntsville , Alabama Direct Hire Oct 7, 2026

**THIS IS A FEDERAL CONTRACT – U.S. CITIZENSHIP IS REQUIRED**
  
**ACTIVE, CURRENT, AND FULLY ADJUDICATED U.S. DOD SECRET CLEARANCE REQUIRED**
  
**100% ONSITE – HUNTSVILLE, AL**  
  
  
  
**DESCRIPTION OF POSITION / DUTIES**
  
All Points is seeking a **Systems Engineer – Test Analyst (Mid)** to support Missile Defense Agency (MDA) Enterprise Analysis & Technical Innovation efforts in Huntsville, Alabama.
  
The Systems Engineer – Test Analyst will support MDA/DE-SEA Enterprise Analysis & Technical Innovation and the MDA Joint Analysis Team. This position performs system-level Missile Defense System (MDS) performance analysis using ground-test, flight-test, real-world event, and Golden Dome for America data; develops analytical approaches and tools; documents findings; and presents results to technical and mission stakeholders.
  
  
**ACTIVE, CURRENT, AND FULLY ADJUDICATED U.S. DOD SECRET CLEARANCE REQUIRED**  
  
  
  
**DUTIES MAY INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:**
  
  
**Missile Defense Analysis & Test Assessment**
  
• Perform Missile Defense System analysis of test data generated primarily by the MDA Ground Test hardware-in-the-loop program
  

* Support analysis of MDA flight-test events, real-world event data, and Golden Dome for America tests, as required
* Develop and apply approaches and tools for system-level and element-level performance analysis of the complex Missile Defense System
* Produce analysis results and inputs for official SEA test-report products and present findings during mission data reviews
* Develop, use, and present analytical products that assess system-level performance in ground and flight test events
* Analyze MDS kill-chain performance, including sensor acquisition, tracking, and discrimination; battle-manager engagement planning and warfighter interaction; engagement coordination; and interceptor acquisition, tracking, and discrimination

  
**Systems Engineering & Mission Support**
  
• Coordinate with systems engineering teams, test organizations, warfighters, and element-program focal points to ensure tests meet technical intent, assess capabilities, and characterize system behaviors
  

* Evaluate system performance against mission objectives, requirements, and operational expectations
* Apply element-level behaviors and technical findings to broader system-level analytical assessments
* Support technical reviews, mission assessments, and stakeholder presentations

  
**Data Analytics & Tool Development**
  
• Develop tools supporting analytical tasks and data-science activities across Missile Defense System elements
  

* Utilize analytical methods and technical tools to characterize system performance and behavior
* Analyze structured and unstructured mission and test data
* Support development and refinement of repeatable analytical methodologies

  
**Documentation & Reporting**
  
• Document analysis activities, methodologies, findings, and recommendations
  

* Prepare technical reports, briefing materials, mission assessments, and presentation products
* Present analytical findings to engineering teams, leadership, and mission stakeholders
* Support development of official SEA test-report products and mission review materials

  
**Collaboration & Technical Leadership**
  
• Work independently and as part of a geographically distributed team
  

* Collaborate with systems engineers, analysts, testers, mission partners, and operational stakeholders
* Provide technical insight regarding system behaviors, performance trends, and test outcomes
* Support continuous improvement of analytical processes and mission assessment capabilities

  
  
**EDUCATION**
  
Bachelor’s degree, Master’s degree, or Doctoral degree in:
  
• Engineering
  

* Systems Engineering
* Aerospace Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering
* Mathematics
* Physics
* Related technical discipline

  
  
**YEARS OF EXPERIENCE**
  
• Minimum 8 years of relevant experience  
  
  
  
**SKILLS / QUALIFICATIONS**
  
  
**Required Experience & Skills**
  
• Experience performing systems engineering test analysis
  

* Experience supporting missile defense, aerospace, defense, mission systems, or similarly complex technical environments
* Experience documenting and presenting analysis findings to technical audiences
* Systems engineering analysis
* Test analysis and evaluation
* Missile Defense System performance assessment
* Requirements analysis and verification
* Performance assessment and mission analysis
* Technical report development
* Technical presentations and briefings
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work independently and within geographically distributed teams
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

  
**Desired Experience & Skills**
  
• Missile Defense Agency (MDA) experience
  

* Missile Defense System (MDS) experience
* Ground test analysis experience
* Flight test analysis experience
* Hardware-in-the-loop (HWIL) environments
* Knowledge of Missile Defense System architecture and testing
* System-level interface design and specification development
* System analysis and data-science experience

* Interceptor performance analysis
* SQL

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

i3 is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to support the U.S. Army DEVCOM Aviation & Missile Center (AvMC) Air/Ground Integration and Interoperability Lab (AGIIL) in Huntsville, AL. AGIIL is a fast-paced, rapid prototyping and systems integration laboratory supporting a diverse range of Department of War customers and mission areas. The selected candidate will work with multidisciplinary teams to translate operational and customer needs into technical requirements and practical hardware and software engineering solutions. You will apply a comprehensive understanding of Systems Engineering principles to identify and derive requirements, support software and system architecture development, design, integrate, test, and verify complex systems in a fast-paced R&D environment, contributing independently while also collaborating closely with senior engineers and mentors.

Responsibilities:

* Analyze customer and operational needs and translate them into practical technical requirements, approaches, and engineering solutions.
* Support rapid prototyping, software development, system integration, troubleshooting, laboratory and field testing, demonstrations, and evaluation activities.
* Develop system concepts, architectures, interface definitions, functional/data flows, mockups, and other engineering products used to communicate and mature solutions.
* Coordinate with software developers and other engineering disciplines to refine system behavior, interfaces, and implementation approaches.
* Work with software, hardware, network, test, and integration engineers to develop, evaluate, and improve integrated system solutions.
* Perform technical assessments, trade studies, and gap analyses; document findings, test results, risks, and recommended courses of action for internal and Government customers.
* Reviewing test plans, procedures, and verification and validation activities.
* Independently manage assigned technical tasks and priorities while coordinating with Government customers, internal teams, vendors, and external organizations as required.
* Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in an engineering, technical, or related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 10 years of relevant Systems Engineering, systems integration, or related technical experience.
* Experience supporting the development, integration, and testing of hardware and software systems, including software-intensive or networked solutions.
* Experience working with a multidisciplinary teams providing systems engineering support to develop practical engineering solutions.
* Ability to analyze technical problems, troubleshoot integration issues, and support software/system verification and validation activities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to work independently with general guidance as part of a multidisciplinary team.
* Active DoD Secret security clearance required to start.
* U.S. Citizenship required.
* Ability to lift 50lbs.
* 10% Travel.

Preferred:

* Experience with DoDAF architectures, UML/Object-Oriented Design, data flows, interface diagrams, or similar system modeling methods.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps environments and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Experience supporting DoD/Army rapid prototyping, tactical networking, system integration, laboratory, or test environments.

Knowledge/Skills

* Knowledge of office administration and procedures.
* Exceptional judgment capabilities and relationship management skills.
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and client service skills; ability to clearly communicate in discussions and written documents, and to deliver feedback clearly and tactfully.
* Interact with a diverse array of customers and staff in a professional and courteous manner.
* Work independently with accountability for accurate and complete results.
* Be extremely organized and exceptionally detail oriented.
* Work well both independently and in a team environment.
* Be energized by a fast-paced work environment.
* Must be able to communicate with others effectively.
* Analyze information and respond appropriately.
* Manage time wisely and prioritize tasks.
* Provide superior customer service.
* Multi-task in a pleasant manner.
* Work well under pressure.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms.
* The employee is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
* Regular i3 hours are 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. Monday-Friday, however, additional hours may be required on occasion. Regular and punctual attendance is required.

About i3:

Founded in 2007, Integration Innovation, Inc. (i3) is headquartered in Huntsville, AL, with additional offices in Orlando, FL, and the National Capital Region. We are a 100% team member-owned mid-tier integrator with over 800 employee-owners, and our culture speaks for itself: we've earned ten Best Places to Work® awards, driven by strong employee engagement, transparent leadership, and a genuine commitment to communication.

i3 team members operate at the leading edge of national defense across a broad range of technical disciplines, from systems and software engineering to modeling, simulation, and training solutions to cybersecurity, digital engineering, and enterprise IT. We also take products from prototype through production, bringing that same engineering rigor to manufacturing and delivering hardware at scale. For candidates, that means a rare opportunity:

Senior Principal Electrical Engineer or Staff Principal Electrical Engineer position in the Huntsville Hardware Engineering functional department. This position will support one or more projects performing design engineering for integration of Command and Control systems, such as radios, networks, antennas, and power equipment, in support of Department of Defense projects. The selected candidate will work in a dynamic people-focused environment where he/she will interact with production, program management, service providers, equipment suppliers, and customers. Primary responsibilities are cable harnesses design, power analysis, and interconnect diagrams for COTS and GFE equipment. Additional tasks include research, development, design, and testing electrical components, equipment, systems, and networks.

* Understanding of the following MIL Standards MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464 , MIL-STD-188-124 , and MIL-STD-1275
* Experience designing cable harnesses using MIL circular connectors, MIL-DTL-38999 (Series 1, 2, and 3), MIL-DTL-5051, MIL-DTL-22992, MIL-DTL-26482, MIL-DTL-83526, and MIL-C-85049.

* Experience with managed network devices and systems

* Experience in leading small product development groups
* Experience working in an autonomous work environment on complex projects
* Experience in working on business or engineering full-cycle projects from project inception through system sustainment

**WHAT WE'RE DOING**  

* Advancing the Integrated Discrimination and Electronic Protection capabilities of the Missile Defense System (MDS)

* Developing and delivering MDS capabilities and engineering artifacts into the Technical Baseline (TBL)

  
**THE WORK**  
This position's primary role will be representing the SE&IT by supporting MDA/DE-SEA (Enterprise Analysis &Technical Innovation) and its role within the MDA Joint Analysis Team OAT). In the test analyst role, the candidate will perform Missile Defense System (MDS) performance analysis of test data generated primarily by the MDA Ground Test (HWIL) program. The candidate may also support analysis of MDA Flight Test events, Real World Event data, and Golden Dome for America (GDA) tests. The role includes developing approaches and tools to support executing System-level and Element-level performance analysis on the complex MDS, and producing analysis results and inputs to the official SEA test report products. In addition, analysts often present their finding during mission data reviews. In this role, the candidate will develop, utilize and present analytical products with the intent of assessing strategic and/or theater/regional element system level performance of the MDS in ground test and flight test events. * Paid time off for work/life balance.

jobs.description:
**About AIRO Group Holdings, Inc.**

The AIRO Group, designs, certifies, and manufactures critical navigation, communication and display components and integrated systems that equip clients with unparalleled precision and accuracy. AIRO has a proven track record of excellence, with over 600 FAA certifications. This impressive achievement highlights our commitment to meeting stringent regulatory requirements while advancing avionics technology.

AIRO is developing the next generation of advanced General Aviation Avionics systems that will bring new levels of Functionality, Usability, Integration and Value to existing and new aircraft for a broad spectrum of General Aviation aircraft. AIRO is offering a unique opportunity to join a highly focused and motivated team of engineers in defining, designing, and implementing these advanced systems.

**Position Overview**

**AIRO is seeking a Systems Engineer to support the Aspen Avionics General Aviation avionics product line. This position contributes to the system architecture and design of Aspen's next generation of avionics, helping carry products from concept through certification. The Systems Engineer will bring a focus on functionality, usability, integration, and value to every stage of the design process, ensuring that each product is commercially competitive, clearly differentiated, and built around the needs of the pilots who use it.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Responsible for the System Architecture, System and Software Requirements as well as Verification and Validation of avionics products.**
* **Interface with marketing, sales, and field support to assess needs for new capabilities and product improvements for existing and new customers.**
* **Coordinate with software, hardware, mechanical, and test engineering teams to ensure seamless integration and traceability across the development lifecycle.**
* **Interface with external organizations to enable the Integration of Aspen products with equipment supplied by other companies.**
* **Contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes, tools, and best practices.**
* **Prepare and present technical briefings and design documentation for internal and external stakeholders.**
* **Perform other duties as requested by the VP of Engineering.**

**Qualifications**

* **Bachelor’s degree in engineering, required.**
* **10+ years of engineering experience in the design of embedded systems, including at least one technical lead role.**
* **Strong Technical and Communication skills.**
* **Project Management and Leadership Skills.**
* **Ability to work in diverse, cross-functional teams.**
* **Good understanding of aircraft and avionics operation.**
* **Experience in avionics system design and FAA certification processes, including ARP4754, ARP4761, DO-178C standards.**
* **Private Pilot experience is desirable.**

**Education**

* **Bachelor’s degree in engineering, required.**
* **Technical certificate, associate degree, military electronics training, or equivalent hands-on electronics experience preferred**

**Physical Requirements:**

* **Ability to sit, stand, and/or walk for extended periods**
* **Ability to use hands and fingers for manual dexterity and repetitive tasks**
* **Ability to bend, stoop, reach, push, pull, and lift as required by the position**
* **Ability to safely lift, carry, push, or pull objects within the requirements of the position**
* **Ability to perform the visual, auditory, and communication requirements necessary to perform the essential functions of the position**
* **Ability to work safely in the physical and environmental conditions applicable to the position**

**Company Benefits:**

* **Paid Time Off (PTO)**
* **Paid Holidays**
* **Parental Leave**
* **Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance**
* **Health Savings Account (HSA)**
* **401(k) with company match**

* **Basic Life Insurance – fully paid by the company for employees and their dependents**
* **Long-Term Disability Insurance – fully paid by the company**

jobs.description:

Join the Maverick Power Team!

At Maverick Power, we don’t just build power distribution solutions—we redefine industry standards. Recognized on the 2025 Inc. 5000 list as #16 in the U.S., #2 in Manufacturing, and #1 in Texas, we are committed to driving innovation, quality, and speed. With multiple manufacturing facilities across North Texas and Phoenix, we are expanding rapidly and looking for top talent to grow with us

If you are ready to be part of a high-energy, solutions-driven team where your work makes an impact, Maverick Power is the place for you.

What We Offer:

* Competitive Salary + Bonus Potential!
* Paid Time Off, 401K Matching, Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits!
* High-growth organization with advancement opportunities!
* Diverse, Collaborative, & Fun Work Environment!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated R&D Electrical Engineer with expertise in low voltage (LV) and medium voltage (MV) power systems to join our dynamic team. The successful candidate will drive the design, development, and testing of innovative power system solutions, contributing to the advancement of next-generation energy technologies. This role requires a strong foundation in electrical engineering principles, hands-on experience with LV/MV systems, and a passion for research and innovation.

Key Responsibilities:

* Design and Development: Design, simulate, and develop electrical systems and components for low voltage (up to 1kV) and medium voltage (1kV–38kV) applications, ensuring compliance with industry standards (e.g., IEEE, IEC, UL).
* Prototyping and Testing: Build and test prototypes of power system components, including transformers, switchgear, circuit breakers, and control systems, to validate performance and reliability.
* Research and Innovation: Conduct research to explore new technologies, materials, and methodologies to improve efficiency, safety, and sustainability of LV/MV power systems.
* Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including mechanical engineers, software engineers, and product managers, to integrate electrical systems into broader product designs.
* Documentation: Prepare technical reports, design specifications, and documentation to support product development, regulatory approvals, and intellectual property filings.
* Standards and Compliance: Ensure all designs and processes adhere to safety, environmental, and regulatory standards, including NEC, NEMA, and OSHA requirements.
* Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical issues in power systems during development, testing, and field implementation phases.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or minimum of 8 years of qualified work experience may be substituted.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in R&D or design of low voltage and/or medium voltage power systems.
* Strong background in control system design using SolidWorks Electrical.
* Proven track record in designing and testing electrical components such as transformers, switchgear, or power distribution systems.
* Experience with power electronics, protection systems, and control systems is a plus.
* Strong understanding of power system components, including circuit breakers, relays, and busbars.
* Familiarity with industry standards (e.g., IEEE, IEC, UL, NEC).
* Proficient in using CAD tools (SolidWorks Electrical) for wiring schematics and panel layout design.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Master’s degree is preferred.
* Experience with renewable energy integration (e.g., solar, wind, energy storage, microgrids) into LV/MV systems.
* Familiarity with smart grid technologies or IoT applications in power systems.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent certification.

Physical Requirements:

* Must be able to lift up to 40 pounds at a time.
* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Work Environment:  
May work in various settings at the Maverick Power facilities, in offices, in multiple shops, and in commercial buildings. Maintaining the same position or posture while performing tasks and sitting for prolonged periods. The above-noted job description is not intended to describe, in detail, the multitude of tasks that may be assigned but rather to give the applicant a general sense of the responsibilities and expectations of this position. As the nature of business demands change so, too, may the essential functions of the position.

* System Design & Development: Lead the design of high-efficiency DC power systems, including rectifiers, inverters, battery backup systems, and power distribution units (PDUs) for mission-critical applications.

* Documentation: Create detailed technical documentation, including schematics, specifications, and operational manuals.

Qualifications:

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or related field; master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum of 7 years of experience in DC power systems engineering, with at least 3 years in a senior or lead role.
* Proven expertise in designing and deploying DC power systems for data centers, telecom, or renewable energy applications.
* Proficiency in DC power system design tools (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical, MATLAB, PSpice).
* Deep knowledge of power electronics, battery technologies (e.g., lithium-ion, VRLA), and energy storage systems.

* Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

* Certifications: PE license or relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, Six Sigma) preferred.
* Experience with high-voltage DC (HVDC) systems or microgrid integration.
* Knowledge of renewable energy systems (solar, wind) and their integration with DC power infrastructure.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity standards for power systems.

* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

  

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

*The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers' capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.*  
  
**ABOUT THE JOB**  
  
As the Sr. Electrical Engineer, you will specify, design, develop and install devices used to collect data on solid rocket motor burn performance. Additionally, you will design custom electronic solutions—including PCBs, firmware, and FPGA code—needed to manufacture and test solid rocket motors, which will include working with integrated safety-critical designs. This position also requires the ability to configure data collection systems and develop software applications used to collect the data. It is expected that you may oversee technicians during the instrumentation installation and during rocket motor testing/development. The right person for this role has direct, hands-on experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors used to collect a variety of metrics related to testing of solid rocket motors. If you are a hands-on leader, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and enjoy being the point person for collecting valuable performance data, then this role is for you. You will assist in the testing solid rocket motors which will include working with integrated safety designs used to initiate the motor.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Collaborates with other engineers to develop accurate, efficient equipment and instrumentation in accordance with safety and usability standards and client expectations.
* Collaborates with other electrical engineers to execute the safe arming and initiation of rocket motors under test.
* Designs PCBA and electrical system components with hands on testing and rework as necessary
* Creates detailed schematics and simulated models to test designs; optimizes designs for performance, reliability, and cost.
* Oversees the implementation of new measuring devices and control systems, ensuring devices are correctly installed and properly tested.
* Acts as project engineer for design, prototype fabrication, and manufacturing development.
* Develops required cable drawings to interface to various low- and high-voltage systems
* Drafts and presents formal technical documents, reports, and testing results to manager for approval.
* Provides training related to devices to employees and/or customers.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Proven experience in safety-critical hardware design, incorporating multi-fault tolerance, arm/fire inhibits, safe bleed-down circuits, and inadvertent initiation mitigation.
* Experience in high-voltage PCB layout and circuit design for motor initiation, including capacitor charging/discharge circuits, high peak-current switching, and creepage/clearance management
* Experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors employed to collect data on system performance.
* NI Labview or NI DAQmx experience or familiar with other COTS data acquisition systems
* Thorough understanding of signal conditioning for data acquisition, i.e. analog circuit design
* Intimate knowledge of the analog to digital conversion process, i.e. digital circuit design
* Understand Computer controlled data acquisition and able to develop computer applications for data collection.
* Able to select the correct sensors and design the placement of them to acquire the needed solid rocket motor performance metrics.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and proficient with computer-aided design software.
* Ability to write and understand Python
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Advanced degree in engineering
* Experience with circuit simulation tools (spice)
* Experience using EDA tools such as Altium/Or CAD
* Familiar with real-time computer architectures and their OS's

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Automation Controls Engineer (Commissioning)

**Reports To:** Controls Engineering Manager

**Location / Travel:** Hackett, AR with travel

**Position Summary:**

We are seeking an Automation Controls Engineer to join our Mission Critical Commissioning team. In this role, you will participate in the design, programming, checkout, and startup of automation control systems with an emphasis on mission critical power or HVAC infrastructure. This position offers significant hands-on field experience validating complex control systems in high-reliability environments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

· Assist in developing and modifying PLC logic, HMI/SCADA screens, and device configurations.

· Review electrical schematics, P&IDs, panel layouts, and sequence of operations (SOO) to verify system intent.

· Perform point-to-point electrical checkouts, instrument calibration, and loop checks.

· Support on-site startup, functional testing, troubleshooting, and integrated system commissioning alongside contractors and field engineers.

· Coordinate with field electricians and engineering staff to verify field wiring by specifications.

· Diagnose and troubleshoot electrical wiring.

· Diagnose and troubleshoot PLC and HMI logic/programs.

· Assist in procurement and tracking of control hardware, field instrumentation, and spare parts.

· Prioritize updates to documents; field modifications (redlines), test results, tasks list, and commissioning reports on a daily basis.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

· Education & Experience (one of the following):

Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, or related technical field.

Associate Degree in Industrial Automation, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related discipline with 1–2+ years of hands-on experience.

Equivalent military or trade experience (e.g., industrial electrician, Navy nuclear/electrical, certified instrumentation tech).

· Foundational understanding of PLC ladder logic or basic control loops.

· Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics.

· Hands-on aptitude with basic electrical testing tools, for example multimeters.

· Strong problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.

· Proficiency with standard office tools (Microsoft Office Suite, PDF markup).

· Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel to client job sites.

**Preferred / Beneficial Qualifications:**

(Candidates with experience in ANY of the following areas are encouraged to apply):

Industrial Automation & Software:

· Experience programming or troubleshooting Rockwell/Allen-Bradley (Studio 5000 / RSLogix), or similar platforms.

· Experience developing or modifying HMI/SCADA systems (Inductive Automation Ignition, FactoryTalk View).

· Understanding of industrial networking and protocols (EtherNet/IP, Modbus RTU/TCP, Serial).

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer (Electrical)
jobs.description:
Navi captures everything a pilot sees and hears. The Wave is how we do it — the hardware that lives in the cockpit, captures flight data, and streams it to the cloud in real time. You're building the next generation of that device.

**About the role**
==================

This is a founding hardware role. You own the entire physical product — from bare-metal architecture through PCB design, ruggedized enclosure, embedded firmware, environmental certification, fleet deployment, and cloud integration. This is Version 2 of the Wave, and you are the definitive technical voice for every decision that shapes it.

The device has to survive cockpit environments — heat, vibration, RF noise — while continuously streaming high-bandwidth audio and telemetry over wireless networks without dropping a frame. It has to be deployable across hundreds of aircraft and manageable as a fleet. It has to meet certification standards for operating in aircraft. And it has to be built fast, because Navi is already live at flight schools and the U.S. Air Force and demand is accelerating.

If you thrive in high-autonomy environments and love building mission-critical edge devices that work in the real world — not on a bench — this is your role.

**What you'll do**
==================

* Lead the end-to-end technical design of Navi's next-generation edge compute node — architecture, component selection, PCB layout, and mechanical enclosure
* Build hardware that is ruggedized for cockpit environments — thermal, vibrational, and environmental stress — and optimized for continuous wireless data transmission
* Architect real-time data pipelines for processing and streaming high-fidelity audio and complex telemetry from the edge to the cloud with minimal latency
* Own the hardware validation lifecycle — environmental testing, quality assurance, and securing regulatory and industry-specific certifications for hardware operating in aircraft
* Develop and oversee embedded firmware and edge processing logic — real-time operating systems, on-device compute, and fleet-wide OTA update infrastructure
* Guide the architecture of live cloud-based telemetry dashboards to ensure seamless data ingestion and real-time visibility from deployed devices
* Collaborate with software and ML engineers to ensure the hardware captures exactly what the intelligence layer needs to generate automated debriefs

**About you**
=============

* 7+ years of experience in systems engineering, embedded edge compute, or connected hardware development — with a track record of bringing a complex device to market, not just prototyping one
* Deep understanding of electronics design — PCB schematics, microcontrollers, wireless communication modules (cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth)
* Experience collaborating with industrial or mechanical designers to build ruggedized enclosures that survive challenging thermal, vibrational, and environmental conditions
* Strong proficiency in embedded C/C++ or Python for edge applications, with experience running RTOS or embedded Linux
* Familiarity with edge-to-cloud architecture, device fleet management, and building scalable live data infrastructure
* Hands-on experience navigating rigorous hardware certification processes and environmental testing standards
* You own projects end to end in ambiguous, fast-moving environments — and you ship

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience with edge processing and lossless streaming of high-bandwidth data — real-time audio, complex signal processing, or continuous telemetry
* Background building hardware for aviation, defense, or other safety-critical regulated industries
* Familiarity with avionics data formats, cockpit audio systems, or aircraft electrical environments

**Why this role matters**
=========================

Every piece of intelligence Navi generates starts with the Wave. The AI is only as good as the data the hardware captures — and in a cockpit, there are no second chances. A dropped audio frame is a missed instructor callout. A connectivity gap is a blind spot in the debrief. You're building the device that makes the entire platform possible, and it has to work perfectly every single flight.

**What you'll get**
===================

* Flight training — earn your pilot's license and build with true domain expertise
* Impact you can see — the device you build will be in cockpits at flight schools, airlines, and the U.S. Air Force
* A role that scales into hardware leadership as we grow

**How we work**
===============

* **Find a way.** We don't wait for permission or perfect information. Ideas come from anywhere regardless of title. Figure it out, ship it, iterate.
* **Creativity over control.** First principles over process. We'd rather have a creative solution that's 80% right today than a perfect one next quarter.
* **Update fast.** Come in with a hypothesis, throw it away when the data says otherwise. Ego has no place here.
* **Intensity with focus.** We work hard because the mission demands it. Clarity on what matters is how we make that sustainable.

jobs.description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

AI’s next breakthrough depends on more than compute—it depends on how efficiently data moves. As AI clusters scale out across racks and data centers, optical connectivity becomes essential to delivering the bandwidth, power efficiency, and performance these systems demand.  
  
Join Marvell’s Optics team and help engineer the hardware that makes that connectivity possible. Our platforms bring together high-speed silicon photonics, transmit and receive amplifiers, controller ASICs, Marvell digital signal processors, and embedded firmware to create highly integrated optical solutions.  
  
Our team owns the design, verification, and validation of these components, including system-level testing of hardware, firmware, and control loops across operating conditions. You will work alongside specialists across these disciplines and carry products from initial concept through new product introduction.

**What You Can Expect**

As a Senior Staff Hardware Engineer, you will lead hardware platform development for integrated optical transceiver engines supporting high-speed fiber-optic communications.

Your decisions will shape how advanced semiconductor devices are powered, interconnected, characterized, and prepared for production. You will translate complex electrical and system requirements into robust hardware, resolve challenging analog and RF issues, and build the platforms that enable teams to validate optical performance with confidence.

This is an opportunity to combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership at a company advancing optical connectivity for AI and cloud infrastructure. You will influence design direction, guide cross-functional decisions, and see your work progress from the first schematic to production readiness.

* **Lead** **Optical** **module and test platform hardware development from concept through NPI.** Define and deliver integrated optical engines’ test platforms, including device-under-test (DUT) cards, interposers, sockets, and handler boards.

* **Bring designs to life in the lab.** Lead optical test platform hardware bring-up, electrical and optical characterization, and debugging using high-speed oscilloscopes, vector or performance network analyzers, signal generators, optical sampling scope, and electronic loads.
* **Validate the complete system.** Partner with optical, silicon, and firmware engineers to investigate hardware behavior, control-loop performance, and interactions across operating conditions.
* **Accelerate engineering through automation.** Develop scripts and tools using Python, C++, and/or MATLAB to improve validation efficiency, measurement repeatability, and correlation between simulations and laboratory results.
* **Balance performance with production realities.** Select components with attention to electrical performance, availability, cost, and manufacturability.
* **Connect development with production.** Collaborate with operations, product engineering, test engineering, applications engineering, manufacturing, and business development to align requirements and support successful product introduction.
* **Provide Senior Staff technical leadership.** Lead design reviews, mentor engineers, communicate tradeoffs, and coordinate technical execution across global teams.
* **Build knowledge that lasts.** Document design rationale, validation methods, and results, and share insights through technical presentations and internal reports.

At Marvell, you can build deep expertise while contributing across a broad semiconductor technology portfolio. This role offers the combination of challenging engineering, end-to-end ownership, and collaboration needed to turn advanced optical technology into products that help AI infrastructure scale.

**What We're Looking For**

* A master’s degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering with **3+ years of relevant experience**, or a bachelor’s degree with **5+ years of relevant experience**.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex O2E and E2O hardware development, with the technical judgment and cross-functional leadership expected at the Senior Staff level.
* Proven experience designing optical transceiver module and test platform hardware design for testing, power delivery, or high-speed communications.
* Strong fundamentals in analog and RF signaling, PCB design and fabrication, schematic capture, and hardware interfaces.
* Experience evaluating signal integrity and power integrity using tools such as PowerDC, PowerSI, ADS, HFSS, or Clarity 3D.

Qualcomm Engineers collaborate with cross-functional groups to determine product execution path.

* Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.

OR
  
Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 1+ year of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.
  
OR
  
PhD in Science, Engineering, or related field.

This role requires close collaboration with design, validation, architecture, and software teams to ensure critical power, performance, reliability, and functionality features are successfully enabled in Qualcomm products.

The team is responsible for the development, integration, and validation of low-level DDR subsystem firmware and APIs. Engineers leverage their understanding of system architecture, memory subsystem behavior, and hardware/software interactions to methodically collect and analyze stability, power, performance, and functional data that drive product decisions and optimization efforts.

This is a highly cross-functional role requiring a strong foundation in embedded systems, digital design, and system-level debugging. Responsibilities include firmware development in C, validation of firmware across DV environments, emulation platforms, FPGA prototypes, and silicon, as well as post-silicon bring-up and performance characterization activities.

The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of LPDDR protocols, caches, interconnects, and memory controllers. The candidate should be comfortable working across the entire product lifecycle, from design validation through silicon bring-up and production readiness.

* Develop and maintain low-level firmware and system APIs for DDR subsystem initialization, training, power management, and performance features.

* Collaborate across design, DV, software, architecture, and product teams to enable and optimize DDR features.

* Debug memory subsystem issues involving LPDDR interfaces, caches, interconnects, and memory controllers.
* Contribute to the definition and validation of next-generation memory subsystem capabilities and optimizations.

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with a focus on Embedded Systems, Computer Architecture, or VLSI.
* 2+ years of experience in embedded firmware or low-level software development.
* Strong programming skills in C.
* Experience with embedded system debugging and hardware/software integration.
* Understanding of digital design fundamentals and computer architecture concepts.
* Experience using lab equipment and silicon debugging tools to collect and analyze system data.
* Familiarity with LPDDR memory interface concepts and protocol fundamentals.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with LPDDR4/LPDDR5/LPDDR5X memory protocols, training algorithms, timing parameters, and power management features.
* Experience with DDR subsystem validation, characterization, and post-silicon bring-up.
* Experience debugging and collecting data from silicon platforms.
* Experience developing or maintaining Verilog/SystemVerilog simulation testbenches and validation environments.
* Familiarity with memory controllers, caches, coherent interconnects, and SoC architecture.
* Experience in performance analysis, power optimization, or system tuning activities.
* Familiarity with emulation platforms and FPGA prototyping environments.
* Experience with Python, scripting, or automation used for validation and data analysis.

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Jose, CA, USA; San Diego, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in C or C++.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
* 3 years of experience working with embedded operating systems.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.
* 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Google's XR organization is dedicated to developing the foundational platforms, software ecosystems, and hardware configurations that power immersive computing, highlighted by the development of the Android XR platform and related developer toolings. The organization rapidly integrates advanced technologies—such as machine learning, sensor simulations, and geospatial digital human models—to scale augmented, virtual, and mixed-reality experiences across both Google and its industry partners.

The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

  
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer, TPU Interconnect and Packaging
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience with semiconductor packaging, integration, or interconnect design.
* Experience with interconnect modeling, 2.5D/3D interposer design rules, or chiplet package assembly.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
* Experience leading complex package development programs for high-performance computing (HPC) or AI accelerator platforms.
* Experience in silicon photonics integration, Co-Packaged Optics (CPO), 2.5D silicon interposers, and high-density substrate routing.
* Knowledge of wafer-level packaging (WLP), chiplet interconnect standards, dynamic thermal control, and high-density power delivery networks.
* Ability to deliver first-of-a-kind optical packaging or heterogeneous 3D integration solutions into production systems.

**About the job**
-----------------

In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

As a Hardware Engineer in the Interconnect and Packaging team, you will serve as a technical lead driving the architectural strategy, co-design methodologies, and technology roadmaps for TPU interconnects and optical packaging. You will bridge hardware architecture with foundry manufacturing capability, leading cross-functional teams across silicon photonics, high-density substrates, and system integration to deliver multi-terabit packaging capabilities.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define the architectural strategy and package technology selection for next-generation TPU systems, incorporating 2.5D/3D interposers, embedded bridges, and CPO modules.
* Drive electro-optical co-design across silicon photonics dies, laser sources, package substrates, and drive electronics to maximize interconnect bandwidth density and energy efficiency.
* Establish signal integrity, power delivery, thermal management, and mechanical robustness design rules across multi-chiplet heterogeneous assemblies.

jobs.title: Sr. Embedded Firmware Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building revolutionary robotic systems that combine AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced electromechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at an unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic manipulation.
  
  
Amazon is seeking a talented and motivated Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to design, implement, and launch firmware for highly dexterous robotic end effectors. In this role you will own firmware sub-domains independently. The ideal candidate has extensive experience writing firmware to process a wide variety of sensors, control electric motors, and communicate with the larger system, and can work well both independently and in a multidisciplinary team setting.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Drive communication interface integration at the firmware layer, ensuring robust, deterministic communication between the end effector and the larger robotic system.
* Review vendor firmware deliverables, provide technical direction, and hold vendors to Amazon's quality, coding, and integration standards.
* Author functional requirements, design verification plans, and test procedures; execute designs that meet those requirements.
* Build and test firmware for electromechanical subsystem prototypes and integrated systems, covering sensor processing, motor control, and system communication.
* Support product releases to manufacturing and customer deployments, including production firmware bring-up and validation, working efficiently to support fast-paced development schedules.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning starts with a new sensor module on your desk: the latest prototype from a manufacturing partner overseas. You jump on a call with the vendor's engineering team to walk through their test results, flag an issue you spotted in the data, and agree on a firmware fix they'll turn around overnight. Getting fast iteration cycles on hardware is how this team operates: you don't wait for perfect specs, you get hardware moving and learn from what it tells you.
  
  
By mid-morning you're designing the control interface for the end effector: defining how it talks to the rest of the system, what data it exposes, and how it fits into the real-time communication architecture. You sketch the firmware-side changes, then switch to the simulation environment to update the corresponding ROS model so the controls engineer you're working with can test policies against it before hardware arrives. Making things work in sim and on your dev kit in the same day is normal here: the hardware hasn't shipped yet, but that doesn't stop you.
  
  
After lunch you pick up a code review from another team. They're building the actuator control framework that your end effector integrates with, and their latest change surfaces a new set of requirements you hadn't considered. You leave substantive feedback, and it reshapes how you're thinking about your own interface design.
  
  
You close the day with a quick chat with a teammate on the mechanical design side who's working on a physical sensor model. They want help writing custom firmware to characterize the sim-to-real gap, and you realize it connects directly to the simulation change you made that morning. What started as two separate threads becomes a collaboration. You open a shared design doc and start outlining the approach together.
  
  
About the team  
We're developing next-generation robotic manipulation capabilities for highly dexterous multi-finger grippers and hands. Our firmware work spans motor control, sensor processing, tactile sensing production firmware, and the tight integration of the robotic end effector with the larger robotic platform. We build the embedded systems that bring capable, reliable robotic hardware to life.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* 5+ years of professional software development in C or C++ for embedded systems 5+ years of full embedded software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
* 5+ years developing embedded C applications that use an RTOS (such as FreeRTOS, uC-OS, Zephyr, VxWorks) or embedded Linux environments
* 3+ years of development experience with some aspect of robotic systems, including direct, hands-on experience designing, developing, and debugging one of: consumer electronics, medical devices, automotive systems, avionics, industrial, or telecommunications products
* Experience with at least two communication protocols at the firmware layer (e.g., EtherCAT, CAN/CAN-FD, SPI, I2C, RS-485, Ethernet/UDP)
* Experience debugging firmware/hardware integration issues with lab equipment (JTAG/SWD, logic analyzer, oscilloscope)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related field
* 10+ years of full embedded software development life cycle experience
* Hands-on experience with motor control firmware (BLDC/FOC, current sensing, commutation, torque/velocity/position control loops)

* Experience with Ethernet/UDP protocol des

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer, AI Accelerator Module Design
jobs.description:
The Hardware Design, Rack-scale Technology and Platforms (HDRTP) engineering team designs, develops, validates, and delivers the hardware platforms that power Meta's AI and HPC infrastructure, deployed in data centers worldwide. Our designs are published for industry adoption through the Open Compute Project Foundation.We are seeking a senior AI Accelerator Module Design Engineer to serve as the technical owner for the electrical and PCB design of accelerator modules supporting Meta's custom silicon (MTIA) and third-party AI accelerators. This is a lead individual-contributor role: you will own module-level electrical architecture end to end from requirements definition and ASIC package-to-board co-design through schematic, stackup, power delivery, bring-up, and volume production across multiple concurrent programs and silicon generations.You will define the design methodologies, reference architectures, and design-rule standards that other engineers and ODM partners build against; resolve the hardest cross-domain trade-offs between signal integrity, power integrity, thermal, mechanical, and cost; and influence ASIC and rack-level architecture decisions upstream of the module. You will operate with minimal direction in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment, and will mentor and raise the technical bar for PCB and module engineers across the team.  
  
  

### **Hardware Engineer, AI Accelerator Module Design Responsibilities:**

* Own the end-to-end electrical architecture and PCB design of AI accelerator modules for high-performance, high-power, high-efficiency custom silicon (MTIA) and third-party accelerators
* Define module requirements and specifications in partnership with ASIC, platform, rack, and systems architecture teams
* translate system-level targets into implementable board-level design intent
* Lead ASIC package-to-board co-design, including breakout routing strategy, substrate and interposer interaction, and escape feasibility analysis for high pin-count, high-bandwidth devices
* Architect power delivery networks for extreme-current loads (multi-hundred-amp rails), owning DC-DC topology and architecture trade-offs (performance, transient response, efficiency, area, cost), decoupling strategy, and plane/stackup partitioning
* Drive high-speed interface design across PCIe Gen5/Gen6, CXL, UCIe, DDR5/LPDDR, HBM, NVLink/scale-up fabrics, and Ethernet up to 800G, including simulation-guided stackup and channel budgeting
* Set the technical direction for SI/PI methodology in partnership with Signal and Power Integrity teams
* define correlation strategy between simulation and measured silicon
* Define and own module-level design reviews
* set the quality bar for schematic, layout, and DFM/DFT readiness across internal designs and ODM-executed designs
* Lead board and silicon bring-up and own root-cause analysis of the most complex electrical, power, and interoperability failures
* drive corrective design action to closure
* Drive ODM/JDM partners through full NPI-to-mass-production cycles, holding partners to Meta design standards and schedule
* Develop reusable reference designs, design-rule libraries, and design automation that scale across programs and generations
* publish and champion designs through the Open Compute Project
* Evaluate and qualify leading-edge technologies with industry partners — HDI and advanced substrates, embedded components, novel materials, co-packaged and coherent optics — and build the business case for adoption
* Identify cross-organizational problems and lead XFN efforts to resolution without being asked
* influence decisions outside your direct scope through technical credibility rather than authority
* Mentor and develop PCB/module design engineers
* contribute to hiring, calibration of technical standards, and team-wide best practices

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* 10+ years of experience in electrical and PCB design for high-speed, high-power digital systems (servers, accelerators, networking, or HPC)
* Demonstrated experience as the lead engineer taking multiple complex custom board or module designs from concept through volume production
* Expert-level proficiency with EDA tools for schematic capture and PCB design (Cadence Allegro/OrCAD, Altium Designer, or equivalent)
* Deep expertise in high-speed digital interface design (PCIe, CXL, DDR4/DDR5, HBM, Ethernet 25G–800G) and SerDes-based channel design, including stackup and channel budgeting trade-offs
* Deep expertise in power delivery network architecture for high-current loads, including DC-DC topology selection, transient and efficiency analysis, and plane/decoupling strategy
* Experience with ASIC or GPU package-to-board co-design and breakout routing for high pin-count devices
* Experience leading board and silicon bring-up, debug, and failure analysis using oscilloscopes, VNAs, TDR, and power analyzers
* Experience owning technical direction across multiple concurrent programs and influencing decisions across hardware, firmware, mechanical, thermal, and manufacturing organizations
* Experience driving external ODM/JDM or component partners through design and production cycles
* Experience communicating technical trade-offs and recommendations in writing and verbally to engineering leadership

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering with emphasis on electromagnetics, signal integrity, or power electronics
* Track record of establishing design standards or methodologies adopted at organizational scale

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer, AI Accelerator Module Design
jobs.description:
The Hardware Design, Rack-scale Technology and Platforms (HDRTP) engineering team designs, develops, validates, and delivers the hardware platforms that power Meta's AI and HPC infrastructure, deployed in data centers worldwide. Our designs are published for industry adoption through the Open Compute Project Foundation. We are seeking an AI Accelerator Module Design Engineer to own the electrical and PCB design of accelerator modules supporting Meta's custom silicon (MTIA) and third-party AI accelerators. You will own module-level electrical design end to end from requirements and ASIC package-to-board co-design through schematic, stackup, power delivery, bring-up, and volume production on one or more programs. You will work within established design methodologies and reference architectures, and contribute improvements to them. You will drive cross-domain trade-offs between signal integrity, power integrity, thermal, mechanical, and cost, partnering with senior engineers and architects on the most ambiguous decisions. You will operate independently on your program's scope in a fast-moving environment.  
  
  

### **Hardware Engineer, AI Accelerator Module Design Responsibilities:**

* Own the electrical design and PCB implementation of AI accelerator modules for high-performance, high-power custom silicon (MTIA) and third-party accelerators
* Contribute to module requirements and specifications in partnership with ASIC, platform, rack, and systems architecture teams
* Execute ASIC package-to-board co-design, including breakout routing, substrate interaction, and escape feasibility analysis for high pin-count devices
* Design power delivery networks for high-current loads, including DC-DC topology selection, decoupling strategy, and plane/stackup partitioning
* Implement high-speed interface design across PCIe Gen5/Gen6, CXL, DDR5/LPDDR, HBM, and Ethernet up to 800G, including simulation-guided stackup and channel budgeting
* Partner with Signal and Power Integrity teams on SI/PI analysis and simulation-to-measurement correlation for your designs
* Participate in and prepare module-level design reviews
* ensure schematic, layout, and DFM/DFT readiness for your designs
* Lead board bring-up and debug

### **Minimum Qualifications:**
