jobs.description:
Aviture provides custom software solutions for clients, acting as a business partner and technical advisor – sharing and contributing to our client’s vision. We provide full lifecycle software services from concept, implementation and first delivery on to continued maintenance, analysis, and continued adaption to user needs and market forces.

At Aviture we treat our employees as people, not resources. We value their personal & professional growth believing that stronger and healthier individuals are good for both our employees and our clients.

Using our principle of ‘cross pollination’ – we actively share problems & solutions between our project teams and provide ample opportunities for employees to advance to different teams at opportune moments to grow and mentor. The exposure to multiple industries and aspects of technology presents an ideal environment in which you can continue to master your trade skills, as well as be exposed to many developing technologies & interesting problem spaces.

**Requirements**

* Experience with UI development using ReactJS and/or React Native.

* Competent with relational databases and SQL.
* Excellent grasp of computer science concepts, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.

jobs.title: Control Systems Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
**Career Area:**

Engineering

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Hear about the Caterpillar Experience for yourself**

Caterpillar is seeking a highly motivated **Control System Engineering Specialist** to join the **Drivetrain Controls System Simulation and Validation (DCSSV)** organization to support machines with powershift transmissions. This role is focused on **New Product Introduction (NPI) drivetrain controls development and product delivery**, **validation planning and execution**, and **technology transformation project execution** that enables robust, scalable drivetrain control solutions for current and future machine platforms using powershift transmissions and torque converters.

The successful candidate will own the software design for powershift transmission controls with responsibility for technical leadership across software, controls, and development activities, partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver drivetrain controls solutions from concept through production readiness. This position requires strong engineering judgment, systems-level thinking, and the ability to execute complex initiatives while ensuring embedded software quality, integration readiness, and validation rigor.

**What you will do**

* Lead and execute **NPI controls development** activities for machine applications, including requirements definition, architecture alignment, implementation, integration, and product delivery.
* Develop and integrate **drivetrain control solutions** supporting transmissions, torque converters, actuators, sensors, and associated embedded software for machine systems.
* Own **validation planning and execution** by defining verification strategies, test plans, success criteria, instrumentation needs, and data review approaches across simulation, bench, and machine environments.
* Execute **technology transformation projects** that modernize controls, software workflows, and development practices to improve capability, quality, and efficiency.
* Apply **systems engineering principles** to balance performance, durability, functional safety, maintainability, and cost across drivetrain mechatronic solutions.
* Coordinate with global and cross-functional teams to support design reviews, software releases, integration activities, and validation execution.
* Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, controls, software, and validation teams to ensure seamless system integration and issue resolution.
* Drive technical problem solving through data analysis, root cause investigation, and corrective action development during development and validation phases.
* Contribute to standard work, best practices, and continuous improvement efforts that strengthen drivetrain mechatronics development and validation processes.

**Degree Requirement**

* Bachelor’s degree in an accredited Engineering curriculum, preferably

* Electrical Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering
* Mechatronics Engineering
* Computer Engineering
* Ag Engineering

**What you must have (skills)**

* **Analytical Thinking**: Fluent use of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine root cause, evaluate complex technical tradeoffs, and create practical solutions for software, controls, and system integration challenges.
* **Decision Making and Critical Thinking**: Mastery of decision-making processes and associated tools; ability to assess technical risk, prioritize work, and make sound recommendations across development and validation activities.
* **Effective Communications**: Effective use of communication concepts, tools, and techniques; ability to clearly convey technical direction, validation results, risks, and project status across cross-functional teams.
* **Project Management**: Mastery of effective project execution strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and deliver technology transformation and product development workstreams.
* **Computer-Aided Controls Systems Development**: Knowledge of tools and techniques used to develop, simulate, integrate, and validate embedded controls and mechatronic system solutions.
* **Product Testing**: Expert knowledge of product testing approaches, techniques, and tools; ability to build and execute robust validation plans that ensure product quality and readiness.
* **Troubleshooting Technical Problems**: Extensive knowledge of troubleshooting approaches, tools, and techniques; ability to anticipate, detect, and resolve software, controls, and integration issues in product development environments.

**Top Candidates will also have**

* Machine application knowledge.
* Demonstrated engineering experience in drivetrain controls, propulsion systems, embedded software, or related product development disciplines.
* Experience with **New Product Introduction (NPI)** processes and delivery of software-enabled product capabilities into production applications.
* Strong mechanical and electronics aptitude, passionate about delivering the highest quality drivetrain system to Caterpillar customers.
* Strong background in **validation planning and execution**, including test strategy development, data analysis, and issue resolution.
* Test, data collection, and analysis capabilities using ATI Vision, CANape, or similar calibration, measurement, and analytics tools.

**Additional Information**

* This posting will close on 10/21/2026 at 11:59 p.m.

* This position will be located onsite 5 days a week in Mossville, IL (Technical Center - Building G).
* Relocat

jobs.title: Robotics & Automation Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
##### **Job Description**

The Robotics and Automation Systems Engineer supports and helps drive the robotics and autonomy work behind automation deployments across the organization. This role spans a broad range of robotics and automation projects, including fixed/stationary robotic systems (e.g., robotic arms, cobots), mobile/autonomous systems (e.g., AGVs/AMRs, autonomous forklifts, and navigation), palletizing and material-handling applications, and adjacent technologies.

This role assesses sites, programs and integrates robotic systems, commissions systems in live warehouse environments, and troubleshoots deployed automation in production. This role supports robotics and autonomy work from assessment through resolution, and works closely with the Controls & Mechatronics Engineer, operations leadership, and robot OEMs or system integrators to keep robotic and autonomous systems running reliably in a live, production-critical environment.

  

##### **Duties and Responsibilities**

* Program, integrate, and commission robotic systems — including industrial robot arms (e.g., FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Rokae, Universal Robots) and mobile/autonomous platforms — for palletizing, material handling, and related applications.
* Own perception, localization, and navigation for autonomous systems, including LiDAR, SLAM, path planning, and obstacle avoidance.
* Integrate sensors (LiDAR, cameras, IMU) and apply sensor fusion as needed across robotic platforms.
* Integrate robotic and autonomous systems with PLCs, safety systems, conveyors, WCS/WES/WMS, or fleet-management platforms, coordinating with the Controls & Mechatronics Engineer and other automation team members on shared electrical and controls interfaces.
* Develop and maintain production-quality robotics software (C++/Python) following standard engineering practices (version control, code review, and testing), and support fleet/robot diagnostics and telemetry.
* Support the application of physical AI techniques — machine learning-driven perception, decision-making, and adaptive robot behavior — to real-world automation problems where practical, in coordination with more specialized resources as needed.
* Support site assessments, commissioning, acceptance testing, and production troubleshooting, prioritizing minimal disruption to live operations and supporting equipment-uptime and service-level targets.

jobs.description:
##### **Job Description**

The Controls & Electrical/Mechatronics Engineer is responsible for owning the physical integration, machine controls, electrical systems, and mechatronic implementation of automation and robotic systems across the organization. This role supports a broad range of automation projects, including conveyors, sensors, cameras, robotic systems, material-handling equipment, safety systems, and custom fixtures or mechanisms.

This role assesses applications and sites, designs and integrates equipment, programs and troubleshoots controls, commissions systems in live warehouse environments, and supports deployed automation throughout its lifecycle. This role is expected to own projects and equipment issues from assessment through resolution with minimal oversight, and to work closely with operations leadership, OEMs, and integration partners to keep automated systems running reliably in a live, production-critical environment.

##### **Duties and Responsibilities**

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!  
  
About the Role:  
As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll mentor junior engineers and lead cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems, implement innovative projects, and develop system design improvements to enhance site throughput. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your technical leadership and design optimization efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy while building team capabilities and driving operational excellence.  
  
What Do We Offer?  
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!  
  
Key job responsibilities

* You will apply Subject Matter Expertise (SME) on troubleshooting and dive deeps for engineering issues, supporting automation engineers to investigate the root cause and planning actions to eliminate/mitigate the downtime of critical assets

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 4+ years of PLC programming or automation engineering experience

* 4+ years of robotics work cells and control systems experience

* Experience leading controls in manufacturing or complex industrial environments
* Experience identifying, maintaining, troubleshooting, and modifying Motor Controls including motor starters, Variable Frequency Drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components

jobs.description:
**Join Vylor—Powering the Future of Agriculture**

At Vylor, we’re advancing agriculture through breakthrough science—combining elite germplasm, cutting-edge biotech, and next-generation expertise in gene editing and molecular breeding. Our portfolio includes trusted industry brands like Pioneer®, Brevant®, and Hoegemeyer®, delivering performance farmers rely on.

Join us to help scale innovation globally and shape what’s next in crop science.

We are seeking a **Senior Automation Engineer** in the Des Moines metro area. The Senior Automation Engineer delivers software solutions for equipment designed by our engineering teams.

**What You'll Do:**

As a member of the Research Engineering team, you will have opportunities to do the following:

* Design and maintain software solutions in collaboration with a team of engineers on custom R&D equipment for various areas such as greenhouses, laboratories, seed processing facilities, and in-field equipment.
* Design and maintain C++ and C# software for controlling imaging systems.
* Design and optimize automation workflows, integrating hyperspectral imaging with robotic or industrial systems.
* Work on a cross-functional project team to meet customer requirements and expectations.
* Develop, test, document, and maintain software solutions driven by a seasonal schedule.
* Develop an understanding of field and lab equipment for R&D.

**What You Need:**

* 10+ years of experience in the industrial automation field.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Agricultural, Biological, Mechanical, Software, or related discipline) or equivalent proven experience.
* Proficient in developing solutions in C++ or C# for the industrial automation field. [7 years of experience]
* Experience with industrial automation protocols (MQTT, MODBUS, EtherCAT etc).
* Ability to work safely around common shop equipment.
* A desire to do hands-on work directly with hardware and equipment for development and testing.
* Strong communication skills.
* Ability to work on projects from the specification to the deployment phases.
* Ability to work in the U.S. without restriction.
* Ability to work as a valued teammate, demonstrating respect for all people.
* Work legally and ethically.

The following skills would be a plus, but not required:

* Experience programming PLCs in Structured Text. (preferably Beckhoff). [7 years of experience]
* Experience developing solutions in Rust and Python
* Experience with EPSON robots (Epson RC+)
* Knowledge of design patterns and N-Tiered architecture.
* Desirable experience with CRUD database interaction.
* Understanding of synchronous programming concepts such as locking on shared resources, deadlock, and race conditions.
* Experience communicating with devices through: Serial communication: Modbus RTU, CAN protocol.Ethernet-based protocols: EtherCAT, PowerLink, EthernetIP, Modbus TCP.
* Experience delivering solutions within the agricultural industry.

* Future planning with our competitive retirement savings plan and tuition reimbursement program
* Learn more about our total rewards package here - Vylor Benefits
* Check out life at Vylor! https://www.linkedin.com/company/vylorgenetics/
  

Are you a good match? Apply today! We seek applicants from all backgrounds to ensure we get the best, most creative talent on our team.

Collins Aerospace, an RTX company, is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Do you want to be part of a team that expects to win every time we take to the air? The Joint Precision Approach and Landing Systems (JPALS) group, working on every aspect of guiding airplanes safely to the deck, is looking for a **Senior Systems Engineer** with a passion for engineering and the desire to join the JPALS team within Precision Navigation.

This engineer will be asked to contribute to a variety of components including, but not limited to: datalink/communications, Position and Time sensors, Navigation Algorithms, Modeling, Antennas, etc. The possible activities may span the entirety of Engineering Development Lifecycle, including Design, Requirements, Validation & Verification, and Integration. A large portion of the day will be spent in the lab with hands-on equipment. With the full array of Precision Landing- enabling functionalities, the team is responsible for architecting, designing, and developing systems and producing products that serve the Land, Sea and Airborne domains. Datalinks, Airborne computing, data processing and GPS Sensor Systems are just some of the sub-products that make up the product line.

**What You Will Do**  

* Be involved in the design of brand-new Precision Approach and Landing equipment
* Perform hands-on testing in a lab environment
* Ability to create, analyze, and review mechanical drawings and schematics
* Debug Real Time Operating System Software
* Assist in performing analysis at all levels of the total system product including concept, design, fabrication, modeling, test, installation, operation, maintenance and disposal
* Help perform technical planning, system integration, verification and validation, cost and risk, and supportability and effectiveness analyses for total systems
* Assist with managing configuration process, perform functional analysis, timeline analysis, detail trade studies, requirements allocation and interface definition studies to translate customer requirements into hardware and software specifications
* Assist with decomposing customer specifications and system level requirements into sub-system and piece part requirements and generates verification criteria and plans for the requirements
* Ability to create, analyze, and review mechanical drawings and schematics
* Coordinate with cross-functional team members to complete assignments & projects as defined and on schedule

**Qualifications You Must Have**  

* Working knowledge of the Systems Engineering Discipline
* Knowledge of testing GPS functionality
* Familiarity with radio transceiver architecture/design, basic radio functional component blocks, performance specifications, and test methodologies
* Knowledge of high-assurance documentation
* Experience troubleshooting lab failures
* Experience investigating product defects, including those on the advanced radio communications equipment and avionics LRUs
* Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years of experience

**Qualifications We Prefer**  

* Ability to read and debug low level software code
* Novice abilities in MATLAB, Simulink, or other Model Based Systems Engineering toolset

**What We Offer**  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees
* Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option
* Tuition reimbursement program
* Student Loan Repayment Program
* Life insurance and disability coverage
* Optional coverages you can buy pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection
* Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits
* Ovia Health, fertility, and family planning
* Adoption Assistance
* Autism Benefit
* Employee Assistance Plan, including up to 10 free counseling sessions
* Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program
* Doctor on Demand, virtual doctor visits
* Bright Horizons, child and elder care services
* Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program
* **This position is eligible for relocation assistance**
* And more!

**Learn More & Apply Now!**

By joining our team, you’ll have your own critical part to play in ensuring our customer succeeds today while anticipating their needs for tomorrow. Are you up for the challenge? jobs.title: Controls Engineer (Engineer II)
jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.  

**JOB SUMMARY**  
Designs, fabricates, modifies, evaluates and documents assembly processes, components, and automated systems to produce or improve company products and facilitate manufacturing operations. Develops data and makes preliminary sketches, lay-outs and notes required to present design proposals. Researches basic design factors such as ease of manufacture and availability of materials and equipment. Works with other organizations impacted by design development.

Responsible for the design, integration, and deployment of automation systems supporting high-level assembly and integration of advanced compute and AI-based server rack products at Jabil’s Florence, KY facility. This position requires application of industrial engineering, mechatronics, robotics automation principles to develop automated manufacturing solutions that improve throughput, yield, and process stability. The role involves end-to-end system integration of automated robotics, vision system implementation, controls configuration, and automation validation.

May perform work in a specific sub-specialty such as Design, Automation, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Technical Project Management, and/or Process Improvement. Please see addendum for specific sub-specialty requirements. This description is designed to capture the general elements of Engineering work in a manufacturing setting.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design and develops complex assembly processes, initiates process improvement initiatives for server rack assembly and integration, system level validation, and packaging as assigned.
* Support collaborative integration initiatives between Jabil and third-party automation providers for advanced server rack assembly automation.
* Participate in process improvement initiatives using Lean and data-driven methodologies to increase yield and throughput.
* Integrate machine vision systems (2D/3D cameras, OCR, barcode inspection) for automated quality validation and closed-loop feedback.
* Develops and implements changes to product design and/or the manufacturing process to achieve efficiency, quality, and/or cost improvements by participating in new product development programs.
* Develops requirement specifications, system concepts, CAD generated layouts, detailed drawings, BOM’s. Makes layouts of complex assemblies and details of parts of devices, mechanisms and structures.
* Generate system requirement specifications, automation layouts, electrical schematics, and functional documentation.
* Provides customer product design engineering for economic production; may participate in meetings with customers as needed.
* Assesses proper material, automation and equipment selection.
* Works with manufacturing to troubleshoot problems, improve yield, retrofits, set-ups, methods development, and the development of process parameters.
* Participates in product development meetings and may make recommendations to product design changes to enhance manufacturing and assembly.
* Conduct proof of concept experiments and design other testing requirements as needed.
* Research new technology or development tools to remain informed of current technology.
* Understanding of Lean Six Sigma tools, projects and processes and ability to incorporate these into assigned engineering projects.
* May assume lead role in small or sub-section of large project, as assigned.
* Reviews completed projects for accuracy, clarity and completeness.
* Ensures projects are compliant with all local, regional, and national regulatory requirements, codes and controls.
* Supports all company safety and quality programs and initiatives.
* May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Engineering Addendum**  
Automation :
  
Technical responsibility for design and development of automation requirement specification and systems concepts and installs automation and transfer automation programs to production in a smooth and timely manner.

Industrial Engineering / Process Improvement :

Apply Lean Six Sigma methodologies and industrial engineering principles for process improvement, yield optimization, and increase throughput of high-value deliverables.

CAD/CAE :
  
Technical responsibility for design and production of 2D and 3D representations of automated assembly layouts, procedures, products, and process improvements. May design and build prototypes as needed.

Mechanical :
  
Technical responsibility for a variety of engineering work in planning and design of products, processes, machines and other mechanically functioning equipment and mechanical industrial processes; oversees production, installation, operation, maintenance and repair of such equipment as needed.

Technical Project Management :

Facilitate a collaborative approach to high-level assembly and integration of advanced compute server racks for a joint-venture between Jabil and Bright Machines – to fully automate the assembly process (Bright Machines) prior to system level testing and validation (by Jabil).

**KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS**

* Ability to interpret electrical schematics and mechanical CAD drawings.

Ready to apply your craft to a mission that actually matters? BAE Systems is seeking **Senior Java Software Engineers** to join a high-velocity agile team supporting a nationally significant program.

  

**The Tech & Terrain:**

* **The Rigor:** Test-Driven Development (TDD) and robust automation are our baseline, not an afterthought.
* **The Stack:** Dive deep into Java and the Java Cryptographic Framework, or expand your reach into Python, embedded C/C++, and modern Web UI.
* **The Work:** From architecting server-side business logic to refining complex UIs, you’ll turn agile stories into deployable, mission-critical capabilities.
  

**Why BAE Systems?**
  
We pair a culture of trust and camaraderie with the flexibility you need to perform at your peak. Join a team driven by a shared ambition: protecting freedom through technological superiority.

#LI-PB2
  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Must currently possess a TS/SCI clearance with appropriate polygraph
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. Relevant work experience may be substituted for a Degree.
* Experience with one or more of the following: Java/JEE, Python, C/C++ , SQL, SOAP, WSDL, WADL.
* Experience with User Interface development, knowledge of databases and structures, and/or experience working with XHTML, HTML, XML, XSLT.
* Experience developing on Windows, and/or Linux operating systems.
* Experience with one or more of the following: Java, Python, PERL, PowerShell, VBS, Eclipse, Postgres, Oracle, Jenkins on a Windows platforms.
* Must have a strong understanding of sound software development principles and practices.
* Must be able to plan and prioritize personal tasking and be able to communicate effectively verbally and in writing.
* Must be an independent thinker, capable of performing high quality work, both independently and with a team, in a fast-moving environment.

MDOPS  
  
  
  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Experience with the following: JEE, SQL, application servers (Tomcat, WebLogic, JBoss), scripting.
* Experience with high level requirements management including requirements decomposition, secure systems engineering and development, trade-off analysis, interface control, and testing and continuous integration.
* Experience in software development on Agile teams using Agile Developer practices such as Pair Programming, TDD, Refactoring, and ATDD.
* Experience with FITNesse, Mockito, Cucumber, Unified Functional Tester (UFT), Selenium.
* Experience with Behavior Driven Development (BDD) or Test Driven Development (TDD).
* Secure Software development (i.e. Layer 7 Policy).
* Experience with the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methodology, SAFe Agilest Certification, or past experience as a member of an agile team.

Full-Time Salary Range: $146670 - $249330
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

As a member of our team, you’ll be making critical contributions to develop these next generation systems, ensuring the enduring effectiveness of our Nation’s strategic deterrent. You will be joining a complementary team of engineers who work together to provide impactful solutions to system level objectives and challenges. We are passionate about innovation and our team is committed to providing engaging challenging work and supporting continued learning and development.

**As a Senior Systems Engineer you will…**

* Provide systems engineering expertise and leadership to assess weapon system capabilities and support/lead the development of next generation reentry systems, hypersonic systems, and enabling technologies.
* Collaborate and engage with multi-disciplinary project engineering teams within APL, government sponsors, military personnel, and industry partners to develop innovative solutions.
* You will prepare for and participate in major design and requirements reviews.
* Participate in government working groups and/or integrated product teams to evaluate industry concepts, designs, and proposals to provide technical recommendations to government sponsors.
* Engage with senior government, industry, and national laboratory leadership on fast-paced, high-visibility defense programs.
* Produce reports and presentations to communicate analysis results, concepts, proposals and recommendations to leadership, external organization partners, and government sponsors.

  
**Qualifications**

**You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...**

* Have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline.
* Have minimum 10 years of relevant experience.
* Have experience with complex hardware / software prototype development.
* Have experience leading highly technical cross-functional teams of engineers.
* Have experience in early concept development efforts to include gap assessments, design trade studies, requirements analysis, and risk assessment.
* Have demonstrated ability to interact effectively with and lead multidisciplinary teams, including industry and government sponsors.
* Have initiative and drive to make meaningful contributions to an important mission.
* Hold an active Secret security clearance and can ultimately obtain Top Secret level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

**You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...**

* Have a Master's degree in Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Aerospace Engineering.
* Have experience in the design or development of reentry, hypersonic, or space systems and relevant technologies.
* Have experience engaging with high level government and/or defense industry leadership on highly technical topics.
* Have experience preparing for and participating in major design reviews such as System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR), Critical Design Review (CDR), and Test Readiness Review (TRR).
* Have knowledge of the Navy Trident II Strategic Weapon System and/or Air Force ICBM System.
* Hold an active Secret or higher level clearance.

  
**About Us**

**Why Work at APL?**

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL’s campus is located in the Baltimore-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities at https://www.jhuapl.edu/careers.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, occupation, marital or familial status, political opinion, personal appearance, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. APL is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals of all abilities, including those with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact Accessibility@jhuapl.edu.

The referenced pay range is based on JHU APL’s good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level with consideration for internal parity. * Analyze user and system requirements to define software design, performance needs, and technical constraints.

* Develop and implement algorithms and database interfaces/queries, ranging from simple to highly complex.
* Conduct system and data flow analysis to support solution design and performance optimization.
* Create, review, and improve software and system documentation, development processes, and standards.
* Collaborate with system engineers, hardware engineers, and users to refine requirements and resolve technical challenges.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Robotics is building a brand-new robotics manipulation platform, and we need a versatile software engineer to help bring it to life. In this role, you will own critical software components spanning robotics middleware, health monitoring, and fleet management — systems that must work reliably for a single robot and scale to fleets of thousands. You will work across a broad technology stack, from real-time C++ on the robot to full-stack web applications on AWS, while applying generative AI to automate and streamline operational workflows.  
  
This is a greenfield opportunity where your architectural decisions will shape how Amazon's next generation of robotic systems operate. You will lead multi-engineer projects, influence technical direction across peer teams, and mentor junior engineers — all while writing exemplary code that sets the standard for your team. If you are a curious, adaptable engineer who thrives on solving hard problems across multiple technology domains, we would love to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, build, and own software components for robotics middleware, health monitoring, and fleet management that scale from individual robots to fleets of thousands.
* Lead the technical design and architecture of systems on a new robotics manipulation platform, balancing real-time performance constraints with long-term extensibility and maintainability.
* Collaborate with peer robotics, hardware, and operations teams to define interfaces, resolve cross-team dependencies, and ensure successful end-to-end delivery of integrated robotic systems.
* Apply generative AI tools and techniques to automate workflows, improve developer productivity, and accelerate the team's ability to iterate on new capabilities.
* Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on guidance, raising the overall quality and engineering practices of the team.

  
A day in the life  
You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, owning your projects from concept through production deployment. On a given day you might be writing real-time C++ for robot control in the morning, reviewing a teammate's AWS service design after lunch, and prototyping a generative AI workflow automation by end of day. You will regularly connect with stakeholders across peer robotics and operations teams to align on priorities, unblock dependencies, and share technical insights — while also carving out focused time for deep, heads-down engineering work.

Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. 1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage  
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options  
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)  
4. 401(k) Plan

If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!  
  
About the team  
Our team is developing a new robotics manipulation platform at Amazon Robotics that aims to be as transformative as mobile robots have been for fulfillment operations. We are a 40+ person organization with a dedicated software group of 10+ engineers working alongside mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers. We value collaboration, technical rigor, and a willingness to experiment. As the platform grows, you will have the opportunity to scale systems that directly improve the customer experience and shape the future of robotic automation at Amazon.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Expert level skills in C++
* Experience working on software libraries and tools for building robot applications and/or communication middle-ware.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Experience with robotic motion control systems and algorithms.
* Experience with robotic operating environments like ROS.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer, Test Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

**Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.**

**Role Description**
--------------------

Form Energy is hiring a Senior Electrical Engineer for the Test Infrastructure Team in Somerville, Massachusetts. In this role you will be responsible for the design and delivery of test equipment that enables the execution of critical tests across our iron-air battery systems and supporting hardware. The scope of your work will range from simple fixture development and material handling systems through complex verification test beds used in the evaluation of our battery systems.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the scaling of our battery technology and be part of the growth of a fast-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission!

*Relocation assistance is available.*

### **What you'll do:**

* Design, build, and deploy custom test equipment used in the electrical testing of battery hardware and software.
* Modify existing designs to accommodate new requirements and test objectives.

Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, or a related Science, Engineering or Mathematics field, plus a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree, plus 6 months of relevant experience.

Responsibilities for this Position:

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Systems Engineer to support the long-term sustainment of a fire control system by identifying and mitigating hardware obsolescence risks. In this role, you will assess the system-level impact of unavailable or end-of-life components, evaluate replacement options, and help implement changes that preserve required performance, reliability, safety, and supportability.

**Responsibilities**

* Monitor hardware lifecycle status and identify components at risk of obsolescence.
* Maintain an obsolescence risk register covering affected parts, system configurations, inventory, projected demand, and decision timelines.
* Analyze how proposed substitutions or redesigns affect system requirements, interfaces, software dependencies, reliability, and maintainability.
* Develop and document mitigation options, such as qualified alternate parts, last-time buys, repair solutions, module redesigns, and planned technology refreshes.
* Lead or contribute to trade studies evaluating technical risk, cost, schedule, availability, and verification effort.
* Define requirements and verification approaches for replacement hardware.
* Coordinate with hardware and software engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, reliability, and program management teams.
* Support configuration management and change-control activities, including updates to technical documentation and parts lists.
* Communicate risks, recommendations, and implementation status to program stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in systems engineering, hardware engineering, or product sustainment.
* Ability to analyze requirements, interfaces, and the system-level effects of hardware changes.
* Experience evaluating technical alternatives and documenting engineering decisions.
* Familiarity with configuration management, verification planning, and risk management.
* Strong written communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with hardware obsolescence or diminishing manufacturing sources and material shortages (DMSMS).
* Familiarity with electronic component lifecycles, bills of materials, supplier data, and product lifecycle management tools.
* Experience supporting complex, safety-critical, or long-life systems.
* Experience planning qualification activities for component substitutions or hardware redesigns.

**Workplace Options:**  
This position is fully on-site.

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer, Client Platform Engineer, macOS
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) treats Anthropic's device fleet as a platform we build and run. We run our own MDM as a production service and manage every piece of device configuration as code. Policies, configuration profiles, queries, remediation scripts, and software all ship through pull requests, CI, a staging environment, and a canary group before they reach the fleet. The fleet is mostly macOS, plus a small number of Linux machines and a growing mobile footprint.

You'll own that platform end to end: the infrastructure underneath the MDM, the configuration on top of it, the patching and software pipelines that keep thousands of devices patched and secure, and the telemetry that tells us what is actually true on every device. You'll also build automation that cuts down on manual operational work. You'll work with Security teams on hardening, compliance controls, and detection and response, and with developer and infrastructure teams to make sure those controls don't get in the way of their work. Your work will let us base access decisions on whether a device can be trusted.

We value people who double check a compliance report before they believe it. The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You'll help define the endpoint roadmap, make architecture decisions, and own the platform every Anthropic employee's work runs on. You'll also help us meet the security standards our Responsible Scaling Policy requires as models advance.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own endpoint configuration as code: author, review, test, and progressively roll out MDM policies, configuration profiles, and remediation scripts across macOS and mobile, with canary stages and rollback built in
* Operate the MDM platform itself as a production service, including infrastructure as code, observability, upgrades, and incident response
* Build patch management automation with rapid enforcement timelines while maintaining good user experience
* Design zero touch provisioning that turns a sealed box into a productive machine on day one
* Support a small number of Linux machines alongside the Mac fleet
* Turn fleet telemetry into policy, dashboards, and early drift warnings, and use Claude to automate manual ops work
* Partner with Corporate Security on endpoint hardening, binary authorization, and compliance controls
* Take shifts on the team's rotation for incoming requests and escalations, and serve as the deep escalation tier for endpoint issues IT Operations can't resolve

**You may be a good fit if you**
--------------------------------

* Have 8+ years building secure IT systems in complex environments, including leading projects across multiple teams
* Have managed endpoint fleets of thousands of macOS devices through a modern MDM
* Treat endpoint configuration as code that is version controlled and peer reviewed, rather than clicking in consoles
* Go deep on macOS internals such as launchd, configuration profiles, TCC, and system extensions
* Write Python and shell scripts
* Write design docs and runbooks so teammates can review and support what you build

**Strong candidates may also have**
-----------------------------------

* Have operated an MDM or device management platform as a service, not only consumed one as SaaS
* Have worked with open source endpoint and device management tooling (Munki, osquery, AutoPkg)
* Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetry
* Have experience running infrastructure as code in a public cloud
* Have working knowledge of Linux administration (packaging, systems, config management)
* Have used LLMs to automate ops work

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our ADAS HMI team within the Interactive Experience platform. In this role, you will design and deliver production automotive embedded software spanning microcontroller (MCU) and System-on-Chip (SoC) platforms. Your work will connect vehicle signals, sensors, and real-time controls to the services that power driver-facing alerts, controls, and situational-awareness experiences. You will apply strong system design and architecture skills to define clear boundaries, interfaces, and data flows across in-vehicle compute domains while meeting demanding requirements for safety, startup time, determinism, resource use, and reliability throughout the vehicle lifecycle.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design and develop production automotive embedded systems spanning MCU firmware and SoC software using C/C++.
* Translate vehicle-level requirements into implementable software architectures, including component boundaries, hardware and software interfaces, communication protocols, data flows, timing budgets, diagnostics, and degraded-mode behavior.

* Build reliable interfaces between real-time MCU applications and SoC services that support driver controls, alerts, chimes, lighting, haptics, and situational-awareness experiences.
* Design software that behaves predictably across vehicle power states, startup and shutdown sequences, communication faults, watchdog recovery, and constrained operating conditions.

* Debug complex cross-domain issues involving MCU firmware, vehicle networks, IPC, SoC services, operating-system behavior, electrical interfaces, and downstream applications.
* Own major vehicle features through the full development lifecycle, from concept and design through implementation, integration, vehicle validation, production launch, and field maintenance.
* Improve engineering productivity through build, test, debugging, simulation, profiling, or developer-workflow tooling.
* Drive shift-left quality through unit, software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, integration, performance, and fault-injection testing.
Mentor junior engineers and serve as a technical resource for system design, C/C++ development, and cross-domain debugging.

* At least 5 years of professional experience developing and shipping embedded software for production products.
* Strong C/C++ development experience on both microcontroller and SoC-based platforms.
* Demonstrated system design and software architecture skills, including decomposition of broad requirements into components, interfaces, and executable technical plans.
* Experience with real-time or resource-constrained MCU software, such as RTOS applications, board-support packages, device drivers, peripherals, or low-level communication stacks.
* Experience with SoC software environments, such as Embedded Linux, QNX, yocto, including IPC and system resource management.
* Experience debugging and testing integrated embedded systems using tools such as in-circuit debuggers, traces, bus analyzers, profilers, SiL, or HiL.
Experience with version control, code review, build systems, static analysis, and CI/CD workflows.  

  

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Experience creating or improving developer tooling, build infrastructure, automated test frameworks, simulation environments, diagnostics, or debugging utilities.
* Experience delivering embedded software for production automotive systems and vehicle program milestones.
* Experience with automotive networks and protocols such as CAN, LIN, Ethernet, SOME/IP, DBC, or UDS.
* Experience designing cross-domain communication between safety-critical or real-time MCU functions and higher-level SoC services.
* Familiarity with automotive engineering practices and standards such as ASPICE, ISO 26262, AUTOSAR, or MISRA C/C++.

jobs.title: Staff Hardware Engineer - ECU Requirements & Specifications
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**About the Team**

Compute & Connectivity Hardware (CCH) is part of GM’s Software & Services organization and owns the hardware foundation for GM’s software-defined vehicles. The team develops and integrates the compute, connectivity, networking, and electronic platforms that support vehicle intelligence, infotainment, ADAS, mechatronic controls, connected services, and over-the-air experiences.

  

CCH work spans architecture, requirements, hardware design, embedded systems, cybersecurity, functional safety, integration, validation, launch, and field performance. Our engineers collaborate across software, systems, controls, vehicle engineering, suppliers, and manufacturing to solve complex technical problems and deliver reliable, production-ready hardware across GM’s vehicle portfolio.

  

**The Opportunity**

Electronic Control Units (ECUs) are central to GM’s Software Defined Vehicle and electrified-vehicle architectures. The ECU Hardware Requirements & Specifications team is seeking a highly experienced Staff Hardware Engineer to provide technical leadership for the development, management, and continuous improvement of hardware requirements, low-level software definitions, and Component Technical Requirements Specifications (CTRS) across GM’s vehicle portfolio.

  

This role is for a recognized technical leader who can operate across hardware, software, vehicle, electrical architecture, diagnostics, safety, sourcing, manufacturing, and external engineering organizations. The Staff Engineer will shape technical direction, establish common solutions, resolve complex system interactions, and influence decisions across the portfolio without direct people-management responsibility.

  

The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of automotive embedded control systems with strong requirements-engineering discipline, systems thinking, business judgment, and the ability to translate complex technical issues into clear decisions and executable outcomes. They will help advance common, traceable, high-quality ECU requirements and support the continued modernization of GM’s requirements-management practices, including DOORS Next-Gen, automation, and leveraging AI to improve requirement quality.

  

**The Role**

As a level-8 Staff Engineer, you will serve as a technical authority for ECU hardware requirements and specifications. You will lead complex technical projects, establish alignment across dependent engineering organizations, mentor engineers, and drive decisions through influence, technical rigor, and clear communication.

  

You will support build-to-spec and build-to-print ECU designs across GM’s diverse vehicle and electrical architectures, including electrification and Electric Vehicle applications. Your work will enable standardized hardware designs, component commonization, requirements reuse, seamless software implementation, and effective downstream verification and validation. You will actively use AI tools to enhance and improve our requirement development process.

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the development, maintenance, and configuration management of ECU hardware electrical and functional interface requirements, including interactions with vehicle electronic and mechatronic devices and low-level software.
* Establish technical direction for embedded-controller requirements across vehicle, electrical/controller architecture, infrastructure software, low-level software, diagnostics, hardware design, safety, and product design release stakeholders.
* Drive standardization of Input/Output interfaces and promote commonization and reuse of components across ECU hardware designs and the CTRS portfolio.
* Lead requirements reviews, design-flow execution, change-control activities, and technical approval discussions to achieve rigor, alignment, timely decisions, and high-quality execution.
* Provide technical leadership for CTRS compilation and build activities supporting product-team sourcing, build-to-print implementation, and post-sourcing design changes.
* Establish and improve traceability between internal and external CTRS requirements and downstream verification and validation activities.
* Identify requirements and design gaps across GM and external engineering implementations, and drive ECU, sub-component, and circuit-level corrective actions when designs do not adhere to common requirements.
* Lead or support the migration, deployment, and continuous improvement of ECU hardware requirements in DOORS Next-Gen and other structured requirements-management environments.
* Support requirements and specifications for ECU manufacturing, remanufacturing, and plant/service programming implementations.
* Apply systems thinking to complex interactions among ECU hardware, low-level software, diagnostics, communications, mechatronics, vehicle systems, and electrical architectures.
* Provide technical leadership for semiconductor and microprocessor functional-safety activities, including requirements aligned to safety-manual use cases and safety-critical embedded-control applications.
* Contribute to ECU circuit-level requirements and safety-related activities, including the interpretation of failure modes and the integration of safety considerations into technical requirements.
* Champion continuous improvement through new technologies, automation, artificial intelligence, competitive benchmarking, and improved requirements-documentation methods.
* Lead cross-functional technical forums and complex projects, resolve ambiguity, mediate competing stakeholder needs, and communicate recommendations to technical and leadership audiences.
Mentor engineers and promote technical excellence, accountability, innovation, and disciplined execution across diverse and global teams.  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipl

jobs.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.

**Your Role:**

As a Principal Controls Engineer supporting Vantive’s Acute Therapies portfolio, you will be a key contributor in the model-based development and verification of control algorithms for the PrisMax system. Your work will shape how the device interprets sensor inputs, controls electromechanical components, manages operating states, and supports safe, reliable therapy delivery.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for an engineer who can take a complex control problem from system behavior and requirements through algorithm design, simulation, embedded implementation, and verification. You partner with Systems, Software, Hardware, Quality, and V&V develop, verify, and document effective control solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

**Control Algorithm Design and Model-Based Development**

* Take technical ownership of complex PrisMax control algorithms, from expected system behavior and requirements through model architecture, implementation, integration, and lifecycle changes.
* Develop and refine algorithms using MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow for functions involving sensors, pumps, motors, valves, alarms, and therapy-related calculations.
* Apply control theory, dynamic-system analysis, and sound engineering judgment to evaluate performance across intended operating conditions, component variation, and foreseeable faults.
* Produce model-generated code and partner with Software Engineering on interfaces, execution behavior, and integration into the device’s embedded software.

**Verify Control Algorithms**

* Define verification approaches for model-based algorithms, including model review, simulation, coverage analysis, interface testing, and testing of integrated software or device behavior.
* Develop and review test cases that challenge nominal, boundary, fault, and difficult-to-reproduce conditions; ensure expected results and acceptance criteria are clear.
* Lead the technical analysis of test results and discrepancies, distinguish model defects from interface or integration issues, and drive robust resolutions.
* Produce clear, traceable design and verification documentation that supports formal test execution, design reviews, and product development records.

**Advance Modeling and Simulation**

* Contribute to fit-for-purpose models of device components and system dynamics so control concepts can be evaluated before and alongside physical-device testing.
* Use model-in-the-loop, software-in-the-loop, and hardware-in-the-loop methods where appropriate to explore design tradeoffs, characterize performance, and expose integration risks.
* Document model assumptions, interfaces, limitations, and supporting evidence so simulation results can be interpreted and reused responsibly.

**Strengthen Controls Engineering**

* Lead reviews of algorithm designs and verification strategies, making tradeoffs and technical risks visible to cross-functional partners.
* Mentor engineers in model-based design, controls analysis, testability, and disciplined problem solving while remaining directly involved in critical technical work.
* Identify opportunities to improve the controls development practice by introducing reusable models, robust test techniques, and common design practices to enhance the quality and maintainability of control algorithms.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Controls Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 6+ years of relevant engineering experience, including substantial hands-on development of control algorithms for embedded electromechanical products.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Controls, Electrical, Mechanical, Biomedical, Systems, or a related engineering discipline.
* Demonstrated experience designing and testing executable control models using MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow, or a closely comparable model-based development environment.
* Experience with model-generated code and its integration into real-time embedded software.
* Experience with plant modeling, physics-based simulation, and model-in-the-loop, software-in-the-loop, or hardware-in-the-loop testing.
* Ability to independently resolve complex technical problems, lead design reviews, and influence complex technical decision making when issues arise.
* Experience developing medical devices or other safety-critical products, including requirements traceability, risk-informed design, configuration control, and formal documentation.
* Experience modeling fluidic, thermal, electromechanical, or physiological-system behavior relevant.

### **Description**

We’re SmartThings, one of the leading IoT ecosystems in the world, creating the most effortless way for anyone to create a smart home. We're a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung with corporate offices in Minneapolis and the Bay Area.  
  
More than 430 million people worldwide use SmartThings to control and manage their connected life. SmartThings delivers simple, powerful experiences across Samsung’s leading portfolio of phones, TVs, and appliances. We also offer the most versatile smart home experience as an open platform with a rich partner ecosystem (think IKEA, SONOS, Honeywell, and so many more). As a founding member of Matter, we are a leader in the industry to help make smart homes more secure, reliable and seamless to use. Come be a part of the leading edge of IoT innovation!  
  
**About The Team:** The Hub Platform team owns foundational software, infrastructure, and operational practices that power SmartThings hubs in the field, and we're building the architecture that lets us support future hub platforms as they come online. The SmartThings Hub acts as a secure edge gateway that translates and bridges local, cross-protocol IoT devices to the SmartThings cloud, enabling centralized routing and execution across a unified ecosystem. We work across three pillars:

* Hub Systems & Architecture: the embedded Linux OS, secure boot chain, firmware rollout process, and hardware platform abstraction
* Hub to Cloud Connections & Attestation: secure hub-to-cloud connectivity, device claim, and attestation so every hub in the field is uniquely identified and trusted
* Hub Developer Operations: the CI/build infrastructure that keeps the entire hub engineering org shipping reliably and the tooling that keeps engineers developing efficiently

Our work sits at the intersection of embedded firmware and cloud services, and it directly determines the stability, security, and update reliability that millions of connected homes rely on every day.

**About The Role:** We're looking for a **Staff Software Engineer** to be a technical owner and leader for the Hub Platform team. You'll help drive long-term technical strategies for our core domains. You'll operate with autonomy to bring clarity to complex, cross-functional challenges. You’ll act as a go-to expert and point of contact for major initiatives, and partner closely with firmware, security, cloud, and product teams to shape how SmartThings hubs evolve. You'll also mentor engineers across the team, including senior engineers, and help guide how the team adopts AI-assisted development and operational practices.

This role is **hybrid, 3 days/week in our Minneapolis Office** (on iconic St Anthony Main across from Downtown...with paid attached parking!).

* **Lead Complex Initiatives:** Act as a technical owner for large, complex, cross-functional projects, architecting scalable solutions for evolving domain needs.

* **Mentor & Elevate the Team:** Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers at every level, including senior engineers, and help build engineering practices that raise the bar across the org.
* **Operational Excellence & On-Call:** Participate in observability, incident response, and on-call rotations supporting the production firmware delivery, hub connectivity, and attestation services that the global hub fleet depends on.

Summary
  
A Manufacturing Automation Engineer designs, builds, deploys, and validates custom automated assembly and test equipment for connector manufacturing. They program PLCs, integrate robotics and vision systems, and manage projects from concept to production ramp. This role ensures scalable, high-quality production under strict defense and aerospace standards.

* Equipment Lifecycle Management: Own automation projects from conception through User Requirement Specifications (URS), vendor selection, FAT/SAT, and final production handover.
* Programming & Integration: Program PLCs, HMIs, and safety systems; integrate robots/cobots and machine vision for automated guidance and 100% in-line inspection.
* Process Automation & Tooling: Architect automation for critical connector manufacturing processes.
* System Traceability: Connect custom assembly and test equipment to MES/SCADA networks for data matrix serialization, statistical process control (SPC), and real-time OEE tracking.

* Quality & Compliance: Lead PFMEA, design reviews, and process validations (IQ/OQ/PQ) ensuring strict adherence to AS9100/ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 standards.

* Safety: Enforce electrical and machine safety standards, including ESD protocols, LOTO procedures, and safety PLC configurations.
* Design for Automation (DFA): Redesign existing legacy connectors and components to improve automated handling, alignment, and assembly while ensuring zero impact on form, fit, function, and strict mil-aero qualification requirements.
* Uphold Positronic’s standards of integrity, quality, and operational excellence.

jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

**WHAT WE'RE DOING**  
By bringing together people that use their passion for purposeful innovation, at Lockheed Martin we keep people safe and solve the world's most complex challenges. Our people are some of the greatest minds in the industry and truly make Lockheed Martin a great place to work. With our employees as our priority, we provide diverse career opportunities designed to propel development and boost agility. Our flexible schedules, competitive pay, and comprehensive benefits enable our employees to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work. At Lockheed Martin, we place an emphasis on empowering our employees by fostering innovation, integrity, and exemplifying the epitome of corporate responsibility. Your Mission is Ours.

**THE WORK**  
Lockheed Martin has been embedded with the USSTRATCOM Nuclear Mission for 30+ years and has a track record of bringing innovative mission software solutions to this domain. Lockheed Martin Rotary & Mission Systems is seeking engineers to support our USSTRATCOM software teams which create Planning and Command and Control (C2) capabilities as part of the Strategic Mission Planning and Execution System (SMPES) in a DevSecOps environment.

In this role, you will help our team create modern Web-based, Java mission systems for the Nuclear community. The successful candidate will have experience with software systems built to exacting standards that are delivered on a DevSecOps cadence using Agile Scrum.

**WHO YOU ARE**  
Our team needs a full-time Cyber Software Engineer. In this role, you will help an Agile team deliver secure solutions by reviewing code, configuring cyber tooling embedded in pipelines, and coordinating with Government cybersecurity stakeholders. You will need to help design new secure patterns and be an advocate for cybersecurity.

Must be a US Citizen. This position will require a government security clearance.

**WHY JOIN US**  
Joining our team offers you the opportunity to support a join a company and a team where your contributions are valued and you can develop your skills and expertise.  
Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren't focused on how many hours you spend at work or online.

Instead, we're happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life both in and outside of work, along with competitive pay, and comprehensive benefits.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

Basic Qualifications :  

* Proven ability to review code for secure coding best practices
* Experience using Cyber DAST/SAST tooling
* Experience developing in Java / Typescript
* Experience tracking security compliance

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* OIDC/OAuth/SSO/RBAC Experience
* CISSP Certification
* Experience integrating cyber tooling into CI/CD and IDE environments
* Microservice Architecture experience
* RMF/STIG experience
* Engineering experience with AFNWC SMPES, MPAS, NPES Systems

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $72900.00 - $135500.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

**Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

* Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
* For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

jobs.title: Electrical Controls Engineer

As an Electrical Controls Engineer, you play a vital role in the development of application specific products through electrical design, process development, and production readiness for new and existing OEM programs.

ABTech creates, builds and supports industry leading precision motion systems. With growth in our OEM programs, we are currently looking to strengthen our engineering team’s ability to support on-site production.

* Understand, modify and maintain plc programs and application software used by motion control suppliers. Application specific software (PLC's and servo settings) to be stored on the Network system consistent with ABTech documentation procedures.

* Minimum requirement: 5+ years of experience in electrical controls design of motion systems
* Electrical or Electromechanical degree preferred
* An eye for continuous improvement and process development
* Knowledgeable in NFPA safety regulations, UL & CE documentation requirements
* Strong troubleshooting skills
* Strong organizational and documentation skills
* Ideal candidate will be a self-starter who enjoys product development and collaboration in a team environment
