jobs.description:
Description:

**ABOUT PROTORA**

**Protora** (formerly *C Speed*) builds radar and surveillance systems that give military and government customers eyes on their airspace, borders, and critical sites. Our name draws from the *Praetorian Guard*, elite soldiers whose job was to **watch and protect**. That history shapes our mission today: we take first watch, so the people we protect don't have to. We are a growing company with a new brand and a clear direction. **This role is an important part of designing, developing, and testing the radar technology behind our mission**.

**THE ROLE**

**Protora** is seeking a mid-level **RF Hardware Engineer** to design, build and test the RF hardware at the heart of our radar systems, including receivers, exciters and transmitters. In this role, you will own discrete technical work packages end to end—from block diagram and component selection through simulation, bring-up, integration and field test—with guidance from senior staff on program-level architecture. You will work alongside antenna, signal processing, software, and systems engineering teams to turn performance requirements into demonstrated capability.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Design, build and test radar receiver, exciter and transmitter subsystems, from block diagram and component selection through schematic capture, board and subsystem bring-up and verification.
* Perform RF cascade analysis (gain, noise figure, linearity, dynamic range and phase noise) and allocate system-level requirements to hardware specifications.
* Simulate RF circuits and assemblies using RF toolsets and validate models against measured performance.
* Work with antenna, signal processing and systems engineers on interfaces, calibration approaches and system-level performance trades.
* Lead hardware bring-up, debug and troubleshooting; plan and execute laboratory, chamber, and field test and analyze measured data against predicted performance.
* Support environmental and EMI/EMC qualification (e.g., MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461) and transition designs to production, including acceptance test procedures.
* Author technical documentation, including hardware specifications, design documentation, trade studies, test plans and procedures, and test reports.
* Present analysis and test results at internal design reviews and customer technical exchanges.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* **B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Physics**, or a related technical field.
* **4–7 years of professional experience** designing, building and testing RF/microwave hardware, preferably for radar or other sensor systems.
* Solid grasp of RF and microwave fundamentals, including S-parameters, impedance matching, noise figure, linearity (P1dB, IP3), and phase noise, along with working knowledge of radar theory such as radar range equation.
* Demonstrated ability to apply RF and radar theory to hardware design, integration, and troubleshooting.
* Demonstrated ability to work **collaboratively in a lean, cross-functional engineering environment** with a positive, solutions-oriented approach.
* Disciplined **engineering mindset** with an understanding of engineering processes, including requirements, design, documentation, integration, test, and validation.
* Proficiency in **MATLAB** or **Python** for analysis, test automation, and data reduction.
* Experience with RF design and simulation tools and schematic capture and layout tools (OrCAD).
* Hands-on experience with hardware bring-up, integration, and test, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, vector network analyzers, oscilloscopes, power meters, and noise figure and phase noise measurement equipment.
* Demonstrated ability to document and present technical work to engineering and customer audiences.
* U.S. person status and the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. DoD Secret clearance.
* Ability to work across office, laboratory, anechoic chamber, and outdoor test range environments, including occasional testing outside standard business hours to meet range scheduling constraints.
* Ability to lift and move test equipment and hardware and work outdoors in varying weather conditions during field testing.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, RF/Microwave Engineering, electromagnetics, or related discipline.
* Active DoD Secret or Top-Secret clearance.
* Experience with active electronically scanned arrays (**AESA**), T/R modules, or phased array calibration.
* Experience designing amplifiers, low-noise receivers, frequency synthesizers or LO distribution networks.
* Experience with air surveillance, counter-UAS, or weapon-locating radar.
* Embedded or **FPGA/DSP** implementation experience (**VHDL, Verilog, or C/C++** on real-time targets).
* Prior work under **MIL-STD-461/464, MIL-STD-810**, or comparable qualification standards.
* Experience with RF PCB layout and taking RF hardware from prototype into production including design for manufacturability.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

* **Compensation Range**: $120,000 - $130,000 commensurate with experience.
* **Benefits**: Health, Dental & Vision Insurance | Paid Time Off (**PTO**) | Retirement Plan Package.

**WHY JOIN PROTORA**

* **Direct impact**. Your engineering work directly contributes to radar systems designed to support critical missions.
* **Hands-on engineering**. You will design hardware, bring it up on the bench, see it perform in the lab and out in the field.
* **Work that supports people who protect others**. The systems you build help the people on watch see threats coming.

**READY TO JOIN THE MISSION?**

**Protora** is always looking for talented professionals who want to do meaningful work with a team that treats every challenge like a mission.

For more information about **Protora**, please visit our website: http://protoratech.com

**Become a Key Player as an Embedded Senior Software Engineer**

You will design, develop, verify and lead embedded software projects that enable fuel measurement, management and inerting systems for aerospace and industrial applications. You will partner closely with systems and electronic hardware engineering stakeholders and lead projects from planning through execution. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - FE
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Intuit Mailchimp is a leading marketing platform for small businesses. We empower millions of customers around the world to build their brands and grow their companies with a suite of marketing automation, multichannel campaigns, CRM, and analytics tools.

Forms are where a huge share of that growth starts. Signup forms, embedded forms, landing page forms, and the pop-ups our customers put in front of their own audiences are the front door to list growth on Mailchimp, and they are rendered across an enormous surface area: inside our own app, and inside millions of third-party websites we do not control. We are looking for a Staff-level frontend engineer to set technical direction for that platform.

This role is about depth, not breadth of headcount. You will own the architecture of a schema-driven, micro-frontend-based forms platform: the contracts that describe a form, the runtime that renders it, the composition layer that lets independently deployed teams ship into a shared experience, and the operational discipline that keeps all of it fast and reliable on somebody else's page. You will do that alongside product, design, and engineers across the Forms, and you will be the person other engineers come to when a rendering, contract, or performance decision needs to be made well the first time.

  

**How you'll work**
-------------------

Our Core Leadership Behaviors are the observable and measurable leadership actions and skills that contribute to our effectiveness and success in our roles.

  

* **Thriving in Complexity:** You unravel and make sense of potentially sophisticated, incomplete, and contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* **Nimble Learning:** You tackle problems with experimentation, using successes and failures to inform future decisions.
* **Expecting the Best:** You hold yourself and others accountable to meet commitments.
* **Collaborating Courageously:** You build partnerships across the company and work collaboratively with others to meet strategic goals.
* **Cultivating Candor:** You act with integrity and earn the confidence and trust of others through honesty and authenticity.
* **Inclusive Leadership:** You recognize the value diversity brings to our organization and leverage different perspectives to enhance organizational culture and drive performance.
* **Customer Obsessed:** You listen hard to customers, understand their challenges, develop relationships with them, and deliver products that remove their obstacles.
* **Action Oriented:** You initiate new opportunities and face tough challenges with a sense of energy, enthusiasm, and service.

**Responsibilities**

* Set the technical direction for the Mailchimp Forms frontend platform, micro-frontend boundaries, module federation and composition strategy, versioning and rollback, and the migration path off legacy rendering paths in the monolith.
* Own the schema contracts that drive our form experiences end to end: the schema definition, validation, versioning and backward-compatibility strategy, and the renderer that turns schema into accessible, performant UI without a code change per field type.
* Drive operational excellence as a first-class deliverable SLOs and error budgets for a client-side product, real-user performance monitoring, Core Web Vitals, structured client-side telemetry, alerting that pages on customer-visible degradation rather than noise, and blameless postmortems that actually change the system.
* Be the technical lead across the full lifecycle: scoping, design, implementation, testing, documentation, rollout, and long-term maintenance, including the unglamorous parts.
* Raise the bar for other engineers through design reviews, pairing, and written architecture guidance covering integration, performance, accessibility, and scalability and find the balance between writing code yourself and creating room for others to grow.
* Extend and contribute back to our design system: component APIs, design tokens, and theming that hold up when a customer embeds our form into their own brand and stylesheet.
* Own accessibility as a requirement, not a cleanup task — WCAG 2.2 AA conformance, keyboard and screen-reader behavior, and automated a11y checks wired into CI.
* Use AI coding agents and GenAI-assisted development as part of how you work, and help the team establish what good looks like: where agents accelerate us, where they need guardrails, and how review standards adapt.
* Share production ownership and on-call rotation with the rest of the team.

**Qualifications**

* You have significant experience designing and implementing frontend architectures at scale and writing code that is maintainable, performant, and observable, not just code that ships.
* You have built or substantially evolved a **micro-frontend architecture** in production: independently deployable frontends, shared dependency and runtime strategy, cross-team contracts, isolation and blast-radius control, and the versioning discipline that keeps it from turning into distributed spaghetti. You can speak candidly about what went wrong and what you would do differently.
* You have deep expertise in **schema-driven / config-driven UI;** JSON Schema or an equivalent contract language, dynamic form rendering, declarative validation, schema evolution and backward compatibility, and codegen from contracts. You understand where schema-driven design pays for itself and where it becomes an abstraction tax.
* You hold a high bar on **software engineering fundamentals and operational excellence**: testing strategy that gives real confidence, CI/CD and progressive delivery, feature flags, instrumentation and observability, incident response, and a track record of owning what you ship in production.
* You are fluent in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and a major component framework (React preferred), and you understand the browser deeply enough to reason about bundle size, hydration, rendering perf

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will drive technical strategy and architecture decisions for software modules that empower robots to operate.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Drive architecture and design decisions for robotic software systems, including perception, navigation, motor control, reasoning, and human-robot interaction.
* Own end-to-end delivery of complex software systems, from design through production deployment and operational excellence.
* Lead collaboration across research, machine learning, hardware, and operations teams to deliver integrated solutions.
* Define technical roadmaps and drive innovation in robotic software development, including production-level SDKs for developer use.
* Design and implement systems and tools that accelerate development velocity for multi-disciplinary engineering teams.

  
About the team  
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
  
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
  
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
  
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
  
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

About Exponent:

**Exponent** is the only premium engineering and scientific consulting firm with the depth and breadth of expertise to solve our clients’ most profoundly unique, unprecedented, and urgent challenges.

Our vision is to engage multidisciplinary teams of science, engineering, and regulatory experts to empower clients with solutions that create a safer, healthier, more sustainable world. For over five decades, we've connected the lessons of past failures with tomorrow's solutions to advise clients as they innovate technologically complex products and processes, ensure the safety and health of their users, and address the challenges of sustainability.

Join our team of experts with degrees from top programs at over 500 universities and extensive experience spanning a variety of industries. At Exponent, you’ll contribute to the diverse pool of ideas, talents, backgrounds, and experiences that drives our collaborative teamwork and breakthrough insights. Plus, we help you grow your career through mentoring, sponsorship, and a culture of learning. Thanks for your interest in joining our team!

**Key statistics:**

* 950+ Consultants
* 640+ Ph.D.s
* 90+ Disciplines
* 30+ Offices globally

In this role, you will work as part of a team performing technical services involving both physical analysis as well as software and data analysis, with the aim of providing scientific and engineering solutions for a diverse variety of challenges faced by clients ranging from early-stage startups through to fortune 100 companies.

You will be expected to combine computer science principles, data driven techniques, and a range of investigative analysis techniques with robust subject-specific scientific expertise, to implement high-value solutions to complex technical problems. You will have the opportunity to apply your technical expertise across an extremely wide cross-section of industry, and will interact with a variety of client contacts ranging from managers, engineers, legal staff, and business leaders. You will be expected to demonstrate continued professional growth, both in technical areas relevant to your expertise, and in business skills essential to providing effective consulting services.

* Using deep expertise in physics, electrical engineering, or a related field to develop solutions to a wide array of challenging technical problems
* Performing a variety of numerical analysis, modeling, and simulation activities to support engineering goals
* Performing reliability and failure analysis related to electrical/electronic systems and components as well as to computer systems and associated networks
* Presenting technical results and solutions to a diverse audience through verbal, written, and interactive communication
* Preparing technical proposals, pursuing business developments, and expanding the range of software-related services Exponent provides to clients

You will have the following skills and qualifications:

* Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or a related field
* An understanding of investigative analysis for troubleshooting technical issues and solving technical challenges
* Experience with at least one common programming language such as Python, C/C++, Java, MATLAB, or similar
* Technical hands-on experience with electronics, device hardware, robotics, semiconductors, optics, power systems, or measurement instrumentation
* Excellent written and verbal communications skills, and ability to work independently or in multidisciplinary teams
* Ability to gather information and convey technical conclusions to individuals in engineering, business, and related industry
* Interest in learning and working with a wide range of devices and systems that span a broad array of consumer and industrial applications, including both hardware and software elements of these systems
* Desire to learn, and work with, a wide array of different programming languages, software frameworks, and tools
* Ability to support multiple group projects and market the Computer, Data & Security Sciences Practice and its consulting services
* Presently legally authorized to work in the United States; no immigration sponsorship or processing required

*Applicants are encouraged to submit a CV (Curriculum Vitae) with publications (feel free to include publications that are in review or pending) [not restricted to 1 page].*

To learn more about life at Exponent and our impact, please visit the following links:

https://www.exponent.com/company/our-impact

Attracting, inspiring, developing, and rewarding exceptional people with diverse backgrounds and expertise are central to our corporate culture. Our diverse team allows us to provide better value to our clients and enjoy an enriched work environment.

Our firm is committed to offering a variety of programs and resources to support health and well-being. We believe that providing competitive benefits as well as compensation and recognition programs empowers our staff to do work that makes a difference.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Integrations
jobs.description:
We're Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.

We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.

We’re looking for a **Senior Software Engineer, Fulfillment,** at an exciting time — we’ve successfully launched multiple platforms and products, raised over $100m in VC funding, reached profitability, and have a growth trajectory of over 100% YoY.

  

Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL BE GETTING INVOLVED IN**
----------------------------------------

Scan.com's integration layer is mission-critical infrastructure. We interface with hundreds of imaging centers and health systems operating disparate, often decades-old systems — RIS platforms built on legacy protocols, HL7 v2 feeds with idiosyncratic vendor dialects, and hardware gateways running in constrained clinical environments. On the demand side, we connect to modern EHR APIs, third-party referral networks, and portal integrations that must work reliably at scale.

As a **Senior Software Engineer, Integrations**, you will architect and build the systems that make these connections robust, observable, and extensible. This problem area requires genuine passion for legacy system integration patterns, message transformation pipelines, and the operational discipline to maintain high-reliability infrastructure against the entropy of the real world.

As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:

* Build and maintain REST API integrations with third-party referral sources, attorney platforms, and demand aggregators, including OAuth flows, rate limiting, retry logic, and schema versioning. Design and implement HL7 v2 transformation pipelines — parsing, normalizing, enriching, and routing ADT, ORM, ORU, SIU, and MDM message types across heterogeneous RIS and EHR systems with non-standard vendor extensions.
* Build and maintain integration connectors for modern and legacy imaging center RIS systems.
* Architect fault-tolerant message queuing and delivery infrastructure for inbound and outbound HL7 and API traffic.
* Develop interfaces for demand-side EHR integrations, including mapping from internal data models to FHIR-compliant (and other standards) representations.
* Own the observability layer for the integration infrastructure: structured logging, alerting on message processing latency/failures, and dashboards that surface issues before they reach the operations teams.
* Contribute to the design of integration onboarding tooling that reduces time-to-live for new imaging center and referral source connections
* Provide technical mentorship to mid-level engineers and participate in architecture reviews across the broader Engineering org

**WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE**
-------------------------------------

You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

* Strong command of message transformation architecture: you can design pipelines that are observable, replayable, and extensible without requiring a full rewrite every time a new vendor is onboarded
* Proficiency in at least one backend language used in high-reliability integration contexts (Python, Ruby, Java, C# are all relevant; language is less important than architectural rigor).
* Familiarity with RESTful API integration patterns, including schema versioning, backward compatibility, and API contract management
* Strong operational instincts: you instrument what you build, you think about failure modes before they happen, and you treat on-call escalations as a signal about systemic gaps
* Experience in healthcare is a plus, but not required. We care far more about your integration engineering depth and legacy system fluency than your industry background

**A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE**
-------------------------

We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here.

  

**HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU**
-----------------------------

We keep our interview process short and sweet, and we're a nimble team that can progress at pace. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order depending on team availability:

* Introductory video call with our Senior Talent Partner, approximately 30 minutes.
* Video call and coding exercise with a software engineer on the team, approximately 60 minutes. This will be a live assessment of your technical skill.
* Assessment stage. This will be cross functional in nature, and will assess your systems design skills along with your ability to evolve a feature with your future teammates.
* Final round with our Chief Technology Officer and Chief Product Officer. This round will assess alignment with our company values.
* Offer!

**WHAT WE OFFER**
-----------------

We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. Here’s what you can
  
expect from us:

* Salary range of **$180,000 - $200,000**
* Equity
* Flexible hybrid work options
* Dedicated personal dev

WSP is currently initiating a search for a **Temporary Early Career Electrical Engineer** for our **Syracuse, NY; Freeport, ME; or Ann Arbor, MI** office. The successful applicant will be responsible for performing electrical studies and/or developing and troubleshooting supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems for utility and industrial/commercial clients. Applicable power systems primarily include conventional and renewable generation facilities, substations, transmission systems, and distribution systems.

* **Protective Relaying:** Short circuit and symmetrical component analysis, time-current coordination, protection scheme and criteria development, relay settings calculation, integration with SCADA systems, NERC compliance, and arc flash analysis. Applicable software: AcSELerator Quickset (SEL-5030), AcSELerator Architect, GE Enervista, ASPEN Oneliner, SKM-PTW, ETAP, RSCAD/RTDS.

Applicable software includes Wonderware, Clearview, AcSELerator RTAC, Visual Basic, OSI PI, and Python scripting.

jobs.description:

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience programming in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, C++, Java, Kotlin, or Go.
* 5 years of experience testing and launching software products, and 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows (e.g., prompt engineering, agent development, evaluation suites, synthetic data generation).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in learning and education, cognitive science, psychometry, or learning analytics.
* Experience building or leveraging rapid prototyping tech stacks (e.g., cloud-native development, Vercel).

**About the job**
-----------------

Team Learning Frontiers' mission is to reimagine learning in the agentic era with frontier and multimodal models by building novel student and teacher experiences grounded in proven learning science. Operating like a nimble 0-to-1 startup within Google, we ideate, prototype, and de-risk step-change experiences across the student journey, backed by research from our Learning Sciences and Pedagogy team. From interactive audio-visual activities to collaborative, gamified learning environments, we partner across Google's flagship product surfaces and product areas to graduate and scale our successful experiments into products that fundamentally impact how students learn.

Learning is the ongoing quest for understanding, and we made it our mission more than 20 years ago to organize the world’s information to make it universally accessible and useful. The learning landscape is changing, and the Learning and Education team's mission is to help everyone in the world learn anything in the world. We provide the information, tools, and services that help people gain knowledge, fuel curiosity, and prepare for what’s next. We focus our work to add the most value for users to enable learning for school, work, and life. We believe everyone can and should have access to quality learning experiences to reach their full potential.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

* Explore and push the boundary of AI capabilities to build advanced tools for students and teachers, supported by learning science and pedagogical principles.
* Partner and lead collaborations across Google's flagship product surfaces and product areas to graduate and scale validated educational concepts.
* Influence the team's technical and product direction from zero-to-one concept ideation through iterative experimentation.

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer

* Security & IT

**About Vercel:**
-----------------

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re hiring an IT Systems Engineer to help build, secure, and improve the systems our employees rely on every day, with a particular focus on identity and access management (IAM) and mobile device management (MDM).

You’ll share ownership with our IT and Security engineers to improve how we manage identities, application access, and devices. This is a hands-on role that combines technical configuration, security judgment, and automation. We’re looking for someone who uses AI effectively to troubleshoot, build, and improve IT workflows. Experience managing IT systems as code using Terraform is a strong plus.

This role requires in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday from one of our offices (SF, NY, or ATX). For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Configure and improve Okta, including application integrations, single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), groups, access policies, and automated provisioning.
* Build reliable onboarding, role-change, and offboarding workflows that keep employee access appropriate and up to date.
* Configure and maintain MDM solutions, including device enrollment, configuration profiles, software deployment, patching, encryption, and compliance controls.
* Partner with Security to define and implement least-privilege access, device security standards, access reviews, and device-based access policies.
* Design and maintain scripts, API integrations, and automation across Okta, MDM, Google Workspace, Slack, and IT service management systems.
* Help expand management of IT systems through code, including opportunities to use Terraform for Okta configuration and other supported resources.
* Use AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, and workflow improvements while validating outputs and protecting company data.
* Serve as an escalation point for complex identity, device, and systems issues; address root causes and prevent recurring problems.
* Support AWS identity and access configurations as part of the broader IT environment.
* Maintain clear documentation for configurations, access policies, integrations, and operational procedures.
* Identify opportunities to simplify the IT environment, reduce technical debt, and improve SaaS lifecycle processes.

**About You**
-------------

* Strong hands-on IT systems engineering experience, with deep expertise in either IAM or MDM and solid working knowledge of the other.
* Experience administering Okta and integrating applications using technologies such as SAML, OIDC, and SCIM.
* Experience configuring and operating an MDM platform such as Jamf, Kandji/Iru, Intune, or an equivalent.
* Strong understanding of security principles, including least privilege, authentication and authorization, endpoint hardening, and secure handling of credentials and company data.
* Proficiency with scripting languages such as Python or Bash, APIs, and workflow automation tools.
* Demonstrated experience using AI to solve technical problems and improve IT operations, with the judgment to review generated code and validate proposed changes.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to follow problems across identity, devices, applications, and integrations.
* Comfortable sharing ownership, collaborating with Security and other teams, and explaining technical decisions clearly.
* Able to take projects from identifying a problem through implementation, documentation, and ongoing maintenance.

**A Strong Plus**
-----------------

* Experience using Terraform to manage Okta or other IT systems as code, including version-controlled configurations, code review, repeatable deployments, and configuration drift management.

**Success in This Role Looks Like**
-----------------------------------

* More reliable identity lifecycle workflows, with timely provisioning, access changes, and deprovisioning.
* Better device enrollment, patching, and compliance through consistent MDM configurations and automation.
* Clearer access policies and repeatable access reviews developed in partnership with Security.
* Less manual work through maintainable automation and effective use of AI.
* More consistent, reviewable system configurations through expanded use of code where appropriate.
* Fewer recurring identity and device issues through root-cause fixes.
* Reliable documentation that helps the team operate, troubleshoot, and improve shared systems.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive salary and meaningful equity
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
* Generous paid time off and parental leave
* Professional development stipend
* Daily lunch and commuter benefits (SF office)

**Compensation & Benefits:**
----------------------------

* Competitive compensation package, including equity.
* Inclusive Healthcare Package.
* Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
* Flexible Time Off.
* We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $180,000.00 - $288,000.00. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based c

jobs.title: Vision Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our Edge team building the software platform behind these products. You will design, build, and operate the distributed edge-to-cloud pipeline that runs on IoT devices on the production floor, ingesting high-rate sensor and controller data and reliably forwarding it to the cloud over intermittent connectivity.

This is a hands-on backend-focused role spanning containerized .NET services, relational and document data stores, pub/sub messaging, and industrial protocol integration. You will own features end-to-end and collaborate closely with Controls, HMI, Manufacturing, and Field Support to ship reliable, production-grade systems to our customers.

**Key Job Responsibilities**

* Design and implement backend services in C# on modern .NET / ASP.NET Core for the edge platform - REST APIs, background workers, message handlers, telemetry aggregators, and long-running device services.
* Own the data pipeline from device ingest to cloud archive: schema design, repository / data-access layer, database migrations, partitioning and retention strategy, and durable store-and-forward upload to cloud object storage.
* Build and maintain containerized services and their deployment manifests, configuration, and orchestration.
* Integrate with industrial controllers over standard fieldbus and industrial communication protocols - designing message contracts, register maps, warning/error codes, and controls-side handshakes for coordinated operation.
* Deliver features end-to-end, from work-item breakdown through implementation, unit and integration tests, CI, code review, deployment, and field validation on live equipment.
* Contribute to architecture: write and review architecture docs, evaluate new patterns, and drive refactors that keep the codebase maintainable as the team and product line grow.
* Mentor and collaborate: raise the bar in code review, pair with junior engineers, and coordinate with Controls, HMI, DevOps, and Field Support to ship releases. Mentor junior software developers and provide guidance on best practices and advanced analytical techniques.
* Communicate complex data insights and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders effectively.

**Key Competencies & Skills**

**Required**

* Strong professional experience with C# and modern .NET building ASP.NET Core REST APIs, hosted / background services, and worker services.
* Solid database engineering skills: relational schema design, indexing, migrations, and query tuning. Comfort writing and reviewing raw SQL is expected.
* Practical experience with containerization
* Comfort with Linux as a deployment target (systemd services, log management, networking, device troubleshooting) and shell scripting.
* Proficiency with Git, pull-request workflows, and CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, or similar), including running unit and integration tests in the pipeline.
* Strong grounding in software engineering fundamentals: automated testing, code review, refactoring, API design, and writing clear technical documentation.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, data analysis, and test automation (pytest); ability to move fluently between C# and Python codebases.
* Experience integrating with industrial control systems via standard fieldbus or SCADA protocols (e.g., EtherCAT, MODBUS, OPC UA, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP), or otherwise interoperating with PLCs.
* Azure cloud services: Blob Storage, IoT Hub, Container Registry, Managed Identity, and Azure DevOps. Equivalent experience on AWS or GCP is also welcome.
* Experience with Kubernetes for orchestrating containerized workloads, including deployments, services, and Helm charts; lightweight distributions such as K3s or MicroK8s at the edge are a plus.
* Experience building IoT device software - long-lived services on embedded / ARM64 hardware, remote deployment, module or fleet management, and safe over-the-air updates.
* Familiarity with columnar / analytics formats such as Parquet and downstream analytics engines (Fabric, Synapse, Databricks, DuckDB).
* Familiarity with visualization / dashboard tools (Grafana or similar) and time-series data modeling.

**Education and Experience Requirements**

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience shipping production systems.
* Demonstrated experience delivering distributed backend systems in production, ideally at the edge or in an IoT / industrial context, with responsibility for reliability, observability, and on-call or field-support obligations.
* Track record of cross-functional collaboration with hardware, controls, or research teams, and of translating ambiguous product requirements into well-scoped, testable engineering work.

**Working Conditions**

Work is performed inside a flex space building consisting of offices, open desk space, laboratory, machine shop, and a manufacturing floor. Level of noise is usually quiet in the office environment and temperature controlled. Noise levels are elevated in the warehouse space where temperatures can vary depending on the outside elements and weather. Travel may be required, including up to 2-8 trips per year to visit suppliers, attend conferences, meetings (customer, investor, and business) and customer sites (hatcheries).

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Since 1892, OPW customers have been able to count on us to revolutionize fluid-handling operations around the world. As a global leader in fluid-handling solutions, the mission of OPW is to be a developer of a comprehensive array of innovative fluid-handling solutions that our customers can consistently and reliably count on. These include loading and unloading systems for high-value hazardous and non-hazardous bulk products; railcar and transport tank-truck valves, gauging devices and tank-monitoring systems; automated storage-terminal controls and systems; and regulators, fittings, valves, vaporizers, vacuum-jacketed piping and gas-handling systems for the safe handling and distribution of cryogenics and industrial gases. OPW has more than 2,000 employees with manufacturing operations in North America, Europe and China, and sales offices around the world. OPW is part of the Clean Energy & Fueling segment of Dover (NYSE: DOV).

  

The Automation Engineer will be responsible for the design, programming, integration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of automated assembly and testing equipment, including PLC-controlled machinery, robotic work cells, and associated controls hardware. This role will work cross-functionally with manufacturing engineering, maintenance, quality, and production teams to bring automated systems from concept through commissioning (both in-house and vendor) and provide ongoing production support. We are looking for individuals who have knowledge or experience in assembly/testing and automation processes, a keen eye for safety and quality, the ability to solve problems and troubleshoot, and the desire to develop and expand their skills in a production-driven environment. The Automation Engineer will report to the PES Value Stream Manager.

* Develop HMI screens and operator interfaces for machine control and diagnostics
* Design and implement vision system integration (Keyence or similar) for part inspection, guidance, and quality verification

Collaborate with mechanical and electrical design engineers during the concept and design phases to ensure controls feasibility

Ensure vendor equipment meets safety, quality, and performance requirements prior to acceptance and handoff to production  

  

**Troubleshooting & Continuous Improvement**

* Provide technical support for installed equipment, including root cause analysis and corrective action for downtime events

* Support preventive maintenance programs and develop troubleshooting documentation for maintenance and production staff
* Analyze production data and machine performance to identify optimization opportunities
Integrate mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and controls subsystems into functioning automated work cells  

**Documentation & Compliance**

* Create and maintain electrical schematics, I/O lists, controls architecture diagrams, and program documentation that complies with all applicable safety standards
* Participate in risk assessments and safety validation for automated equipment
Maintain version control and backups of PLC, HMI, and robot programs  

  
  

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Mechatronics, Controls Engineering, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience programming and troubleshooting PLCs in an industrial/manufacturing environment
* Hands-on experience programming industrial robots and integrating them into automated systems
* Working knowledge of electrical schematics, ladder logic, structured text, and function block programming
* Understanding of pneumatics, sensors (photo eyes, proximity, encoders), servo/motion control, and machine safety circuits
* Experience with HMI development platforms
* Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose mechanical, electrical, and software issues under time pressure
* Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, and P&IDs
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite  

  

**The Ideal Candidate Will Also Bring**

* Experience with FANUC and Universal Robots programming/certification
* Familiarity with machine vision systems (Keyence or similar)

* Experience with Autodesk Inventor, SolidWorks, or similar 3D CAD software for reviewing mechanical designs
* Prior experience in high-volume assembly and testing automation, packaging automation, or similar

**Projected Hiring Range:** $92,558.61- $120,326.20 DOE

**Closing Date:** **Open Until Filled**

**Primary Purpose of Position:**

The RHTP Systems Cloud Platform Engineer will be responsible for the design, provisioning, configuration, operation, security, monitoring, and ongoing support of cloud infrastructure supporting the North Carolina Rural Health Transformation Program (RHTP) Region 3 environment.

The position will primarily support Microsoft Azure and related cloud platforms, including infrastructure supporting Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, application integration, data services, identity, networking, monitoring, security, and business continuity/disaster recovery.

The engineer will work closely with enterprise architecture, information security, application development, data and analytics teams, Microsoft, IBM, and other technology partners to ensure RHTP solutions are secure, scalable, supportable, and aligned with Vaya Partners technology standards.

A key responsibility of this position will be participating in the implementation of the RHTP technology platform and knowledge transfer from implementation partners to Vaya Partners, establishing the internal technical capabilities necessary to operate and support the environment after implementation.

The position will ensure RHTP cloud infrastructure, configurations, documentation, operational procedures, and change-management practices comply with organizational security, privacy, data-governance, and technology standards.

**Note:** This position requires access to and use of confidential healthcare information or protected health information (PHI) as described in laws addressing patient confidentiality, including, but not limited to, the federal HIPAA law, the Confidentiality of Alcohol and Substance Abuse Patient Records law, 42 CFR Part 2, and various state laws. As such, the individual filling this position shall be required to be trained regarding such laws and shall be required to observe those laws in his/her capacity as an employee of Vaya Partners. The individual filling this position shall also sign a confidentiality statement as an employee of Vaya Partners.

**Role and Responsibilities:**

**Cloud Platform Operations & Support 40****%**

* Provision, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Microsoft Azure infrastructure supporting the RHTP environment.
* Support Azure subscriptions, resource groups, networking, private endpoints, DNS, storage, Key Vault, monitoring, logging, application hosting, integration services, and other RHTP cloud resources.
* Support infrastructure dependencies for Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, Azure DevOps, application services, and data integration workloads.
* Monitor platform health, availability, performance, capacity, security, and cost and proactively identify operational issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve Tier 3 incidents involving RHTP cloud infrastructure and platform services.
* Coordinate and execute approved maintenance and production changes.
* Participate in incident response, problem management, disaster recovery, and business continuity activities.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure configurations, operational documentation, diagrams, inventories, and support procedures.

**Cloud Engineering, Security & Governance — 30%**

* Design and implement secure, scalable, highly available Azure infrastructure in collaboration with Enterprise
* Architecture, Information Security, development, and data teams.
* Implement organizational standards for Azure landing zones, resource naming, tagging, Azure Policy, RBAC, privileged access, network segmentation, logging, monitoring, and cost management.
* Implement and maintain secure connectivity between Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, external systems, and approved partner environments.
* Support Microsoft Entra ID integration, managed identities, workload identities, service principals, certificates, secrets, and privileged-access controls.
* Implement infrastructure-as-code and automated deployment practices where appropriate.  
  Support CI/CD and Azure DevOps infrastructure and deployment processes.
* Implement monitoring and security telemetry using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Microsoft Defender and related enterprise security platforms.
* Participate in architecture, security, vulnerability, configuration, and operational-readiness reviews.
* Support backup, recovery, resiliency, and disaster-recovery capabilities based on approved RTO/RPO requirements.
* Assist with cloud capacity planning, consumption monitoring, optimization, reservations, and cost forecasting.

* Effectively manage time and priorities.
* Participate directly with implementation partners during the design and implementation of the RHTP technology platform.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer - Industrial Controls
jobs.description:
Location Charlotte, North Carolina, 28273 Category Engineering JR105329 FCX 9290 FCX Performance, Inc. Regular Job Type Full time

  

**System Engineer – Industrial Controls**

**Position Overview**

FCX Performance, an Applied Industrial Technologies Company, is seeking a hands-on, mid-to-senior level **System Engineer** to deliver industrial and commercial control systems services to local customers. This is a field-heavy engineering role requiring physical site visits, tool utilization, and direct interaction with industrial machinery.

**Essential Functions & Responsibilities**

* **Field Engineering & Support:** Provide local industrial/commercial control systems engineering service for customers relating to SCADA Systems, PLC Programming, CAD Drawings, Industrial Networking, and Systems Calibration.
* **Technician Interfacing:** Support instrument technicians in the field with issues related to interfacing field devices to DCS & SCADA systems, special needs testing, and technical support.
* **Project & Contract Management:** Partner with fellow engineers to resolve project backlogs while maintaining excellent relationships with contract customers.
* **On-Site Upgrades:** Identify opportunities for system and hardware upgrades at customer facilities.
* **Documentation & Safety:** Report job activity and maintain detailed logs about service calls, parts, and orders. Fully comprehend and communicate safety protocols on active job sites.
* **Travel:** Safely operate a company vehicle to travel to and from local job sites daily.

**Required Education & Experience**

* **Experience:** **Minimum 5+ years of direct, hands-on industry experience** programming PLCs (Allen Bradley, Automation Direct, MOSCAD, etc.) and working with process/flow control systems.
* **HMI Proficiency:** 5+ years of experience with computer-based HMI software (Wonderware, VTSCADA, Lookout, etc.).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering (BSEE/BSEET), or an Associate Degree (ASEE) paired with extensive, verifiable field experience. *(Note: Advanced theoretical degrees like an MSEE are not required; this is a practical field engineering role).*
* **Driving Record:** Must possess a valid US driver's license with a clean driving record.
* **Work Authorization:** Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Sponsorship will not be provided for this position

**Technical & Mental Requirements**

* Strong background in electrical/electronic engineering, process instrumentation, and process engineering.
* High energy, technically competent, resourceful, with extreme attention to detail.
* **Programming & CAD:** Strong skills in PLCs, Microsoft Visual Basic (or basic programming software) and AutoCAD/AutoCAD Electrical.
* **Industrial Networking:** Solid understanding of networks, network structures, radio-based communications, and industrial protocols.
* **Controls Mastery:** Deep understanding of industrial controls, process controls (including PID Loops and pump control), industrial instrument calibrations, and repairs.
* **Electrical Knowledge:** Advanced understanding of analog current loops (4-20mAdc, 1-5Vdc, etc.), their PLC counterparts in numeric counts, and strict adherence to the National Electrical Code (NEC).
* **Tool Proficiency:** Competency with required physical equipment, including hand tools, volt-ohm meters, power tools, and instrument loops.
* **Growth Mindset:** While 5+ years of core experience is required, you will receive ongoing On-the-Job Training (OJT) for company-specific workflows. A willingness to learn daily and teach others is required.
* **Autonomy:** Must be highly self-motivated, self-driven, and able to manage daily schedules.

**Physical & Environmental Requirements**

* **Physical Strength:** Must be able to lift objects weighing up to 50 lbs regularly.
* **Mobility:** Must be able to stand, kneel, walk for long periods, and climb ladders or stairs.
* **Availability:** Available for occasional emergency call-ins and overnight travel to various customer sites based on business needs.
* **Environment:** Duties are performed indoors and outdoors with direct exposure to weather elements, heavy equipment, earth excavation, power tools, clean rooms, dirt, and noise.
* **National Travel:** Ability to travel nationally when required (infrequent).

Founded in 1923, Applied Industrial Technologies (NYSE: AIT) is a leading value-added distributor and technical solutions provider of industrial motion, fluid power, flow control, automation technologies, and related maintenance supplies. Our leading brands, specialized services, and comprehensive knowledge serve MRO and OEM end users in virtually all industrial markets through our multi-channel capabilities that provide choice, convenience, and expertise.

**Applied Industrial Technologies is built on a philosophy that puts people first. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to a workforce in which we enforce fair treatment and provide growth opportunities for everyone. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.**

**Description**

Duties:
  
Under limited supervision, analyze, develop and/or significantly modify software, applications, and programs from general requirements and specifications. Develop, code/modify, test, debug, maintain, and enhance existing programs.
  
Analyze complex technical problems and provide solutions.
  
Develop component design and develop and/or modify effective, defect free source code that meets business requirements and team standards.
  
Participate in unit test case development and develop complex test scripts.
  
Execute all levels of testing (System, Integration, and Regression).
  
Work from specifications to develop or modify highly complex software programming applications.
  
Identify and recommend appropriate continuous improvement opportunities and contribute technical alternatives. May mentor junior team members.

Telecommuting permitted up to 60%.

Employer will accept a Master’s degree (or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Industrial and Systems Engineering or related field and three (3) years of experience in the job offered or in a Sr Software Engineer-related occupation.

Category: Engineering

widget: Full-Time

Other

### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

If you want to work on cutting-edge DoD programs, Serco has a great opportunity for you! As a SME Software Engineer, you will be supporting the Special Programs Division (AFLCMC/WAG) at Wright Patterson AFB, OH.

**This position is contingent upon the ability to maintain/transfer active Department of War (DoW) Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI.**

The Fighters and Advanced Aircraft Directorate, Special Programs Division develops, tests, and rapidly fields classified USAF aeronautical capabilities. AFLCMC/WAG conducts studies to identify new capabilities; transitions laboratory technologies to operational platforms; executes demonstrations; and develops, tests, rapidly fields, sustains, and demilitarizes capabilities for the warfighter.

In this role, you will:

* Oversee software engineering architecture of prime DoD contractors that are implementing Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) for a software pipeline in the acquisition, development, and sustainment of prototypes, aircraft, subsystems, and/or support equipment

* Using DevSecOps, evaluate prime contractor proposed software design changes and solutions for aircraft/test equipment, perform systems analyses and technological/trade-off study assessments

* Assess the interfaces and interaction of a computer system’s software, firmware, and hardware

* Actively participate in software-centric technical reviews and transitioning efforts from traditional methodologies to CI/CD

* Using MBSE, translate operational user requirements into contract system requirements documents to improve traceability
* Analyze software performance deficiencies; make recommendations for corrective action

* Audit DoD contractors for software configuration and control measures and verify appropriate quality accreditation

* Review the system design software architecture and interoperability requirements

* Evaluate system software test plans and participate in the conduct of system, subsystem, and component testing; review and analyze test data; make recommendations

* Support development and review of program and contract technical documentation
* Provide technical and programmatic feedback, develop and present technical briefings, and develop engineering strategies/analyses
* Conduct technical evaluations of contractor proposals
* Interface with weapons system contractors, vendors, and Government representatives on software engineering activities; independently apply software and engineering principles to investigate, analyze, plan, oversee, and evaluate weapons system development and sustainment
* Assess AFRL technology initiatives to guide investments and shape transition strategies
* Assess contractor product capabilities in achieving system design requirements and specifications
* Perform technical risk assessments and develop mitigation plans
* Develop request for proposal (RFP) technical documents and conduct technical evaluations of contractor proposals to include software design feasibility and system compatibility

  

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* An active TOP-SECRET security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and access to Special Access Programs (SAP) and have a background investigation current within the past 5 years or under Continuous Vetting
* Masters Degree in an Engineering discipline with a minimum of 20 years relevant experience with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Minimum 3 years of SAP or SCI experience within the last 5 years
* Ability to travel up to 10% (CONUS)

  

Additional desired experience and skills:

* Bachelor’s or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering
* In-depth knowledge of DoD acquisition software engineering support to include software architecture, design, integration, configuration, test/evaluation, and certification
* Current knowledge of software development methodology and tools to include Agile and CI/CD
* Experienced with real-time operating systems, software languages, computer hardware platforms
* Experience in integrating DevSecOps, MBSE, and DoD cybersecurity considerations into software architectures
* In-depth knowledge of DoD acquisition engineering and test support

If you are interested in supporting and working with our Air Force and airmen and a dedicated Serco team, then submit your application now for immediate consideration. It only takes a few minutes!

  
  

### **Company Overview**

  
  

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our clients deliver vital services more efficiently while increasing the satisfaction of their end customers. Serco serves every branch of the U.S. military, numerous U.S. Federal civilian agencies, the Intelligence Community, the Canadian government, state, provincial and local governments, and commercial clients. While your place may look a little different depending on your role, we know you will find yours here. Wherever you work and whatever you do, we invite you to discover your place in our world. Serco is a place you can count on and where you can make an impact because every contribution matters.
  
  
To review Serco benefits please visit: https://careers.serco-na.com/us/en/what-we-offer. If you require an accommodation with the application process please email: careers@serco-na.com or call the HR Service Desk at 800-628-6458, option 1. jobs.title: Lead Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
We're ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.

As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.

When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you'll collaborate on some of the world's toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.

  

As a **Lead Electrical Engineer** you will be responsible for;

* Leading the design, development, testing, and support of advanced RF-based electronic systems for medical imaging applications.
* Designing and analyzing analog and RF circuitry, including high-frequency electronics and signal transmission systems.
* Utilizing simulation, modeling, and CAD tools to develop and optimize electrical designs.
* Performing system integration activities to ensure compatibility and performance across complex electromechanical systems.
* Conducting validation, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective action investigations for field and production issues.
* Collaborating with mechanical, systems, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Supporting compliance with applicable safety, performance, and regulatory standards.
* Leading technical reviews, driving engineering decisions, and mentoring junior engineers.
* Identifying opportunities for innovation, product enhancement, and continuous improvement.
* Managing multiple engineering initiatives while ensuring quality, schedule, and technical objectives are achieved.

**Qualifications;**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in electrical engineering, RF design, medical devices, medical imaging, or other highly regulated industries.
* Strong knowledge of analog and RF circuit design principles.
* Experience with electrical design, simulation, and modeling tools.
* Understanding of electromagnetic theory, transmission lines, antennas, amplifiers, oscillators, and related RF technologies.
* Experience with printed circuit board design, testing, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of engineering product development processes and design verification practices.
* Ability to perform root cause analysis and drive effective corrective actions.
* Strong communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience within medical devices, healthcare technology, or regulated product development environments preferred.
* Knowledge of IEC standards, reliability engineering, Lean methodologies, or continuous improvement practices preferred.

  

**Location: Onsite in Aurora, OH**

**Salary Range: $80,000 0 $120,000**

The actual salary offered is dependent on various factors including, but not limited to, location, the candidate's combination of job-related knowledge, qualifications, skills, education, training, and experience

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.

***Please beware of job seeker scams and see this*** ***important notice*** ***on our careers page for more information about our recruiting process.***

**Compliance Notice:** Alten USA is a federal contractor subject to the requirements of the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA) and Executive Order 11246. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

**Drug Screening Requirement:** As a federal contractor, Alten USA maintains a drug-free workplace. All candidates selected for employment will be required to successfully complete a pre-employment drug screening as a condition of hire.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer II - Instrumentation
jobs.description:
The ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance & Reconnaissance), Aviation, and Security (IAS) business area is a leader in ISR and aviation, it is a leading prime manned and unmanned aircraft systems integrator for innovative, high-performance ISR and aviation systems. Its end-to-end Command, Control, Computers, Communications and Intelligence, Surveillance & Reconnaissance (C4ISR) capabilities encompass design, integration, test, certification, ground/flight training and complete logistics support. IAS tailors solutions to customer cost, performance, and schedule requirements and designs to consistently exceed expectations – with an unrivaled record of on time and on (or under) budget deliveries.

SNC has led thoughtful and disruptive change in the aerospace and defense industry for the past 60 years and now, we’re applying this tenacity and expertise to the U.S. Air Force’s (USAF) Survivable Airborne Operations Center (SAOC) mission. Join the SNC-led SAOC team and be a part of exciting and meaningful work to modernize and deliver the next-generation SAOC aircraft trusted by the President, Secretary of Defense and Chairs of the Joint Chiefs of Staff to ensure continued critical command, control and communication during national emergencies. If you’re passionate about building the airborne command post of the future, consider SNC for your next mission. Learn more about NC3 and SAOC here .

Are you ready to unleash your technical creativity? Dream, Innovate, Inspire and Empower the next generation to transform humanity through technology and imagination! As an Electrical Engineer II, you will play a key role in the design, development, and testing of electrical/electronic systems for aerospace and defense applications. You will be responsible for designing and integrating electrical/electronic systems, validating electrical/electronic systems, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products.

**Responsibilities:**

* Contribute to the instrumentation effort from design to de-modification through requirements development, design, lab test, integration, and test operations support
* Plan, participate, and execute test plan development to ensure objective results are of sound quality
* Responsible for developing, modifying, and implementing standard operating procedures for instrumentation hardware and system design
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical, systems, and test engineers to ensure seamless integration of instrumentation systems.

Maintain, document, and control NIST standards for calibration and verification of measurement equipment.  

  
  

**Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
* 2+ years of experience in electrical engineering or a related role.
* Higher level relevant degree may substitute for experience.
* Proficiency in electrical/electronic circuit design and testing techniques.
* Knowledge of engineering principles and practices.
* Experience with Computer Aided Engineering tools.
Familiarity with working in multi-disciplinary design and development teams.  

  
  

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
* Experience with Computer-Aided Design (CAD) software for electrical applications.
* Understanding of aerospace and defense industry standards.
* Exposure to simulations through functional and logical models and system analysis.
* Exposure to FAA electrical system regulations, including Electrical Wiring Interconnection System (EWIS) requirements.
* Exposure to electrical/electronic Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and System Safety Assessment (SSA) concepts.
* Understanding of an Electrical Load Analysis (ELA).
* Experience with circuit modeling, simulation, and analysis.
* Knowledge of electrical component selection and manufacturing.
* Understanding Electromagnetic Effects (EME) to include Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) and Electromagnetic Interference (EMI).
* Experience in digital or analog circuit design and schematic capture.
* Understanding of the printed circuit board layout process and tools.
* Background in the Aerospace and Defense Industry
* Experience with extensive ground and flight test programs
* Familiar with Ethernet, 1553, ARINC 429, and CAN bus protocol
Familiar with Curtiss Wright and/or similar data acquisition systems  

  

**Essential Functions:**

* Ability to work on a computer for extended periods.
* Ability to travel as required.
* Ability to work in an office or hybrid environment.
* Precision in designing, testing and troubleshooting electrical/electronic systems and components.
* Ability to analyze complex electrical/electronic systems and evaluate performance data to identify problems and improve designs.
* Applying systematic and logical problem-solving techniques to diagnose and resolve electrical/electronic issues.
* Clearly convey technical information, design specifications, and project updates to team members, stakeholders, and management.
* Ability to understand technical documents, electrical/electronic schematics, and electronic instrument measurements.
* Ability to handle small components, tools, and equipment with precision.

This posting will be open for application for a minimum of 5 days and may be extended based on business needs.

If you want to work on cutting-edge DoD programs, Serco has a great opportunity for you! As a SME Systems Engineer specializing in aircraft sub-system integration, airworthiness, and electronic warfare, you will be supporting the Special Programs Division (AFLCMC/WAG) at Wright Patterson AFB, OH.

**This position is contingent upon the ability to maintain/transfer active Department of War (DoW) Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI.**

The Fighters and Advanced Aircraft Directorate, Special Programs Division develops, tests, and rapidly fields classified USAF aeronautical capabilities. AFLCMC/WAG conducts studies to identify new capabilities; transitions laboratory technologies to operational platforms; executes demonstrations; and develops, tests, rapidly fields, sustains, and demilitarizes capabilities for the warfighter.

In this role, you will:

* Translate operational user requirements into contract system requirements documents.
* Apply systems engineering expertise for modification improvements, hardware/software development, configuration management, data rights, and quality assurance.
* Provide technical and programmatic feedback, develop and present technical briefings, and develop engineering strategies/analyses and technical program documents.
* Interface with weapons system contractors, vendors, and Government representatives on engineering activities; independently apply engineering principles to investigate, analyze, plan, oversee, and evaluate weapons system development and sustainment.

* Implement aircraft airworthiness, risk management, and obsolescence tracking processes.
* Evaluate Contractor proposed design changes and solutions, perform systems analyses and technological/trade-off study assessments, and oversee the correction of deficiencies.
* Support all phases of subsystem component and system-level integration and testing: develop and review test plans/procedures, test activities oversight, and test result analysis.
* Assess contractor product capabilities in achieving system design requirements and specifications
* Perform technical risk assessments and develop mitigation plans.
* Develop request for proposal (RFP) technical documents and conduct technical evaluations of contractor proposals to include design feasibility and system compatibility.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* An active TOP-SECRET security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and access to Special Access Programs (SAP) and have a background investigation current within the past 5 years or under Continuous Vetting

* In-depth knowledge of DoD acquisition engineering and test support
