jobs.title: Critical Infrastructure Electrical Engineer, Field Engineering
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will provide full life-cycle support to AWS Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource for your region when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams to:  
  

* Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.

  

* Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.

  

* Own the conceptual design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, increase efficiency and sustainability.

  

* Interface with internal data center operations team, data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.

  

* Develop innovative solutions for AWS’s data centers.

  

* Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.

  

* Initiate and lead engineering audits including on-site visits within Amazon’s data centers. Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediations.

  

* Act as resident engineer during new construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and turnover.

  
Key job responsibilities  
Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out our data centers to  
  
meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale. As an ideal candidate you:  
  

* Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty/ambiguity.

  

* Are detail and data oriented.

  

* Have experience solving problems with engineered solutions.

  

* Have experience managing engineering projects and consultants.

  

* Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Controls, Construction, Design, Commissioning, Product Managers, Technical Program Managers, ).

  

* Are adaptable and inclined to get into the field to see things up close.

  

* Excited about a mix of office and field work.

  
A day in the life  
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.  
  
About the team  
Why AWS  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
* Valid and active driver's license

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of electrical systems in critical Data Center operations that include but are not limited to utility substation feeds, transformers, switchgear, VFI Class UPS, DRUPS, PDUs, ATS, STS, SLA/VRLA batteries and associated systems, diesel/gas turbine generators and related fuel systems, Surge Suppression, Active Harmonic Filteri

If you want to work on cutting-edge DoD programs, Serco has a great opportunity for you! **This position is contingent upon the ability to maintain/transfer active Department of War (DoW) Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI.**

WAG-AT conducts studies to identify new capabilities; matures laboratory technologies to be weapon system ready; and develops, tests, and rapidly fields new AT capabilities/products all which provide insight and foundational AT technology to seed DoD weapon system development programs. These are focused on reducing developmental risk and associated cost and schedule growth, ultimately ensuring AT architectures are developed, supporting protection of US warfighters against loss of life caused by technological exploitation of US weapons systems.

* Apply DoD systems engineering process, policy, and procedures in the acquisition, manufacturing, fielding, and sustainment, modernization and disposal of new, existing and future weapons systems and capabilities, with specific experience in weapon system Program Protection planning and anti-tamper methods
* Assess integrated circuitry, industry standard processors, and memory chips and determine methodologies for reverse engineering electronic systems and integrated circuitry
* Provide engineering support for technology and product acquisitions to include long-term planning, request for proposal (RFP) development, and technical oversight of ongoing projects
* Review and analyze proposals for design feasibility and system compatibility
* Assess acquired capabilities in achieving system design requirements and specifications
* For program protection, identify technologies and evaluate system/subsystem design functions and improvements to protect Critical Program Information (CPI)
* Develop plans to assess security features of Government Off-The-Shelf (GOTS) and Commercial Off-The Shelf (COTS) components for CPI susceptibility/vulnerability to exploitation and reverse engineering.
* Work with DoD Anti-Tamper Evaluation Teams to understand current designs and identify vulnerabilities to foreign and adversary exploitation
* Assist efforts to improve US weapons system anti-tamper/anti-exploitation design, development, manufacturing, training, and sustainment
* Evaluate system test plans and participate in conduct of system, subsystem, & component testing
* Conduct engineering performance, supportability, schedule, and risk assessments and scheduling trade off studies

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* An active TOP-SECRET security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and access to Special Access Programs (SAP) and have a background investigation current within the past 5 years or under Continuous Vetting
* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering with a minimum of 12 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Masters Degree in a relevant engineering discipline with a minimum of 10 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Minimum 3 years of SAP or SCI experience within the last 8 years
* Ability to travel up to 10% (CONUS)

Additional desired experience and skills:

* Experience with Program Protection planning and implementation in weapon system programs
* Experience evaluating current fielded weapons systems to determine anti-tamper and reverse engineering susceptibility based on vendor design
* Experience working with industry to assess tamper resistance of current weapons systems within the acquisition development cycle
* Experience working within the electronic exploitation lab environment to evaluate current and new processors, memory units, and electronic circuits to exploit weaknesses, identify improvements to design, and develop new standards to deter technological exploitation

### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

If you want to work on cutting-edge DoD programs, Serco has a great opportunity for you! As a Senior Anti-Tamper Engineer specializing in systems engineering, you will be supporting the Special Programs Division, DoD Anti-Tamper (AT) Executive Agent Field Program Office (FPO) (AFLCMC/WAG-AT) at Wright Patterson AFB, OH.

**This position is contingent upon the ability to maintain/transfer active Department of War (DoW) Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI.**

WAG-AT conducts studies to identify new capabilities; matures laboratory technologies to be weapon system ready; and develops, tests, and rapidly fields new AT capabilities/products all which provide insight and foundational AT technology to seed DoD weapon system development programs. These are focused on reducing developmental risk and associated cost and schedule growth, ultimately ensuring AT architectures are developed, supporting protection of US warfighters against loss of life caused by technological exploitation of US weapons systems.

* Apply DoD systems engineering process, policy, and procedures in the acquisition, manufacturing, fielding, and sustainment, modernization and disposal of new, existing and future weapons systems and capabilities, with specific experience in weapon system Program Protection planning and anti-tamper methods
* Assess integrated circuitry, industry standard processors, and memory chips and determine methodologies for reverse engineering electronic systems and integrated circuitry
* Provide engineering support for technology and product acquisitions to include long-term planning, request for proposal (RFP) development, and technical oversight of ongoing projects
* Review and analyze proposals for design feasibility and system compatibility
* Assess acquired capabilities in achieving system design requirements and specifications
* For program protection, identify technologies and evaluate system/subsystem design functions and improvements to protect Critical Program Information (CPI)
* Develop plans to assess security features of Government Off-The-Shelf (GOTS) and Commercial Off-The Shelf (COTS) components for CPI susceptibility/vulnerability to exploitation and reverse engineering.
* Work with DoD Anti-Tamper Evaluation Teams to understand current designs and identify vulnerabilities to foreign and adversary exploitation
* Assist efforts to improve US weapons system anti-tamper/anti-exploitation design, development, manufacturing, training, and sustainment
* Evaluate system test plans and participate in conduct of system, subsystem, & component testing
* Conduct engineering performance, supportability, schedule, and risk assessments and scheduling trade off studies

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* An active TOP-SECRET security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and access to Special Access Programs (SAP) and have a background investigation current within the past 5 years or under Continuous Vetting
* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering with a minimum of 12 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Masters Degree in a relevant engineering discipline with a minimum of 10 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Minimum 3 years of SAP or SCI experience within the last 8 years
* Ability to travel up to 10% (CONUS)

Additional desired experience and skills:

* Experience with Program Protection planning and implementation in weapon system programs
* Experience evaluating current fielded weapons systems to determine anti-tamper and reverse engineering susceptibility based on vendor design
* Experience working with industry to assess tamper resistance of current weapons systems within the acquisition development cycle
* Experience working within the electronic exploitation lab environment to evaluate current and new processors, memory units, and electronic circuits to exploit weaknesses, identify improvements to design, and develop new standards to deter technological exploitation

**The Boeing Company** has an exciting opportunity for an **Associate Software Engineer** to support the Guidance Repair Center in **Heath, OH.**

  
  

This engineering position will be responsible for the design, development, test, and sustainment of electrical, electronic, and electro-mechanical products and test equipment/software in support of the U.S. Strategic Deterrence Systems (U.S. Air Force Intercontinental Ballistic Missile, U.S. Air Force & U.S. Navy Guidance Systems and other military programs). In addition, this role will review test data, direct repairs, develop process improvements, capture process changes, and solve problems with new workloads and part obsolescence.

* Works in small agile teams composed of diverse engineering skills

jobs.description:
This job is available in 2 locations

See all

Category Engineering JR104037 9032 SG Morris Co, LLC 9032 S.G. Morris Co., LLC Regular Job Type Full time

  

S.G. Morris Co., a subsidiary of Applied Industrial Technologies (NYSE: AIT), the world’s largest fluid power distributor, is looking for an Controls Engineer who will assist our sales force with technical expertise for the design of fluid power systems and customer system integrations. This includes preparing schematics, test procedures and recommend components. You will provide integral project management for these systems.

**Essential Functions:**

* Ability to work with AutoCAD LT for wiring diagrams and panel layouts.
* Fundamental understanding of UL, CE, CSA and NEC. Ability to read and understand these and other standards.
* Develop control scheme estimate quotes based on customer/salesmen descriptions of potential job requirements.
* Select electrical components appropriate for applications (mobile, industrial, environmental, etc.)
* Develop full electrical project schematics and component BOM to meet application requirements.
* Develop panel layouts. Must understand layout flow for power and logic wiring isolation.
* Program PLC’s and HMI’s using RSLogix 500 and Studio 5000.
* Program HMI’s using C\_More programming software.
* Work with shop to insure wiring is in accordance with project requirements.
* Understanding of mobile controls and components a plus.
* Troubleshoot electrical issues via phone, e-mail and in person on site at customer facilities.
* Deal with requests from multiple salesmen at one time.

**Additional Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate projects with branch personnel, including sales and shop associates.
* Travel to customer locations occasionally required.
* Mechanical hands-on assistance may be required on occasion.

**Requirements:**

* Degree in engineering, Electrical preferred
* Working knowledge of CAD
* Ability to read / understand technical drawings.
* Fluid Power Industry experience is a plus

**Desired characteristics:**

* Work independently and as part of a team.
* Listening, negotiating, and effective problem solving skills.
* Ability and desire to quickly learn new processes and systems.
* Organization skills, detailed oriented and written communication skills.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Bluetooth
jobs.description:
Description:

Enovation Controls is a turnkey technology company that solves complex problems and delivers innovative solutions. People who find their place here tend to stay. Many of our team members have decades of tenure, evidence of a culture where people feel valued and want to build a career. We’re proud to be recognized by Great Place to Work as one of the **Best Workplaces in Manufacturing & Production for seven consecutive years** and recognized for **Top U.S. Benefits by Mployer Advisor.** This recognition comes directly from employee feedback, not marketing, and reflects a workplace where people feel trusted, supported, and empowered. We live our core values every day in a collaborative, high-performance environment that balances complex technical work with real camaraderie, accessible leadership, and traditions that bring teams together.

**Description**

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Software Engineer who brings deep Bluetooth protocol expertise, takes ownership of complex technical problems, and partners across software, architecture, product, and project teams to deliver robust solutions. This is a software-centric role focused on implementing and extending Bluetooth features across Classic (BR/EDR) and Low Energy (BLE) profiles on embedded Linux, while maintaining support for a legacy QNX 6.6 platform.

Our primary Bluetooth stack is BlueZ on Linux, with an application layer built in C# on .NET. You’ll work across C#, C, and C++ and lead new Bluetooth development on Linux while supporting our legacy QNX 6.6 platform using Searan’s HCI stack on the QNX 6.6 armv7-le platform. The role requires the ability to work at the protocol and stack level, troubleshoot complex issues, and, when needed, read and modify the underlying Bluetooth stack.

**What you’ll lead and own**

**Bluetooth Features & Platform Support**

* Design, implement, and maintain Bluetooth profile features across Classic (BR/EDR) and BLE on embedded Linux using BlueZ and GCC ARM.
* Maintain feature parity and support across the legacy QNX 6.6 armv7-le platform using Searan’s HCI stack.
* Troubleshoot and resolve Bluetooth issues at the protocol and stack level, not just at the application layer.

**Software Architecture & Development**

* Design and implement robust, maintainable software components using C# on .NET and C/C++ for lower-level stack integration and legacy platform support.
* Contribute to the design of system modules and partner with Software Architects to develop scalable solutions for the Enovation Control Platform Software.
* Apply and promote Software and Enovation Best Practices to strengthen code quality, maintainability, and development efficiency.

**Roadmap, Delivery & Collaboration**

* Partner with the Bluetooth Team Lead to develop and maintain the Bluetooth feature roadmap across a monthly release cadence using Azure DevOps SCRUM.
* Accurately estimate work, provide technical insight, and collaborate with Project and Product Management to align development efforts with business objectives.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to translate customer needs and technical requirements into reliable software solutions.

**Engineering Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify and advocate for software, development, and tooling improvements that support customer use cases and strategic goals.
* Expand static analysis coverage on the Linux platform to improve code quality and reduce technical risk.
* Mentor Software Engineers through knowledge-sharing, technical guidance, and practical application of engineering best practices.
* Stay current with Bluetooth technologies, software development practices, and industry trends to bring new ideas and capabilities to the team.

Requirements:

**What we’re looking for**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 5+ years of professional software development experience.
* Hands-on experience with an embedded or RTOS-based Bluetooth protocol stack at the HCI, L2CAP, RFCOMM, or profile-implementation level (e.g., BlueZ on Linux, SEARAN dotstack, BlueKitchen BTstack, Zephyr Bluetooth, or equivalent).
* Strong working knowledge of Bluetooth Classic (BR/EDR) profiles, including A2DP, AVRCP, HFP, PBAP, MAP, and SPP, as well as Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE).
* Strong proficiency in C# on .NET as the primary application language, along with C/C++ for stack integration and legacy platform support.
* Experience with embedded Linux development, including Yocto or equivalent, and cross-compilation toolchains such as GCC ARM.
* Experience with Agile/SCRUM development methodologies.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills at the protocol and stack level.

**Preferred**

* Experience working with multiple Bluetooth stacks and applying a cross-platform perspective to resolve stack-level limitations.
* Depth in BlueZ sufficient to read, trace, and modify stack source code directly.
* Familiarity with QNX RTOS, particularly QNX 6.6 on armv7-le.
* Experience with BLE Audio (LE Audio / LC3).
* Experience with D-Bus and Linux inter-process communication patterns relevant to BlueZ integration.
* Familiarity with Yocto Project / OpenEmbedded build systems.
* Experience expanding static analysis coverage on Linux C/C++ codebases using tools such as cppcheck, clang-tidy, or equivalent.
* Background with mobile platforms (iOS/Android) for Bluetooth testing and protocol-level diagnostics.

**Why Enovation Controls**

We tackle complex work with high expectations and a learning mindset. Our culture is fun and rewarding, and we consistently rank among the best places to work in manufacturing. We back that culture with solid benefits: a strong 401(k) match, cost-effective healthcare options that meaningfully reduce out-of-pocket costs, wellness support, and profit-sharing that rewards collective success.

jobs.title: Entry Level Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Entry – Level Electrical Engineer**

  

At Salas O’Brien we tell our clients that we’re engineered for impact. This passion for making a difference applies just as much to our team as it does to our projects. That’s why we’re committed to living our values every day: inspiring, achieving, and connecting as shared owners of our success with a focus on a sustainable future.

Building for the long-term means that all of our team members can expect to work on amazing projects with a people-first approach to problem solving. It also means that each member of our team has truly limitless potential to build a unique, meaningful, and high-impact career—and they’ll receive great total rewards along the way.

**About Us:**

Founded in 1975, Salas O’Brien is an employee-owned engineering and professional services firm focused on achieving impact for our clients, our team, and the world. We know that tomorrow’s requirements are today’s opportunities, and we are here to design lasting solutions for pressing challenges.

We work across a variety of industries providing integrated engineering and consulting services. Our specialized experience includes design for data centers, healthcare, science and technology, high-rise buildings, clean energy, education, and other building types as well as structural and building sciences, infrastructure asset management, advanced robotics, and more.

Our technical expertise is paired with an exceptional team of business development, human resources, finance and accounting, information technology, and marketing professionals, all of whom play a key role in bringing our commitments to life every day.

**Job Summary:**

The **Entry-Level Electrical Engineer** serves to engage in all phases of a project from programming to construction document development to construction administration. This involvement is intended to grow individuals and nurture design talents. You’ll be part of a team that provides creative solutions that build success for our clients and employees. Your role will include developing and sustaining relationships with in-house teams and contractors while providing technical solutions through design and consulting services that address the facility manager and/or owner’s requirements.

**In this role, you will:**

* Clearly communicate design recommendations to our clients, project teams, construction contractors and vendors in presentations, meetings, via email and phone as necessary.
* Work independently or as part of a team on projects with other technical staff to develop the electrical systems designs that are needed, assuring that the work is accurate and coordinated, and that quality assurance measures have been followed.
* Participate in office and companywide electrical department technical development and education.
* Assist other engineers and designers as a design Engineer to generate project deliverables.

**You will be a great fit if:**

* You have a minimum of a BS in Electrical Engineering, have taken or plan to take the Fundamentals of Engineering exam, and desire obtaining your PE license. A Professional Engineering license is expected once the required years of experience have been obtained
* You can provide timely services that meet the needs of the clients and the overall project schedule requirements.

**Skills/abilities:**

* Able to work within a project team to efficiently produce project BIM models and construction documents of building electrical systems.
* Able to implement and utilize project specific model and drawing standards.
* Can effectively coordinate work with other project team members.
* Exhibit excellent problem-solving skills, able to find creative, innovative solutions to challenges.
* Have excellent listening, written and verbal communication skills, and is sensitive to situations where it is necessary to effectively communicate and coordinate with others.
* Be able to work effectively under the supervision of a Senior Engineer.
* Produce electrical designs that adhere to relevant codes, standards, and Salas O’Brien design practices.
* Possess excellent teamwork skills.
* Be effective at handling multiple tasks.
* Be able to quickly adapt to changes.
* Demonstrate a high standard of professionalism and customer service.

  

**Location**: Oklahoma City, OK

**Travel**: Less than 10%

**Equal Opportunity Employment Statement**

Salas O’Brien provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/provincial, or local laws. Salas O’Brien will accommodate the disability-related needs of applicants as required by law.

#### **Education**

Required

* Bachelors or better in Electrical Engineering

#### **Licenses & Certifications**

Preferred

* Engineer in Training

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.description:
Tinker AFB, Oklahoma, US, 73145

Category: Engineering

Job ID: 35512

widget: Full-Time

TS/SCI

No - Teleworking not available for this position

$121744.58-$210984.64

  

### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

If you want to work on a cutting-edge Air Force program, Serco has a great opportunity for you! As a Senior Level Software Engineer, you will be supporting the Special Programs Division (AFLCMC/WAG) at Tinker AFB, OK.

AFLCMC/WAG develops, tests, and rapidly fields classified USAF aeronautical capabilities. Executing a significant budget, the AFLCMC/WAG conducts studies to identify new capabilities; transitions laboratory technologies to operational platforms; executes demonstrations; and develops, tests, rapidly fields, sustains, and demilitarizes capabilities for the warfighter.

  

In this role, you will:

  

* Develop software engineering strategies in support of the acquisition, development, and sustainment of software for weapon systems, subsystems, and/or support equipment
* Assist in translating user requirements into system requirements, which is used to design, develop, test and evaluate software for computer systems, subsystems and equipment
* Conduct assessments of DoD contractor software deliveries for aircraft / test equipment
* Analyze software performance deficiencies and make recommendations for corrective actions
* Audit DoD contractors for software configuration and control measures and verify appropriate quality accreditation
* Using software engineering experience, evaluate Contractor proposed design changes and solutions, perform systems analyses and technological/trade-off study assessments
* Review system design software architecture and interoperability requirements
* Evaluate system test plans for software and participate in the conduct of system, subsystem, and component testing; review and analyze test data; make recommendations
* Support development and review of the full range of program and contract documentation
* Conduct technical evaluations of contractor proposals
* Perform technical risk assessments and develop mitigation plans

  

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* An active TOP-SECRET security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and access to Special Access Program (SAP) and have a background investigation current within the past 5 years or under Continuous Vetting
* Masters Degree in a relevant engineering discipline with a minimum of 10 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
  + Or a Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant engineering discipline with a minimum of 15 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Minimum of 3 years of SAP experience within the last 8 years
* Recent “hands-on” software development or analysis
* The ability to travel up to 10% (CONUS)

Additional desired experience and skills:

* In-depth knowledge of software engineering support to include software design, integration, configuration, test/evaluation, and certification
* Current knowledge of software development methodology and tools
* Very experienced with operating systems, software languages (e.g., C++, Java Script, Python), computer hardware platforms, or other applicable computer systems
* Experience in integrating DoD cybersecurity considerations into software architectures Experience in a SAP and/or SCI environment

  

If you are interested in supporting and working with our Air Force and airmen and a dedicated Serco team, then submit your application now for immediate consideration. It only takes a few minutes!

  
  

### **Company Overview**

  
  

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our clients deliver vital services more efficiently while increasing the satisfaction of their end customers. Serco serves every branch of the U.S. military, numerous U.S. Federal civilian agencies, the Intelligence Community, the Canadian government, state, provincial and local governments, and commercial clients. While your place may look a little different depending on your role, we know you will find yours here. Wherever you work and whatever you do, we invite you to discover your place in our world. Serco is a place you can count on and where you can make an impact because every contribution matters.
  
  
To review Serco benefits please visit: https://careers.serco-na.com/us/en/what-we-offer. If you require an accommodation with the application process please email: careers@serco-na.com or call the HR Service Desk at 800-628-6458, option 1. Please note, due to EEOC/OFCCP compliance, Serco is unable to accept resumes by email.
  
  
Candidates may be asked to present proof of identity during the selection process. If requested, this will require presentation of a government-issued I.D. (with photo) with name and address that match the information entered on the application. Serco will not take possession of or retain/store the information provided as proof of identity. jobs.title: Systems Engineer III
jobs.description:
At PLEXSYS, we’re all about creating Live, Virtual, and Constructive (LVC) training solutions for our customers worldwide. With over 200 employees spread across fifteen states and four countries, we’re dedicated to enhancing training experiences every day, everywhere.

**Why PLEXSYS?**

At PLEXSYS, you’ll be part of a dynamic and supportive culture that encourages you to reach your professional goals, put forth your best effort, and collaborate with other enthusiastic and driven individuals. Our core values – integrity, excellence, teamwork, and agility – are at the heart of everything we do, guiding our decisions and shaping our vibrant organizational culture.

PLEXSYS is an amazing place to work, but you don’t have to take our word for it. We invite you to check out what our team members are saying about working at PLEXSYS on Glassdoor. Discover why PLEXSYS could be the perfect place for the next step in your career.

**GENERAL DESCRIPTION**  
PLEXSYS is seeking a qualified candidate to support the E-3G Gen 2 Block 40/45 AWACS (Airborne Warning and Control System) Mission Crew Training Set (MCTS) program.  
The E-3G Gen 2 AWACS MCTS provides a fully functional aircrew mission crew simulator that accurately models the software functionality of the USAF E-3G Sentry aircraft. The MCTS is a non-articulated simulator that is designed to provide training for Air Battle Managers and their respective crew positions through nine different system locations worldwide. The MCTS is a device that provides capabilities to train up to 15 crew members at Operator Workstations (OWS); also known as crew consoles and 8 Instructor Operator Stations (IOS) for Instructor Cadre. The trainer uses aircraft software developed by Boeing and supported by the 558th Software Engineering Squadron (SWES) that includes PLEXSYS’ and other COTS training software to facilitate three simultaneous instances function as an independent AWACS.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**  
The role of this position is to provide technical expertise and engineering support to implement reachback support to the MCTS systems, software and networks to include:

* Perform reachback support engineering to MCTS customer requests for software and hardware issues and integration
* Works in cross-functional teams to improve software, systems, and cybersecurity integration and development efficiencies across the PLEXSYS Ecosystem.
* Explores and provide integration strategies for third-party and partner solutions.
* Perform General Acceptance and Operational testing, validation and installation of Government, PLEXSYS and other COTS software applications
* Perform system maintenance task preparations and selection of spare parts, support equipment, tools and technical data for MCTS systems
* Support practical test activities and schedules to include providing technical assistance and training on equipment operation and maintenance with customers, vendors, and company representatives.
* Troubleshoot technical problems and issues to determine technical solution in accordance with product and customer specifications and recommend actions to company or customer representatives for coordinated product solution.
* Provides system hardware, software, and cyber system troubleshooting and reach back support to on-site personnel and coordinate with organizations as necessary.
* Provide technical assistance and assess product needs in accordance with customer specifications
* Provides technical assistance and expertise on suggested customer changes and technical manuals
* Conducts technical training and product briefing with customers, vendors, and company representatives.
* Perform connection, disconnection and other network procedures and process for components testing and inspection
* Track and maintain system trends and provides product and system improvement initiatives
* Coordinate engineering reach back support for software/hardware issues through JIRA, Confluence and other software and resources
* Continuously develops and updates operation and troubleshooting procedures, diagrams and scripts for MCTS hardware and software applications.
* Track software approvals, versioning changes and annotate required changes
* Create and maintain system diagrams (Vizio) for data and network flow
* Coordinate and communicate with PLEXSYS and customer security personnel cybersecurity posture
* Perform component level and Operational System Integration Testing (OSIT)
* Perform field level periodic updates, modifications, and maintenance to systems as required
* Provide comments on suggested customer changes to documented technical manual procedures
* Assist with and/or develop operating procedures and manuals
* Experience working with and configuring systems to meet/maintain Risk Management Framework (RMF) compliance
* Performs other duties, as assigned

**REQUIREMENTS**  

* Ability to communicate with internal and external customers effectively both oral and written
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work in both a local and virtual Team environment, as well as independently
* Must be organized and detail orientated with demonstrated presentation and customer service skills
* At times, perform physically demanding work including working in tight, restricted access quarters and standing for long periods.
* Experience working with and configuring systems to meet Risk Management Framework (RMF) compliance
* Ability to Travel 30% of the year CONUS/OCONUS
* Current or ability to obtain a U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) Top Secret security clearance.
* Ability to obtain/maintain access to work on-site in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.
* Experience in IT administering within multi-domain environments
* 5-10 years experience with Microsoft Windows and Microsoft Office
* Experience with hardware Fault isolation, repair and part replacement
* Extensive industry/vendor skillsets/knowledge on Microsoft Windows OS, Red Hat, Linux, VMWare, Active Directory, Po

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
The Senior Systems Engineer is responsible for the administration, performance, security, and continued improvement of the organization’s enterprise infrastructure. This position manages complex server, storage, backup, virtualization, email, and cloud environments while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and system optimization. The Senior Systems Engineer also serves as a technical leader, supporting IT staff, implementing best practices, and helping align infrastructure solutions with evolving business needs.

  

* Administer, monitor, maintain, and optimize on-premises and cloud-based infrastructure.
* Manage enterprise server, storage, virtualization, backup, and email environments.
* Support cloud services with a focus on security, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Monitor system health and performance, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and conduct capacity planning.
* Develop automation solutions using scripting and DevOps tools to streamline system processes and deployments.
* Lead disaster recovery and business continuity efforts to ensure system availability and data protection.
* Implement cybersecurity best practices, security hardening, monitoring, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Research, evaluate, and deploy new technologies that support organizational and business needs.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to IT staff and promote infrastructure best practices.
* Maintain accurate technical documentation, system configurations, procedures, and policies.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement effective technology solutions.
* Provide advanced technical support for software, hardware, and infrastructure-related issues.
* Travel as needed, work varied shifts including weekends and holidays, and perform other job-related duties as assigned.

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field and 5+ years of experience in systems engineering or IT infrastructure management; equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
* Advanced experience with Windows Server, Linux, enterprise storage, backup solutions, and email platforms such as Exchange and Microsoft 365.
* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud and hybrid-cloud infrastructure strategies.
* Experience with enterprise backup technologies such as Veeam, Commvault, Rubrik, or similar solutions.
* Experience with virtualization technologies including VMware and Hyper-V.
* Advanced scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity, system hardening, endpoint security, data protection, and email security protocols including DKIM, SPF, and DMARC.
* Experience with performance monitoring, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and system automation tools.
* Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Certified SysOps
* Administrator, VMware Certified Professional (VCP), or ITIL are preferred.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to provide technical leadership and work effectively across teams.
* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, work in varying environments, travel as required, and work varied schedules.
* Ability to obtain and maintain required gaming licensure and a valid driver’s license.

  

Cherokee Nation Entertainment is one of the largest and most successful tribal businesses in the country. As the retail, gaming and entertainment entity of the Cherokee Nation, it owns and operates a variety of restaurants, entertainment venues, retail shops, fuel/convenience stores, golf courses, hotels, a horse racing track and an RV campground. As the brand continues to expand its offerings and footprint, CNE remains dedicated to the well-being of the Cherokee Nation and the communities that it calls home.  
  

**Here's** **what awaits you:**

* **Health & Wellness:** Choose from top-notch health plans, **24/7 Telemedicine access** , and **on-site health clinics** (at select locations).
* **Financial Security:** Grow your future with a generous **401(k) match** and **paid vacation, sick time, bereavement, and holidays.**
* **Work-Life Balance:** Enjoy **flexible spending accounts** , **maternity/** **paternity leave** , and **voluntary benefits** for added peace of mind.
* **And More:** Earn **incentives** based on performance, **refer** **friends** and get rewarded, and enjoy **discounts** and **holiday appreciation gifts** .

  

**Immerse Yourself in World-Class Hospitality with Cherokee Nation Entertainment**

**Thrill, excitement, and entertainment await at Cherokee Nation Entertainment, one of the largest and most successful tribal businesses in the country** . As the gaming and hospitality business of the Cherokee Nation, CNE owns and operate a diverse portfolio of leading brands, including Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Tulsa, nine Cherokee Casinos across Northeastern Oklahoma, and Gold Strike Casino Resort in Tunica, Miss.

**Step into a world of possibilities:**

* Gain experience delivering exhilarating gaming across electronic games, table games, and poker rooms .
* Help deliver legendary live entertainment from national and local acts at iconic venues like Hard Rock Live.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
The Systems Engineer is responsible for implementing and improving the organization’s IT infrastructure, with a focus on system reliability, performance, security, and scalability. This position supports server, storage, backup, virtualization, email, and cloud environments while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and system optimization. The Systems Engineer also troubleshoots infrastructure issues, supports system upgrades and maintenance, and collaborates with the IT team to implement technology solutions that meet evolving business needs

  

* Implement and maintain IT infrastructure solutions that support organizational growth and scalability.
* Configure and optimize server environments, virtualization technologies, and cloud-based systems.
* Manage enterprise backup solutions to support data integrity, availability, and recovery readiness.
* Maintain enterprise email platforms and implement security and reliability best practices.
* Develop and implement automation solutions to improve system administration and operational efficiency.
* Conduct performance analysis and capacity planning to identify opportunities for system optimization.
* Strengthen infrastructure security through system hardening, monitoring, patching, and compliance practices.
* Perform software installations, upgrades, updates, and patching while maintaining system stability.
* Troubleshoot and resolve software, hardware, and infrastructure-related technical issues.
* Collaborate with IT teams to evaluate and implement new technologies and system improvements.
* Maintain accurate technical documentation, including system configurations, procedures, and policies.
* Monitor potential security risks and follow established cybersecurity best practices.
* Travel as needed, work varied shifts including weekends and holidays, and perform other job-related duties as assigned

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field and 3+ years of experience in systems engineering, systems administration, or IT infrastructure management; equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
* Experience with Windows Server, Linux, enterprise email platforms such as Exchange and Microsoft 365, and cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with virtualization technologies including VMware and Hyper-V.
* Experience with performance monitoring, system automation, and infrastructure management tools.
* Working knowledge of automation and scripting technologies such as PowerShell.
* Familiarity with email security protocols including DKIM, SPF, and DMARC.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices, system hardening, and applicable compliance frameworks.
* Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, VMware Certified Professional (VCP), or equivalent are preferred.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under pressure.
* Self-motivated, collaborative, and able to work effectively as part of a team.
* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, work in varying environments, travel as required, and work varied schedules.
* Ability to obtain and maintain required gaming licensure and a valid driver’s license

  

Cherokee Nation Entertainment is one of the largest and most successful tribal businesses in the country. * **Financial Security:** Grow your future with a generous **401(k) match** and **paid vacation, sick time, bereavement, and holidays.**
* **Work-Life Balance:** Enjoy **flexible spending accounts** , **maternity/** **paternity leave** , and **voluntary benefits** for added peace of mind.
* **And More:** Earn **incentives** based on performance, **refer** **friends** and get rewarded, and enjoy **discounts** and **holiday appreciation gifts** .

  

**Immerse Yourself in World-Class Hospitality with Cherokee Nation Entertainment**

If you want to work on a cutting-edge Air Force program, Serco has a great opportunity for you! As a Senior Level Software Engineer, you will be supporting the Special Programs Division (AFLCMC/WAG) at Tinker AFB, OK.

AFLCMC/WAG develops, tests, and rapidly fields classified USAF aeronautical capabilities. Executing a significant budget, the AFLCMC/WAG conducts studies to identify new capabilities; transitions laboratory technologies to operational platforms; executes demonstrations; and develops, tests, rapidly fields, sustains, and demilitarizes capabilities for the warfighter.

  

In this role, you will:

  

* Develop software engineering strategies in support of the acquisition, development, and sustainment of software for weapon systems, subsystems, and/or support equipment
* Assist in translating user requirements into system requirements, which is used to design, develop, test and evaluate software for computer systems, subsystems and equipment
* Conduct assessments of DoD contractor software deliveries for aircraft / test equipment
* Analyze software performance deficiencies and make recommendations for corrective actions
* Audit DoD contractors for software configuration and control measures and verify appropriate quality accreditation
* Using software engineering experience, evaluate Contractor proposed design changes and solutions, perform systems analyses and technological/trade-off study assessments
* Review system design software architecture and interoperability requirements
* Evaluate system test plans for software and participate in the conduct of system, subsystem, and component testing; review and analyze test data; make recommendations
* Support development and review of the full range of program and contract documentation
* Conduct technical evaluations of contractor proposals
* Perform technical risk assessments and develop mitigation plans

  

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* An active TOP-SECRET security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and access to Special Access Program (SAP) and have a background investigation current within the past 5 years or under Continuous Vetting
* Masters Degree in a relevant engineering discipline with a minimum of 10 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
  + Or a Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant engineering discipline with a minimum of 15 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Minimum of 3 years of SAP experience within the last 8 years
* Recent “hands-on” software development or analysis
* The ability to travel up to 10% (CONUS)

Additional desired experience and skills:

* In-depth knowledge of software engineering support to include software design, integration, configuration, test/evaluation, and certification
* Current knowledge of software development methodology and tools
* Very experienced with operating systems, software languages (e.g., C++, Java Script, Python), computer hardware platforms, or other applicable computer systems
* Experience in integrating DoD cybersecurity considerations into software architectures Experience in a SAP and/or SCI environment

* Support development and review of the full range of program and contract documentation.
* Conduct technical evaluations of contractor proposals.

  + OR a Masters Degree in a relevant engineering discipline with a Bachelor’s in Electrical/Electronics Engineering from an ABET accredited program and a minimum of 10 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor.
* Minimum of 3 years of SAP experience within the last 8 years.
* The ability to travel up to 10% (CONUS).

  

Additional desired experience and skills:

* Familiar with basics of electrical and electronic circuits, Institute for Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) standard communication circuits, radar, electro-mechanical interface design, software control of electronic circuits.
* Familiar with analog to digital and digital to analog interfaces, electromagnetic interference, electromagnetic compatibility, circuit analysis, and safety of flight requirements in electrical and electronic circuitry.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Application deadline: Oct 12, 2026  
  
Join AWS Hardware Engineering to design the servers powering the world's leading cloud platform and AI/ML infrastructure. We're seeking an exceptional Linux Kernel Engineer to accelerate critical kernel initiatives across millions of servers worldwide.  
  
We are seeking an exceptional Linux Kernel Engineer to join our server firmware team. In this role, you will lead Linux kernel patching, code development, and version adoption for our server management controllers across a massive global fleet. You will ensure our kernel remains current, secure, and compliant with strict patching service-level agreements that directly impact AWS infrastructure reliability. Your work will power the backbone of AWS compute infrastructure, including the servers that enable AI/ML workloads for customers worldwide.  
  
The ideal candidate will be an innovative self-starter with deep expertise in Linux kernel internals, device driver development, and embedded Linux systems. You will gain comprehensive understanding of our server firmware kernel stack and analyze it in both current and future contexts. Using your systems knowledge, you will architect solutions to complex multi-factor problems, including kernel upgrade strategies that minimize customer impact, address security vulnerabilities rapidly, and optimize operational efficiency across millions of servers supporting diverse workloads from traditional compute to advanced machine learning applications.  
  
You will collaborate with engineers across AWS and external partners, leading development efforts that span kernel security, hardware enablement, and platform services teams. Your work will directly contribute to critical initiatives that keep our infrastructure patched, secure, and operationally excellent—ensuring the foundation for tomorrow's AI/ML innovations remains robust and scalable.  
  
AWS Engineers are shaping the way people use computers and designing the future of cloud computing technology – come help us make history!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Design and develop firmware solutions for AWS servers, contributing to server designs that power millions of customer workloads.  
Lead the complete development lifecycle from initial conception through production deployment, ensuring robust and scalable firmware implementations across our massive server fleet.  
Architect and implement firmware deployment strategies that minimize customer impact while maintaining the highest standards of security and operational excellence.  
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including hardware engineers, validation teams, software services to optimize functionality and performance.  
Explore and evaluate emerging technologies and their potential impact on AWS infrastructure, making recommendations for adoption and integration into our firmware stack.  
Drive technical solutions for problems, balancing security requirements, operational efficiency, and system reliability.  
Tailor firmware solutions specifically for the AWS environment, ensuring seamless integration with our unique infrastructure requirements and operational workflows.  
Mentor team members and contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and best practices.  
  
A day in the life  
Most mornings, you'll dive into code—whether that's developing new security features, optimizing firmware deployment strategies, or debugging a tricky issue that's affecting a subset of servers.  
You'll collaborate a lot. Maybe it's a quick sync with platform teams about an upcoming deployment, or a deeper technical discussion with hardware engineers about a new server design. You might work with internal customers to understand their requirements.  
Some days you'll be architecting solutions to complex problems. Other days you might be mentoring a teammate through a code review or exploring a new technology that could improve our firmware stack.

jobs.title: Sr. Mgr Hardware Dev, AWS Hardware Engineering Services
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services is establishing a hardware engineering office in Portland, Oregon to accelerate server hardware development, manufacturing, and operations. The Portland site will become a center of excellence for electrical hardware engineering within AWS for board development, server power, system performance, silicon quality, and manufacturing. This is a greenfield site leadership role. The site leader will be the first hire and the single most important investment in the success of this office. You will not simply manage a team. You will own the culture, operational posture, recruiting velocity, and engineering output of the entire Portland site from day one.  
  
As the site leader, you will own the Portland office end to end. You will define the site's identity, set its operational cadence, and establish the cultural foundation before the organization scales. You will drive recruiting velocity across all Portland teams, partner with real estate and facilities to stand up lab-capable office space, and represent the Portland site in cross-site planning with Seattle, San Jose, and other AWS engineering locations. You will be the single point of accountability for the site's hiring trajectory, engineering output, and organizational health. Every team at the Portland site, whether in your direct reporting line or not, will look to you as the senior leader on the ground.  
  
As the functional engineering leader, you will hire, develop, and lead the managers who run each of the Portland engineering teams. Your direct reports will be the engineering managers who own board development, server power, and manufacturing test/quality, and validation of 3rd party silicon. You will be accountable for the output, hiring velocity, and technical judgment of each of those teams through the managers you put in place. You will lead board development managers, server power managers, electrical manufacturing test/quality, silicon qualification, and production yield. These are not adjacent teams doing similar work. You will be expected to set technical direction across all of them, make resourcing tradeoffs between them, calibrate talent across teams, and hold each manager and their team to a unified engineering bar. You will also carry coordination responsibility for firmware disciplines co-located at the site, including BIOS, BMC, and mechanical engineering teams.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The site leader owns all Portland site operations end to end. This includes defining and executing the recruiting strategy to hire and scale multiple engineering teams. You will lead the multiple engineer teams. You will establish and maintain Amazon's cultural standards at the site, operational rigor, and embody Amazon culture to scale the site.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* 10 or more years of progressive experience in hardware engineering, including at least 5 years managing managers
* Demonstrated track record of building and scaling hardware engineering teams from the ground up, ideally in a greenfield or early-stage site context
* Deep technical fluency across at least two of the following areas: board-level electrical design, server power delivery, manufacturing test engineering, or silicon validation
* Proven ability to hire senior technical talent in competitive markets and to establish a high-performance engineering culture that attracts and retains strong builders

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* Deep connections with the Portland metro technology labor market, including the semiconductor and hardware engineering ecosystem
* Prior experience standing up electrical labs, including board bring-up environments, manufacturing test infrastructure, and silicon debug facilities
* Prior experience building culture in a new site, team, or organization
* Experience managing organizations that span electrical hardware, power delivery, and silicon validation, manufacturing disciplines under a single leadership structure

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Engineer - Industrial Controls
jobs.description:
**About The Company**

As the Pacific Northwest’s leading contract packer and co-packer of ready-to-drink beverage products for nearly a century, Portland Bottling Company provides flexibility and responsiveness, with unmatched regional and national reach, as well as the scale to handle the needs of any and all customers. PBC offers 24/7, end-to-end solutions with state-of-the-art equipment, in-line monitoring, and automated technologies for next level quality, reliability, efficiency and yield.

Our mission at Portland Bottling Company is to act as one team, committed to providing real differentiated value to our customers’ business by delivering the most trusted and highest quality solutions in the industry. That comes from providing an environment for our employees that is safe and promotes growth, development, and success.

**Job Summary**

Interface with several PBC departments to troubleshoot, improve, upgrade and support manufacturing network systems. As a senior technical engineer, the Senior Robotics Engineer – Industrial Controls position will make hands-on contributions to the manufacturing information system software by editing and troubleshooting Programmable Logic Control (PLC) programming and data acquisition / formatting. The position will liaise with the Process Control Engineer in regard to software architecture design, development of software applications and their integration into enterprise systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build, configure, test and debug robotics applications, programs and software codes, such as PLC (AB & Siemens) and Human Machine Interface (HMI) software (Ignition) to support operational changes and improvements for the manufacturing operations.
* Develop, design, and write custom software programming, applications and interfaces to control and monitor systems, including both PLC code (ladder logic) and programming, HMI code and development,
* Install, commission, and deploy robotic programs, ensuring smooth integration with existing manufacturing infrastructure.
* Diagnose other robotic systems, such as advanced displays, advanced sensing, and robotic programs.
* Create detailed technical documentation and back ups of system architecture diagrams, PLC programs, and user manuals
* Implement advanced sensing and vision systems to enable robotics to perceive and interact with their environment autonomously. Maintaining calibration of the sensors
* Investigate mechanical failures and maintenance problems for root cause analysis, providing occasional afterhours remote support for 24/7 operation.
* Support Operations and Maintenance by implementing improvements, troubleshooting electronics and program failures
* Provide technical support for robotic systems. Continuously monitor and optimize the performance of robotic systems, troubleshooting issues and implementing improvements as needed.
* Provide training and support to production personnel on the operation and maintenance of systems and programs.
* Work with vendors and internal personnel on projects related to automated solutions to improve plant operations, increase safety, increase quality, reduce cost and increase efficiency.
* Engage in ongoing maintenance activities, supporting software upgrades, diagnostics and troubleshooting.
* Stay updated on the latest advancements in robotics technology and industry best practices to drive innovation and maintain a competitive edge.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Robotics Engineering or Controls Engineering.
* Seven years of experience maintaining and programming Krones can bottling and packaging machinery, including installation, commissioning, startup, overhaul, inspection, retrofit, and service.
* Seven years of experience programming and troubleshooting controller interfaces and PLCs using Allen-Bradley, Siemens Step 7, Siemens TIA Portal, ladder logic, SCL, and structured text; and programming HMIs using FactoryTalk, WinCC, TIA Portal, Zenon, and Inductive Automation Ignition.
* Seven years of experience with VODM fillers; CIP/SIP processes using phosphoric and caustic; Transmarket product-preparation equipment and processes; and adjusting blending, preparation, filling processes, and filling programs—including mechanical fillers, weight filling, and PFIR filling valves—to operational requirements.
* Seven years of experience with tray packers, palletizers, dry-end machinery, and peripherals, including Videojet tray coders, Nordson glue-injection systems, and Toledo weight checkers; and with can/bottle, case, and pallet conveyors, LCT4 systems, and bottle liners/separators.
* Seven years of electrical experience interpreting American and European (German) prints; and seven years of experience with Profibus, AS-i Bus, CAN bus, Ethernet, Powerlink, and Profinet networks; Danfoss, Allen-Bradley, and B&R frequency inverters, including model and brand conversions and upgrades; servo drives, stepper motors, and general motor control; and programming and addressing AS-i Bus and AS-i safety devices such as buttons and Evoguard, SPX, and Burkert valves.
* Seven years of experience with empty-can, full-can, tray-code, and vision inspection systems; and with Anton Paar equipment, including digital and analog sensors, flow meters, temperature and pressure transmitters, and mass flow meters.
* Seven years of mechanical experience performing major overhauls, replacing worn parts, and rebuilding filling valves, manifold distributors, filler main bearings, conveyor belts, and process valves—including flap, seat, double-seat, double-seal, diverting, shuttle, and sampling valves—and replacing and referencing servo motors.
* Seven years of experience with line control and balancing; adjusting can- and case-conveyor speeds to optimize motor use; and creating, adjusting, and tuning formats for new can sizes, can inspections, package arrangements, and pallet patterns.
* Seven years of experience developing SOPs for equipment upgrades and changes

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The SPTS division provides advanced wafer processing solutions—including etch, deposition and vapor-based technologies—designed for R&D through high-volume production. With a global presence and strong customer support network, SPTS helps manufacturers across industries improve performance, yield and cost-efficiency. It also offers comprehensive service and spare parts through a worldwide network of service centers and qualified local agents.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

At KLA, we develop industry-leading equipment and technologies that enable innovation across the semiconductor industry. Our teams solve complex engineering challenges that help customers manufacture faster, more powerful, and more efficient electronic devices.

  
  

We are seeking a hands-on position support multiple semiconductor process equipment platforms, including advanced etch and deposition systems. This role combines electrical system design, product safety, regulatory compliance, sustaining engineering, and new product development. The ideal candidate is a hands-on electrical engineer that has a strong interest in and willingness to lead product safety and compliance efforts.

  

**What You'll Do**

As a key member of the engineering team, you will be responsible for the electrical design, product & safety compliance, and long-term support of electrical systems in semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

  

**Electrical Systems Design & Sustaining**

* Design and sustain electrical systems for semiconductor process equipment
* Specify and integrate electrical components including power supplies, sensors, relays, circuit protection devices, heaters, temperature control hardware, and motion-control elements
* Develop equipment protection strategies and electrical safety functions such as emergency stops, safety interlocks, and grounding systems
* Evaluate new technologies and alternative components to improve product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and cost
* Support field electrical troubleshooting escalations when required
  

**Product Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

* Lead product safety and compliance initiatives across multiple equipment platforms
* Interpret and implement industry standards including SEMI, CE, IEC, NFPA, UL, and customer-specific requirements
* Conduct compliance assessments, design reviews, gap analyses, risk assessments, and hazard evaluations
* Partner with certification bodies and testing organizations to achieve product certifications and maintain compliance documentation
  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline
* 5+ years of experience designing electrical systems for semiconductor equipment, industrial automation, manufacturing equipment, or other similar electromechanical systems
* Demonstrated ability to assess and design electrical systems and equipment to regulatory standards (i.e., 60204-1, NFPA 79, UL 508A)
* Strong understanding of electrical design principles, power distribution, controls, and electrical safety
* Experience selecting, integrating, and troubleshooting electrical components and subsystems
* Travel requirement for 15 to 20%
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience as a liaison with 3rd party assessors to achieve and maintain equipment certifications (i.e., CE mark, EMC)
* Experience assessing and designing safety interlock circuits with performance levels required by ISO 13849
* Working knowledge of SEMI S2, CE, IEC, NFPA, UL, ISO 13849, and other product compliance standards
* Experience performing machine safety risk assessments and hazard analyses (i.e., 12100, FMEA)
* Experience using Sistema for Performance Level (PL) and functional safety evaluations
  

**Why Join KLA?**

This is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the safety, performance, and reliability of advanced semiconductor manufacturing systems used by leading technology companies worldwide. You'll work on challenging multidisciplinary engineering problems, collaborate with experts across KLA, and contribute to products that power the future of electronics.

**Minimum Qualifications**

Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  
  
  

**Total Rewards**

And we’re reimagining how space can connect us, ensuring security and prosperity.  
  
Join us in shaping a new era in space and find a career that's built for you.  
  
For over 70 years, the Fleet Ballistic Missile (FBM) team has supported the Navy’s mission to provide affordable and credible strategic defense. We offer unique career opportunities and challenges on a program with a rich history and exciting future. We help keep this nation and our allies secure. The FBM Program is experiencing significant growth and we need your expertise to deliver amazing new technologies to our customers while maintaining the technical requirements of the strategic deterrence.  
  
Lockheed Martin (LM) is looking for an resourceful **Systems Engineer, Senior** to become a member of the Systems Engineering and Integration Team.  
  
As a Systems Engineer, Senior, you will:  

* Develop subsystem requirements documentation
* Develop CAMEO models of the subsystem
* Support requirements writing, other model based systems engineering activities, and verification planning
* Collaborate with internal, external, and customer stakeholders to create end to end integrated solutions
* Support a value driven systems engineering team and facilitate design evolution in a systematic and thoughtful way
* Support development of test, modeling, validation and verification activities

  
**YOU WILL TYPICALLY HAVE**  

* 3+ years of professional experience with a Bachelor's
* Active Top Secret Clearance
* Ability to work onsite at our Valley Forge, PA or Littleton, CO campus

This position requires the ability to work in a controlled and compliance-driven environment while supporting mission-critical capabilities.

Serco supports the Naval Undersea Warfare Center (NUWC), including support for the design, acquisition, testing and sustainment of naval undersea warfare systems. **This position is contingent upon the ability to maintain/transfer a DoD Secret Security Clearance**

In this role, you will:

* Provide technical support to government and external user communities, including troubleshooting, issue resolution, and user engagement
* Develop, maintain, and enhance core simulation software (PCX), including implementation of bug fixes and new capabilities
* Conduct code audits and enforce software quality standards as part of the integration process with R&D development teams
* Prepare, validate, and release software builds for external distribution in accordance with configuration management and security requirements
* Perform lifecycle maintenance activities, including:
* + Operating system updates and patching
  + C++ compiler and library updates
  + DDS middleware configuration, updates, and troubleshooting
* Design, implement, and maintain automated simulation and test pipelines, including nightly regression runs
* Support simulation environments leveraging PCX, MOAA, and DSIM across diverse mission scenarios and vehicle configurations
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure system performance, reliability, and compliance
* Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines in secure, controlled environments

To be sucessful in this role, you will have:

* The ability to maintain/transfer a DoD Secret Security Clearance
* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field
* 2 years of relevant experience
* Strong programming experience in:
* + C++
  + Python
* Proficiency in Linux/Unix-based operating systems
* Experience with:
* + Distributed systems (DDS or similar middleware preferred)
  + Version control (Git) and collaborative development workflows
  + CI/CD pipeline development and maintenance
* Familiarity with DevOps tools and practices, including:
* + GitLab and GitLab Runners
  + Automated testing frameworks (e.g., Google Test)
  + Containerization technologies (e.g., Docker)
* Ability to troubleshoot complex, integrated systems across software and infrastructure layers
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* The ability to travel up to 10%

Additional desired experience and skills:

* Experience with modeling and simulation environments or autonomy systems
* Familiarity with PCX, MOAA, and/or DSIM (or similar frameworks)
* Experience supporting software in classified or regulated environments
* Background in robotics, unmanned systems, or naval/defense applications
* Experience with secure software development practices and accreditation processes
