jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, Power Electronics PCB Design
jobs.description:
Valinor is a new type of defense and government tech company focused on solving the problems others don't. Our unique model of centralized go-to-market and decentralized engineering allows us to move with unparalleled efficiency to identify unmet needs, build right-sized solutions, and get products where they matter most, in the hands of users. Unlike others in the space, who focus on the flashy problems, Valinor exists to solve the quiet, unaddressed problems, the small but significant ones that lead to cracks in the country's strength, stability, and security.

Backed by General Catalyst, Founders Fund, and Friends & Family Capital, Valinor was founded in 2024 and has established strategic partnerships with Palantir, Anduril, and Helsing. We are building the dream team, and we want you on it.

**About the Role**

**Valinor Dispatch** builds modular charging infrastructure that keeps unmanned systems (drones, ground robots, surface vessels) powered and operating autonomously in the field. We're seeking an **Electrical Engineer** specializing in power electronics and PCB design to own power flow for our AC/DC systems in low-voltage applications. This is a hands-on, on-site role for someone who can take a design from prototype and proof of concept through production-ready manufacturing, working directly with our engineering team to build rugged, high-reliability power systems for austere environments. You'll own the board-level design for DC/DC conversion, protection, and health monitoring, and set the standard for power electronics quality as the team scales.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Own power flow for AC/DC systems and subsystems in low-voltage applications (<240VAC, <60VDC) across the power infrastructure for autonomous platforms including robots, drones, and surface vessels
* Design production-level PCBs for DC/DC converters, protection systems, and health monitoring built to survive austere environments
* Take designs from prototype and proof of concept through to production-ready manufacturing
* Design to EMI/EMC requirements for high-current, high-power systems (1kW to 50kW)
* Partner with mechanical, embedded, and systems engineers to integrate power electronics into complete autonomous charging platforms
* Build and validate prototypes, then drive the handoff to volume production

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

* 3+ years in power electronics or electrical engineering with hands-on, production-level PCB design
* Proven track record designing DC/DC converters, protection systems, and health monitoring from schematic through manufacturing
* Familiarity with EMI/EMC requirements for high-current, high-power designs (1kW to 50kW)
* Demonstrated ability to prototype, prove out a concept, and push it to production-ready manufacturing
* Experience with low-voltage AC/DC systems (<240VAC, <60VDC)
* Experience designing for austere or rugged environments (thermal, shock and vibration, ingress protection) strongly preferred
* Background in industrial, automotive, oil and gas, rail, or defense power systems preferred
* Proficiency with PCB design and simulation tools such as Altium Designer, LTSpice, or similar a plus
* Experience with wide-bandgap devices (SiC/GaN) and resonant topologies (LLC, dual active bridge) a plus

**What Valinor Offers**
=======================

* Competitive salary, equity packages, and benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance - fully covered for employees, 401(k), among others.
* Unlimited PTO and two-week company holiday at the end of every calendar year.
* We are a pro-mental health and pro-family company - we actually encourage employees to spend time with themselves and their families. Valinor also provides fertility benefits to those just beginning that journey.
* Fun work environment - we like to laugh and take care of each other, but we also deeply respect the mission in front of us.

*This role requires the candidate be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. Active clearance preferred, but not required.*

Valinor is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. The Valinor team is made up of incredibly talented and unique individuals, who together are disrupting industry norms by creating new paths towards the future of defense and government technology. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, Veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the CA Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. We actively encourage members of recognized minorities, women, Veterans, and those with disabilities to apply, and we work to create a welcoming and supportive environment for all applicants throughout the interview process. If you are someone passionate about working on problems that have a real-world impact, we'd love to hear from you!

At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world.

Join our RF/Microwave Engineering team at Raytheon and help develop mission-critical technologies that protect the U.S. and our international allies. In this role, you will design, develop, integrate, test, and/or support the manufacture of advanced RF and microwave hardware for radar and sensing applications.

You may work across a broad range of technologies, including RF circuit card assemblies (CCAs) and modules for receivers, exciters, and transmitters; antennas and radomes; semiconductor devices; microwave and millimeter-wave integrated circuits (MMICs); and phased-array hardware.

You will collaborate closely with multidisciplinary engineering, manufacturing, test, and program teams throughout the full hardware development lifecycle—from concept development and detailed design through integration, verification, and transition to production. This is an opportunity to solve challenging RF problems, work hands-on with advanced hardware, and contribute directly to some of Raytheon’s premier radar and sensing programs.

**What You Will Do**

* Design, simulate, and analyze RF/microwave components, MMICs, CCAs, and/or phased array module hardware.
* Perform assembly, testing and characterization, of RF, microwave, and millimeter-wave hardware and/or devices.
* Execute component-level and system-level integration and testing for digital, analog, and RF assemblies.
* Utilize automated test instrumentation and software (e.g., Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW) to control measurement systems, capture data, and evaluate test results.
* Characterize and test hardware using advanced laboratory equipment, including Vector Network Analyzers (VNAs), Signal Generators, Spectrum Analyzers, Phase Noise Analyzers, and Performance Network Analyzers (PNAs).
* Conduct circuit simulations, obsolescence trade assessments, hardware troubleshooting, and failure investigations to resolve performance issues.
* Partner with multi-discipline teams
* Participate in project design reviews, peer reviews, and briefings to internal program leadership and external customers

**What You Will Learn:**

* RF simulation and design processes
* RF hardware characterization techniques, including using spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, signal generators, phase noise analyzers, etc.
* Software such as Keysight ADS, HFSS, Cadence Virtuoso, MATLAB, CST, Mentor Graphics’ Expedition, Python, Labview

**Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or related Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) discipline. Degree must be obtained by start date.
* Coursework in one or more of the following: RF Circuit Design, Microwave Circuits, Electromagnetics, Antenna Engineering, Microwave Measurements, RF Engineering, Radar Signal Processing, or Radar Design.
* Experience in at least one of the following technical domains:

* **RF/Microwave Design & Measurement:** Designing, fabricating, or bench-testing RF/microwave circuits or components (e.g., amplifiers, filters, mixers, couplers), including S-parameter or microwave measurements using network/spectrum analyzers.

* **Antennas & Applied Electromagnetics:** Modeling, simulating, or testing antennas or electromagnetic structures using computational tools (e.g., HFSS, CST Studio, ADS, FEKO) or anechoic chamber measurements.

* **Radar Architecture & Signal Processing:** Modeling or implementing radar signal processing algorithms (e.g., pulse compression, Doppler processing, beamforming, CFAR, waveform design) using simulation tools (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, Python) or embedded hardware.

  

* Experience building, testing, or characterizing electronic hardware, RF circuits, or antenna systems using standard test benches or measurement facilities.
* Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects.

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

jobs.title: Software Engineer Stf - E4
jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

This position is for a Mission Assurance Software Engineer Staff supporting Anti-Tamper software development for the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter (JSF) and Integrated Fighter Group (IFG) platforms. Opportunities to support other LM Aero platforms may become available as the candidate progresses in this role. Daily tasks include, but are not limited to, the following:

  

* Lead the development, maintenance, and execution of unit tests and requirements‑driven test suites for mission‑critical software components.
* Drive agile ceremonies (scrum, sprint planning, retrospectives) and coach the team on best-practice us of agile tools.
* Architect and implement software features in a Linux environment; own branching/merging strategies and code-review processes.
* Design and deliver middleware components that define integration interfaces across mission systems and hardware subsystems.
* Drive the optimization of CI/CD pipelines to improve build quality and delivery speed.
* Lead embedded software development, including memory‑mapped hardware access, bare‑metal coding, and real‑time operating system (RTOS) integration.
* Direct root‑cause investigations, fault isolation, debugging, and after‑action reporting.
* Collaborate with system engineers, hardware engineers, and test teams to ensure software meets interface, performance, and security requirements.
* Author and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, test procedures, and operational guidance.

The successful candidate plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities. Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment. Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle. Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software. Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls. Ensures software standards are met.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s (or higher) degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 8 + years of software‑development experience, including independent delivery of embedded or mission‑critical systems.
* Secret Clearance with ability to obtain Special Access Program (SAP) Clearance.

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Expert-level C/C++ programming background; ability to design reusable libraries and frameworks.
* Extensive experience with GNU build tools (Make, CMake, etc.).
* Hands-on experience with AMD/Xilinx FPGA tools (Vitis, Vivado) and integration of FPGA-based IP.
* Extensive Linux development experience (user-space and kernel-level), including driver development and performance tuning.
* Advanced experience with memory-mapped hardware, practical FPGA integration, deep knowledge of RTOS (VxWorks, FreeRTOS) and bare-metal development, and proven ability to perform rate-monotonic scheduling analysis.
* Extensive experience with cryptographic libraries (OpenSSL, WolfSSL, etc.) and implementation of secure-coding best practices in mission-critical software.
* Experience leading unit test and requirements-driven test development.
* Advanced use of Agile tools such as Jira and Confluence (or equivalents).
* Familiarity with JSF and/or IFG Mission Systems, Combat Navigation & Identification (CNI), Electronic Warfare (EW), Weapons, and Radar sub-systems.
* Reverse Engineering background.

**Pay Information**

Product Eng

  

Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Project Leo Customer Terminals
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Project Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.  
  
In this role, you will develop software for the Leo Customer Terminal embedded systems engineering team. You will be responsible for the design, implementation, deployment and operations of the functions for Leo Customer Terminals.  
  
Export Control Requirement:  
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Development and testing with embedded Linux
* Develop embedded software functions for Customer Terminal devices within the Project Leo system
* Developing embedded software utilizing Rust, C++, C
* Participate in all phases of SDLC: requirements, design, coding, test, deployment and production system
* Development of software in a secure compute environment
* State machine design and analysis
* Support Customer Terminal deployments operations and debugging on production systems
* Technical writing of design specifications

  
  
A day in the life  
As part of our software engineering team, you will design, implement and debug software used to test and debug embedded software for Leo Customer Terminal platforms in R&D and commercial operation. You will work in a collaborative environment with teams in Leo Customer Terminal hardware development, software development and operations. You need to be flexible and responsive to fast changing priorities and issues. You will work on Customer Terminal issues on production system platforms.  
  
About the team  
The Leo Customer Terminal Software Team develops and supports the devices that connect Leo subscribers to the Leo network. We provide software for the Leo Customer Terminal platform, applications and underlying Linux system. We work hand in hand with hardware engineering, product, and operations teams to deliver commercial grade services for our Leo subscribers.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 7+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 7+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 10+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Master's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Proficiency in languages suitable for system-level programming (C++, Rust, Go)
* Experience with CI/CD pipeline setup and management
* Experience with automated testing and continuous integration

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

**Job Title: Senior Associate, Software Engineer**

**Job Code: 45702**

**Job Location: Richardson, TX**

**Job Schedule: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked, and have every other Friday off**

* Work closely with cross functional members of the engineering organization to develop and evaluate interfaces between hardware and software, and operational performance requirements and design of the overall system

* Support and participate in all phases of the software development life cycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, integration, and test of embedded software for real-time control of advanced tactical radio equipment

* Participate in peer reviews, identify, track and repair defects

* One or more of the following: C++, C#, C, Java, Ruby, JEE, HTML5, XML, SQL, Qt, Windows, .NET, Unix, Linux, SOA, RTOS, Real-Time Controls, Wireless, Software Security, Robotics, OOA/OOD, Hadoop, Android, Embedded Systems

Join our RF/Microwave Engineering team at Raytheon and help develop mission-critical technologies that protect the U.S. and our international allies. In this role, you will design, develop, integrate, test, and/or support the manufacture of advanced RF and microwave hardware for radar and sensing applications.

You may work across a broad range of technologies, including RF circuit card assemblies (CCAs) and modules for receivers, exciters, and transmitters; antennas and radomes; semiconductor devices; microwave and millimeter-wave integrated circuits (MMICs); and phased-array hardware.

You will collaborate closely with multidisciplinary engineering, manufacturing, test, and program teams throughout the full hardware development lifecycle—from concept development and detailed design through integration, verification, and transition to production. This is an opportunity to solve challenging RF problems, work hands-on with advanced hardware, and contribute directly to some of Raytheon’s premier radar and sensing programs.

**What You Will Do**

* Design, simulate, and analyze RF/microwave components, MMICs, CCAs, and/or phased array module hardware.
* Perform assembly, testing and characterization, of RF, microwave, and millimeter-wave hardware and/or devices.
* Execute component-level and system-level integration and testing for digital, analog, and RF assemblies.
* Utilize automated test instrumentation and software (e.g., Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW) to control measurement systems, capture data, and evaluate test results.
* Characterize and test hardware using advanced laboratory equipment, including Vector Network Analyzers (VNAs), Signal Generators, Spectrum Analyzers, Phase Noise Analyzers, and Performance Network Analyzers (PNAs).
* Conduct circuit simulations, obsolescence trade assessments, hardware troubleshooting, and failure investigations to resolve performance issues.
* Partner with multi-discipline teams
* Participate in project design reviews, peer reviews, and briefings to internal program leadership and external customers

**What You Will Learn:**

* RF simulation and design processes
* RF hardware characterization techniques, including using spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, signal generators, phase noise analyzers, etc.
* Software such as Keysight ADS, HFSS, Cadence Virtuoso, MATLAB, CST, Mentor Graphics’ Expedition, Python, Labview

**Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or related Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) discipline. Degree must be obtained by start date.
* Coursework in one or more of the following: RF Circuit Design, Microwave Circuits, Electromagnetics, Antenna Engineering, Microwave Measurements, RF Engineering, Radar Signal Processing, or Radar Design.
* Experience in at least one of the following technical domains:

* **RF/Microwave Design & Measurement:** Designing, fabricating, or bench-testing RF/microwave circuits or components (e.g., amplifiers, filters, mixers, couplers), including S-parameter or microwave measurements using network/spectrum analyzers.

* **Antennas & Applied Electromagnetics:** Modeling, simulating, or testing antennas or electromagnetic structures using computational tools (e.g., HFSS, CST Studio, ADS, FEKO) or anechoic chamber measurements.

* **Radar Architecture & Signal Processing:** Modeling or implementing radar signal processing algorithms (e.g., pulse compression, Doppler processing, beamforming, CFAR, waveform design) using simulation tools (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, Python) or embedded hardware.

  

* Experience building, testing, or characterizing electronic hardware, RF circuits, or antenna systems using standard test benches or measurement facilities.
* Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects.

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* Hands-on laboratory experience specific to RF/microwave device or circuit characterization using VNAs, spectrum analyzers, and automated test environments.
* Proficiency with RF/electromagnetic design and analysis software such as Keysight ADS, ANSYS HFSS, CST Studio Suite, Microwave Office, Cadence Virtuoso, or MATLAB.
* Experience scripting and automating laboratory test equipment using Python, C++, or LabVIEW.
* Demonstrated leadership experience through student organizations, research projects, or engineering team initiatives.
* Strong collaborative, interpersonal, and technical communication skills working in multi-disciplinary engineering settings.

**What We Offer:**

* Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
* Relocation Eligibility

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer, BMC & BIOS
jobs.description:
**Firmware Engineer, BMC & BIOS**

**Location:** El Paso TX, 79927

**Reports To:**  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Permanent | **Salary range: $**

**Schedule:** Mon.- Fri. **(Overtime may be required based on business needs).**

**Language:** English | Bilingual (preferred)

The **Firmware Engineer, BMC & BIOS** is responsible for supporting customer issue resolution involving server, storage, networking, and AI rack systems throughout New Product Introduction (NPI) and Mass Production (MP).

This position serves as the firmware subject-matter expert within the WYUS Forward Engineering Team, providing first-level technical triage, log analysis, firmware validation, issue reproduction, and cross-functional coordination for problems involving **BMC, BIOS/UEFI, NIC firmware, switch firmware, PCIe switches, and add-in cards**.

The Firmware Engineer works closely with factory teams, R&D engineering organizations, suppliers, and customers to collect complete technical data, narrow failure conditions, identify appropriate corrective actions, and drive issues through resolution and closure.

The position does not replace the responsibilities of product design, failure analysis, quality, or test ownership teams. Instead, the role ensures that firmware-related issues are properly characterized, supported with complete data, assigned to the appropriate technical owners, and driven toward timely resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Firmware Issue Investigation and Troubleshooting**

* Investigate customer, factory, and production issues involving BMC, BIOS/UEFI, NICs, switches, PCIe switches, and add-in cards.
* Collect, analyze, and interpret firmware and system logs to identify abnormal behavior and failure conditions.
* Review BMC event logs, Redfish, IPMI, BIOS/UEFI POST information, serial logs, network device logs, and other relevant diagnostic data.
* Reproduce firmware-related failures whenever possible and narrow issues to the appropriate firmware, hardware, configuration, or environmental condition.
* Verify firmware versions, configurations, settings, and release requirements against approved product baselines.
* Identify missing information and ensure appropriate diagnostic data is collected during the initial investigation.

**BMC and BIOS/UEFI Support**

* Provide technical support for BMC and BIOS/UEFI-related issues across server and rack-level systems.
* Troubleshoot issues involving system boot, POST, firmware configuration, hardware initialization, management interfaces, and system monitoring.
* Apply working knowledge of Open BMC, Redfish, IPMI, BIOS, UEFI, and PCIe architecture to support system-level troubleshooting.
* Coordinate firmware validation and issue reproduction with appropriate R&D teams.
* Support firmware release verification and configuration checks during NPI and MP.

**Networking and PCIe Firmware Support**

* Support technical investigations involving NIC firmware, network switches, PCIe switches, and add-in cards.
* Analyze logs and system behavior to determine whether an issue originates from firmware, configuration, hardware, or system integration.
* Coordinate with firmware development teams and external vendors to investigate and resolve component-level issues.
* Support configuration verification and firmware compatibility testing for integrated server and rack systems.

**Customer Issue Resolution**

* Act as the firmware subject-matter expert for customer escalations within the Forward Engineering organization.
* Participate in technical issue reviews with customers, management, business units, factory teams, and R&D organizations.
* Translate complex technical findings into clear and concise explanations for customers and non-firmware stakeholders.
* Provide accurate status updates, technical findings, next steps, owners, and estimated timelines.
* Maintain professional communication during high-priority and escalated customer issues.

**NPI and Mass Production Support**

* Provide firmware support throughout NPI phases, including EVT, DVT, and PVT, as well as Mass Production.
* Support factory builds, validation, production testing, and customer qualification activities.
* Work closely with Failure Analysis, Test Engineering, Manufacturing Test Engineering, Quality, and Manufacturing teams.
* Ensure firmware-related issues discovered during production are properly documented, investigated, and escalated.
* Support transition of recurring firmware issues into permanent corrective actions, test improvements, or design changes.

**R&D and Vendor Coordination**

* Work directly with R&D firmware organizations and component vendors to drive issue resolution.
* Provide complete logs, reproduction steps, system configurations, firmware versions, failure conditions, and other required technical information.
* Clearly define the technical problem and communicate the expected next action to the engineering team responsible.
* Track R&D and vendor actions to ensure issues continue progressing toward closure.
* Escalate unresolved issues when additional resources, management attention, or technical decisions are required.

**Debug Tools and Automation**

* Develop, improve, or introduce scripts and diagnostic tools that simplify firmware troubleshooting and data collection.
* Use Python, Bash, Linux command-line tools, or similar technologies to automate repetitive debug activities.
* Improve the consistency and completeness of log collection.
* Develop methods that allow factory teams to capture required information correctly during the first investigation.
* Share effective debug methods and tools with engineering and factory teams.

**Issue Tracking and Closure**

* Maintain ownership of assigned firmware issues from initial identification through resolution and closure.
* Track issue status, technical owners, action items, timelines, and required follow-up.
* Ensure open issues are reviewed regularly with factory and R&D teams.

jobs.title: Hardware Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Hardware Engineer to support the validation and production readiness of AI and high-performance computing infrastructure deployed across Meta's global data centers. In this role, you will work at the intersection of AI silicon, server systems, and data center operations, partnering with hardware design, firmware, software, and capacity engineering teams to bring AI accelerators and GPU-based server platforms from new product introduction through full-scale deployment. Your work will directly influence the reliability, scalability, and performance of the AI infrastructure that powers Meta's machine learning and AI initiatives.  
  
  

### **Hardware Systems Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Lead hardware system validation and qualification activities for AI server platforms, GPU clusters, and AI accelerator systems entering Meta's production data center environment
* Drive new product introduction efforts for AI/HPC hardware by defining acceptance criteria, coordinating bring-up activities, and managing cross-functional readiness reviews with silicon, firmware, and software teams
* Develop and execute test plans covering thermal, power, and electrical characterization of AI server systems at component, board, and rack levels
* Investigate and root-cause complex hardware failures across the full stack, including AI silicon, firmware, system software, and thermal subsystems
* Collaborate with AI silicon vendors and original design manufacturers to resolve hardware issues, drive engineering change orders, and ensure production quality standards are met
* Define and improve hardware qualification methodologies and failure analysis processes for AI/HPC platforms to scale across large fleet deployments
* Partner with AI platform and capacity engineering teams to support hardware deployment planning, rack integration, and production ramp execution for GPU and AI accelerator systems
* Analyze fleet telemetry, failure rate data, and field return trends to identify systemic reliability risks in AI infrastructure and drive corrective actions
* Contribute to AI hardware design reviews and provide feedback on system architecture, component selection, and manufacturability to improve production outcomes
* Communicate hardware qualification status, risk assessments, and deployment readiness for AI/HPC systems to cross-functional stakeholders and engineering leadership

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 6+ years of experience in hardware engineering with a focus on AI servers, GPUs, AI accelerators, or high-performance computing systems in a data center environment
* 6+ years of experience in hardware validation, system bring-up, or new product introduction for AI/HPC platforms
* Experience debugging hardware failures across multiple domains including power delivery, thermal management, signal integrity, or high-speed interconnects such as PCIe, NVLink, or HBM in AI systems
* Experience developing test specifications, qualification procedures, and failure analysis documentation for AI/HPC hardware systems
* Experience collaborating with silicon vendors, original design manufacturers, or contract manufacturers to resolve hardware quality and reliability issues for AI infrastructure

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with scripting or automation for hardware test workflows, data collection, and failure triage in a Linux-based environment
* Familiarity with hardware telemetry frameworks, out-of-band management protocols such as IPMI or Redfish, and fleet-level diagnostics tooling for AI infrastructure
* Experience with AI/HPC hardware platforms including GPU clusters, AI accelerators, or custom AI server designs at rack or pod scale

We are the group within GM building innovative IT solutions supporting manufacturing, leveraging current and emerging technologies. Our focus includes technologies around error proofing, monitoring and control, robotics, AI, and intelligent automation. Our work supports GM manufacturing goals to build quality products with zero defects.

  

The **Sr. Systems Engineer** is responsible for leading the deployment, modernization, and ongoing support of software applications used globally in GM manufacturing plants. This role will help deconstruct existing deployment processes and make them AI-centric, improving speed, repeatability, reliability, and business engagement across GM’s manufacturing footprint. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - Research and Development
jobs.description:
Onsite:  
Travel: 20%

Join the Maverick Power Team!

At Maverick Power, we don’t just build power distribution solutions—we redefine industry standards. Recognized on the 2025 Inc. 5000 list as #16 in the U.S., #2 in Manufacturing, and #1 in Texas, we are committed to driving innovation, quality, and speed. With multiple manufacturing facilities across North Texas and Phoenix, we are expanding rapidly and looking for top talent to grow with us

If you are ready to be part of a high-energy, solutions-driven team where your work makes an impact, Maverick Power is the place for you.

What We Offer:

* Competitive Salary + Bonus Potential!
* Paid Time Off, 401K Matching, Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits!
* High-growth organization with advancement opportunities!
* Diverse, Collaborative, & Fun Work Environment!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated R&D Electrical Engineer with expertise in low voltage (LV) and medium voltage (MV) power systems to join our dynamic team. The successful candidate will drive the design, development, and testing of innovative power system solutions, contributing to the advancement of next-generation energy technologies. This role requires a strong foundation in electrical engineering principles, hands-on experience with LV/MV systems, and a passion for research and innovation.

Key Responsibilities:

* Design and Development: Design, simulate, and develop electrical systems and components for low voltage (up to 1kV) and medium voltage (1kV–38kV) applications, ensuring compliance with industry standards (e.g., IEEE, IEC, UL).
* Prototyping and Testing: Build and test prototypes of power system components, including transformers, switchgear, circuit breakers, and control systems, to validate performance and reliability.
* Research and Innovation: Conduct research to explore new technologies, materials, and methodologies to improve efficiency, safety, and sustainability of LV/MV power systems.
* Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including mechanical engineers, software engineers, and product managers, to integrate electrical systems into broader product designs.
* Documentation: Prepare technical reports, design specifications, and documentation to support product development, regulatory approvals, and intellectual property filings.
* Standards and Compliance: Ensure all designs and processes adhere to safety, environmental, and regulatory standards, including NEC, NEMA, and OSHA requirements.
* Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical issues in power systems during development, testing, and field implementation phases.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or minimum of 8 years of qualified work experience may be substituted.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in R&D or design of low voltage and/or medium voltage power systems.
* Strong background in control system design using SolidWorks Electrical.
* Proven track record in designing and testing electrical components such as transformers, switchgear, or power distribution systems.
* Experience with power electronics, protection systems, and control systems is a plus.
* Strong understanding of power system components, including circuit breakers, relays, and busbars.
* Familiarity with industry standards (e.g., IEEE, IEC, UL, NEC).
* Proficient in using CAD tools (SolidWorks Electrical) for wiring schematics and panel layout design.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Master’s degree is preferred.
* Experience with renewable energy integration (e.g., solar, wind, energy storage, microgrids) into LV/MV systems.
* Familiarity with smart grid technologies or IoT applications in power systems.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent certification.

Physical Requirements:

* Must be able to lift up to 40 pounds at a time.
* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Work Environment:  
May work in various settings at the Maverick Power facilities, in offices, in multiple shops, and in commercial buildings. Maintaining the same position or posture while performing tasks and sitting for prolonged periods. The above-noted job description is not intended to describe, in detail, the multitude of tasks that may be assigned but rather to give the applicant a general sense of the responsibilities and expectations of this position. As the nature of business demands change so, too, may the essential functions of the position.

***We are looking for a self-motivated, adaptable engineer who approaches problems systematically, learns new technologies quickly, communicates clearly, and is comfortable working both independently and as part of a project team.***

***This role is ideal for someone who wants to expand their technical capabilities, take on increasing responsibility, and contribute directly to customer projects in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial automation company***

* Programming, modifying, debugging, and documenting PLC systems on multiple platforms
* Developing PLC applications using ladder logic, structured text (highly sought), and other programming methods, as appropriate
* Building, modifying, and supporting HMI/SCADA interfaces
* Evaluating existing systems, understanding how they operate, and developing practical solutions before making changes.
* Troubleshooting across a wide variety of equipment, technologies, and PLC platforms — both virtually and in live production environments
* Performing on‑site testing, startup, and commissioning
* Working directly with customer engineers, technicians, operators, and project managers to resolve technical problems and deliver effective automation solutions
* Taking ownership of defined controls work from requirements and development through testing, startup, commissioning, and customer turnover, including planning, communicating project status and technical risks, and escalating significant issues early.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Demonstrated communication, documentation, ownership, and follow-through habits
* Strong problem-solving mindset — able to diagnose issues, develop and implement solutions under pressure.

* Strong proficiency with at least one major PLC platform such as CODESYS, Bosch Rexroth ctrlX, Rockwell Automation, or Siemens, with the ability to learn unfamiliar platforms quickly.

jobs.title: Automation Controls Engineer, Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services' Hardware Engineering team is looking for experienced professionals to help build the world's premier cloud computing platform. The Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering team designs, validates, and deploys automation solutions, including robotics, cobots, vision inspection, AI-powered quality systems, and automated assembly workflows, across contract manufacturer sites worldwide.  
  
About the Role: You will define the controls and electrical systems architecture for all automated assembly lines, creating the standard control platform that scales across all platforms and all contract manufacturer sites. You own PLC programming standards, HMI development frameworks, safety system architecture, and industrial network design. You define how automated cells communicate with each other, with MES, and with data collection systems. You are the architect of the nervous system that connects every robot, sensor, actuator, and inspection system into a coordinated, data-generating production line. You establish reusable control system templates that ensure consistency and reduce deployment time globally.  
  
The scope covers all server and rack assembly across all architectures and platforms, including compute, AI/ML accelerators, storage, and networking. The team designs intelligent, predictive-analytics-driven production systems where every station is sensor-driven, AI-optimized, and self-correcting, turning assembly lines into programmable, data-generating platforms that scale capacity without scaling headcount. This role requires the engineer to operate in a fast-paced, multi-platform international manufacturing environment with travel to contract manufacturer sites (up to 25-30% travel anticipated).  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define controls systems architecture: PLC programming standards, HMI frameworks, safety system design, network topology
* Design and program PLC-based control systems for automated assembly lines
* Develop standardized HMI interfaces for operator interaction and production monitoring
* Architect industrial network infrastructure (e.g., EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT) for automated lines
* Design safety system architecture per ISO 13849 and IEC 62443 (functional safety and cybersecurity)
* Create reusable control system templates and code libraries for global deployment standardization
* Define MES integration specifications and data exchange protocols between automation cells and enterprise systems
* Lead controls architecture reviews for automation projects and vendor-supplied systems

  
About the team  
About the team: The Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering team is building a centralized automation Center of Excellence that owns the process specification and IP for how AWS hardware gets assembled. The team is responsible for engineering, defining automated process requirements, designing and proving solutions at proof-of-concept, and maintaining AWS-owned intellectual property that scales globally. The team works within a collaborative framework across Hardware Engineering (product design for automation), Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering (process specification and validation), and Manufacturing Operations (deployment and scaling), ensuring automation is engineered once, proven once, and deployed everywhere.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent
* 7+ years designing industrial control systems for automated manufacturing
* Proficiency in PLC programming (e.g., Siemens TIA Portal, Allen-Bradley Studio 5000, Beckhoff TwinCAT)
* Experience with industrial safety system design (e.g., ISO 13849, safety PLCs, safety networks)
* Experience with industrial network protocols (e.g., EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT, OPC-UA)
* Track record of defining control system standards for multi-site deployment

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with MES integration and manufacturing data exchange
* HMI/SCADA development experience (e.g., Ignition, WinCC, FactoryTalk)
* Industrial cybersecurity knowledge (e.g., IEC 62443)
* Experience with servo motion control and multi-axis coordination
* Electronics, server, or precision hardware manufacturing environment
* Experience leading controls design reviews for third-party automation systems
* Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher)

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/ac

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Section Manager - Production Support
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  
See what you’re missing. Our employees work on the world’s most advanced electronics from Electronic Threat Detection being used by F-35 pilots to Software Defined Airborne Tactical Radios (ATRs) enabling Warfighter communication, to Identification Friend or Foe (IFF) radars ensuring the safety of airborne platforms around the world. Spanning air, land, sea, and space, we are developing the technology of tomorrow, delivered today. Drawing strength from our differences, we’re innovating for the future. Our flexible work environment provides you a chance to change the world without giving up your personal life. We put our customers first – exemplified by our mission: “We Protect Those Who Protect Us®.” Sound like a team you want to be a part of? Come build your career with BAE Systems. Our engineers are the lifeblood of our company. With our robust offering of educational and career development opportunities, your chances to grow are limitless.
  
  
Given our continued growth, we have an immediate role available for an experienced and highly motivated Production Support Electrical Engineering Manager to join our team. As a member of the Continued Engineering Services (CES) team, you will have the chance to provide engineering support to the production of complex electronic assemblies and manage a team of electrical engineers, supporting multiple product lines and business areas. You will have the opportunity to work closely with cutting-edge hardware fielded on the most advanced Military Platforms.
  
  
Activities day to day will vary and may include:
  
  
\* Working with multiple Program Management Offices (PMOs) to understand and plan for the Electrical Engineering staffing needs to support production in our Austin Business Center.
  
\* Assignment of Electrical Engineering resources to support various businesses and product lines
  
\* Training and development of the electrical engineering team
  
\* Leading and peer reviewing issue resolution for electrical product defects
  
\* Utilize a metric-based approach to drive product yield and affordability improvements across product lines
  
\* Leading/Supporting transition to production of new products
  
\* Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across multiple sites and states to ensure on time deliveries of quality products to support the War Fighter.
  
  
If you are looking to be immersed in a myriad of new technical challenges, this role is for you! At BAE Systems, we thrive in a diverse, and dynamic team-oriented environment with principles of respect and trust. Our engineers interact with colleagues and peers of various disciplines and backgrounds to arrive at innovative solutions to problems. We encourage collaboration and foster an environment of knowledge sharing and continuous learning. Take the first step towards achieving your career goals with us and apply today!
  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* BSEE from a 4 year accredited school.
* 10+ years experience in HW Engineering with a proven track record of leading multidisciplinary engineering teams through the full product lifecycle (from proposal and design through production and sustainment).
* Demonstrated experience as a direct line people manager with a proven ability to provide daily direction, mentorship, and professional development for junior electrical engineers.
* Strong track record of driving discrete tasks to closure and "owning the design" while managing deadlines and deliverables.
* Experience interfacing with Operations, Quality, and Program Management across multiple sites and states to drive root-cause defect resolution.
* Ability to present complex technical information clearly to internal program teams and external customers.

* Advanced ability to apply electrical engineering principles to solve complex problems involving high-speed digital and RF products.
* Experience in a manufacturing environment, specifically in developing test methodologies to reduce cost, increase yield, and improve throughput.
* Proficient in analyzing test data to identify trends and execute yield improvement plans.
* Expertise in generating and reviewing engineering specifications, drawings, reports, and Engineering Change Orders (ECOs).
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting complex electronic systems, modules, and sub-assemblies in a production environment.
  

  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* MSEE preferred
* Active Secret Clearance HIGHLY PREFERRED
* Exposure to microwave electronics a plus
* Six Sigma Green Belt Certified
  

  
  
**Pay Information**
  
Full-Time Salary Range: $149603 - $254317
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  
  
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**\*This position is contingent upon contract award\***

Amentum is seeking a skilled and driven **Senior Electrical Engineer** to join our engineering team based in Houston, TX. This is a design-focused role that spans the full product lifecycle — from early concept development through hardware design, fabrication, installation, and on-site operation.

The ideal candidate is a licensed or degree-qualified electrical or systems engineer who brings expertise in low voltage electronics, wiring systems, sensor integration, and harness design, and who communicates and collaborates effectively across engineering and operations teams.

This position offers the opportunity to lead and participate in design reviews, work alongside vendors to bring electrical hardware from schematic to reality, and provide direct technical support during field installation and testing. If you are looking for a role where your engineering decisions have real, visible consequences on mission-critical systems, this is the opportunity for you.

This team supports multiple US Navy research and development facilities associated with top priority submarine weapon system development programs. The facilities are one-of-a-kind and provide a capability not found anywhere else in the DoD. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic and fast-paced environment and is willing to tackle problems that span the hardware lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
**Electrical Design & Analysis**

* Lead electrical design efforts from concept development through detailed design, fabrication support, and on-site commissioning.
* Develop and review wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, harness drawings, and interconnect documentation using CAD/EDA tools (AutoCAD Electrical, SOLIDWORKS Electrical, Zuken, or equivalent).
* Perform electrical analysis including power budgets, voltage drop, signal integrity, and harness load calculations to validate designs meet system requirements.
* Evaluate designs for manufacturability, reliability, and compliance with applicable electrical standards and codes.
* Drive projects through the full lifecycle — from initial concept and requirements definition through fabrication, installation, testing, and operational turnover.

**Low Voltage Systems, Sensors & Harnesses**

* Apply engineering expertise in low voltage circuit design, sensor integration, signal conditioning, and wiring harness development for complex system applications.
* Develop and review harness and cable assembly drawings, connector specifications, and routing layouts that comply with applicable workmanship and design standards.
* Troubleshoot low voltage circuits, sensor faults, and harness anomalies using standard test equipment (multimeters, oscilloscopes, data acquisition systems, and signal analyzers).
* Select and specify sensors, connectors, cables, and associated hardware appropriate for the operating environment and system requirements.

**Design Review & Work Package Support**

* Lead and actively participate in formal design reviews (PDR, CDR, and peer reviews), ensuring technical rigor, safety compliance, and design completeness.

jobs.description:

Join the Maverick Power Team!

At Maverick Power, we don’t just build power distribution solutions—we redefine industry standards. Recognized on the 2025 Inc. 5000 list as #16 in the U.S., #2 in Manufacturing, and #1 in Texas, we are committed to driving innovation, quality, and speed. With multiple manufacturing facilities across North Texas and Phoenix, we are expanding rapidly and looking for top talent to grow with us

If you are ready to be part of a high-energy, solutions-driven team where your work makes an impact, Maverick Power is the place for you.

What We Offer:

* Competitive Salary + Bonus Potential!
* Paid Time Off, 401K Matching, Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits!
* High-growth organization with advancement opportunities!
* Diverse, Collaborative, & Fun Work Environment!

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to lead the design, development, and implementation of advanced DC power systems for critical infrastructure, including data centers, telecommunications, and renewable energy applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in electrical engineering, expertise in DC power distribution, and a proven track record of delivering reliable, efficient, and scalable power solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

* System Design & Development: Lead the design of high-efficiency DC power systems, including rectifiers, inverters, battery backup systems, and power distribution units (PDUs) for mission-critical applications.
* Technical Leadership: Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and cross-functional teams, ensuring compliance with industry standards (e.g., IEEE, UL, NEC).
* Project Management: Oversee end-to-end project lifecycles, from requirements gathering and system architecture to testing, commissioning, and maintenance.
* Performance Optimization: Analyze and optimize DC power systems for energy efficiency, reliability, and scalability, integrating renewable energy sources where applicable.
* Troubleshooting & Support: Diagnose and resolve complex power system issues, ensuring minimal downtime for critical operations.
* Vendor Collaboration: Work with suppliers to select and qualify power components, ensuring cost-effectiveness and compatibility with system requirements.
* Documentation: Create detailed technical documentation, including schematics, specifications, and operational manuals.
* Innovation: Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in DC power systems, contributing to R&D initiatives and patent filings as needed.
* Other duties as assigned by supervisor.

Qualifications:

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or related field; master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum of 7 years of experience in DC power systems engineering, with at least 3 years in a senior or lead role.
* Proven expertise in designing and deploying DC power systems for data centers, telecom, or renewable energy applications.
* Proficiency in DC power system design tools (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical, MATLAB, PSpice).
* Deep knowledge of power electronics, battery technologies (e.g., lithium-ion, VRLA), and energy storage systems.
* Familiarity with control systems, SCADA, and BMS for power monitoring and management.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and leadership abilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Certifications: PE license or relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, Six Sigma) preferred.
* Experience with high-voltage DC (HVDC) systems or microgrid integration.
* Knowledge of renewable energy systems (solar, wind) and their integration with DC power infrastructure.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity standards for power systems.

Physical Requirements:

* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift up to twenty-five pounds at times.

Work Environment:  
May work in various settings at the Maverick Power facilities, in offices, in multiple shops, and in commercial buildings. Maintaining the same position or posture while performing tasks and sitting for prolonged periods. jobs.description:
For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, which was built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career!

Our Customer Enablement organization defines semiconductor system requirements, develops technical documentation, and supports internal teams and customers in using our devices.

Do you want to grow with us? At DXP we are passionate about what we do and driven to be the best solution for our industrial customers. Check out our many videos to learn more! http://www.dxpe.com/about-us/careers/

**Electrical Engineer**

**Position Summary**

The electrical engineer is responsible for developing and executing basic and detailed engineering for electrical systems applied to modular process packages and skids in the oil & gas, petrochemical, and power industries. The electrical engineer will combine strong technical electrical design fundamentals, in accordance with applicable international standards and company specifications, senior-level technical decision-making, and mentorship of junior engineers, with the ability to provide hands-on support during shop fabrication and in the field, including direct client interaction during commissioning and after-sales service.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the development and review of one-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, conduit/cable tray installation drawings, and hazardous area classification layouts.
* Perform and validate electrical load calculations, conductor sizing, voltage drop, short circuit, and protective device coordination studies, including review of calculations prepared by junior engineers or sub-contractors.
* Specify and select electrical equipment (transformers, MCCs, VFDs, motor starters, lighting, grounding systems) in accordance with client requirements and applicable standards (NEC, IEEE, NEMA, API RP 500/505).
* Prepare and approve technical specifications, equipment data sheets, and bid packages for electrical equipment and materials.
* Develop and validate hazardous area classifications (Class I Div. 1/2, Zone 1/2) per NEC Articles 500-505, ensuring all specified components meet the required classification.
* Review and approve vendor drawings for conformance with project specifications.
* Serve as the senior technical reference for complex electrical design questions within the team.
* Provide direct technical support to the shop during fabrication, wiring, and testing of skid-mounted electrical systems.
* Resolve field deviations and coordinate engineering changes (redlines/as-builts) during construction.
* Lead or participate in point-to-point checks, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), and continuity/insulation verification prior to shipment.
* Coordinate with the instrumentation, mechanical/piping, and structural teams to ensure proper integration of electrical systems within the skid.
* Provide on-site technical support during installation, commissioning, and start-up of supplied electrical systems.
* Diagnose and resolve complex field electrical issues (troubleshooting) on installed and operating equipment.
* Document field findings and provide feedback to the engineering team for continuous improvement of future designs.
* Train client personnel and junior team engineers on the operation and maintenance of supplied electrical systems.
* Review installation procedures, alignment methods, and start-up protocols.
* Interface with vendors and multidisciplinary teams (process, mechanical, piping, instrumentation and controls, rotating equipment, operations and maintenance teams).
* Develop and update internal specifications, guidelines, engineering standards and best practices related to rotating equipment.
* Maintain technical documentation and lessons learned from equipment operation and failures.
* Provide technical training and mentorship to junior engineers and maintenance staff.
* Issue BOMs and work instruction releases.
* Communicate effectively and consistently with internal and external clients.

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of electrical engineering experience in the oil & gas, petrochemical, or power generation industry, with a demonstrated track record of technical leadership on projects.
* Proven experience designing electrical systems for modular packages/skids.
* Experience with field support/commissioning at industrial sites.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Proficiency in applicable codes and standards: NEC (NFPA 70), IEEE, NEMA, API RP 500/505, IEC (for international projects), and hazardous area classification.
* Proficiency with electrical design tools (AutoCAD Electrical, SKM PowerTools, ETAP, or equivalent short-circuit/coordination software).
* Working knowledge of control systems (PLC/DCS), associated instrumentation, and their interface with electrical systems.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Ability to lead and work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams (process, mechanical, instrumentation, structural).
* Availability to work in the fabrication shop/site as needed (including possible on-site client support).
* Strong technical communication and reporting skills, both written and verbal, including direct senior-level client interaction.
* Practical orientation, independent technical judgment, and problem-solving ability under pressure, both in the office and in the shop/field.
* Ability to interact with vendors and multidisciplinary teams, and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer, Space Systems
jobs.description:
General Atomics (GA), and its affiliated companies, is one of the world’s leading resources for high-technology systems development ranging from the nuclear fuel cycle to remotely piloted aircraft, airborne sensors, and advanced electric, electronic, wireless and laser technologies. General Atomics Electromagnetic Systems (GA-EMS) designs and manufactures first-of-a-kind electromagnetic and electric power generation systems. GA-EMS' expanding portfolio of specialized products and integrated system solutions support critical fleet, space systems and satellites, missile defense, power and energy, and process and monitoring applications for defense, industrial, and commercial customers worldwide.
  
  
We have an exciting opportunity for a Systems Engineer in our Herndon, VA office which is part of our Electromagnetic Systems group. The Herndon team provides innovative, cutting-edge, security solutions for the United States Government. Our employees provide a multi-disciplinary, sometimes non-traditional, approach to generate innovative solutions to incredibly challenging technical problems in the national security arena. Our areas of expertise are in spacecraft payload and system development (especially in the confines of implementing very large amounts of functionality in extremely small, power-constrained environments); unique system development; ground control and operational software development; embedded software development; and unique cyber capabilities. Key customers include the Department of Defense and the Intelligence Community.
  
  
With limited direction, this position exercises considerable latitude in determining technical objectives for the review, research, design, development, and/or solution(s) for a designated engineering system(s) or project(s)/program(s).
  
May function in an advisory or project leadership role providing direction to experienced professional staff.
  
  
**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Formulates plans, typically long term, for solution(s) development, documentation, and deployment, as well as meeting various compliance, reporting, and safety standards.
* Evaluates the integration of the engineering solution within the overall engineering environment; and ensures that appropriate documentation, testing, maintenance, and engineering updates completed.
* Communicates with engineering professionals, solution users, and management throughout the solution development cycle, represents the company as a prime technical contact on contracts and/or projects, interacts with senior external personnel on technical matters requiring coordination between the organizations, and participates in the development of new or expansion of existing business.
* Determines technical objectives for solution(s) to advanced technical engineering problems.
* Represents the organization as a prime technical contact within and engineering team for assigned project(s)/program(s).
* Formulates plans and guides the development and implementation of engineering solution(s) including deployment, resource requirements, testing, documentation, integration and compliance and safety.
* Plans and coordinates the maintenance of engineering solutions including, documentation, reporting, publishing, and making technical and other presentations to ensure viability of the solution(s) in an evolving environment.
* Maintains the strict confidentiality of sensitive information.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
* Responsible for observing all laws, regulations and other applicable obligations wherever and whenever business is conducted on behalf of the Company.
* Expected to work in a safe manner in accordance with established operating procedures and practices.

  
We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply.

Job Qualifications

* Typically requires a bachelors or masters degree in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution and two or more years of engineering experience with a bachelors degree. May substitute equivalent engineering experience in lieu of education.
* Demonstrates a detailed and extensive technical expertise and application of engineering principles, concepts, theory, and practice with the ability to organize, plan, schedule, conduct, and coordinate workloads to meet established deadlines or milestones with some experience in project leadership.
* Must possess the ability to understand new concepts quickly and apply them accurately throughout an evolving environment; strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to effectively interface with other departments, customers, government representatives, and/or professionals; the capability of representing the organization as a prime technical contact; and, the ability to provide leadership and guidance to less experienced professionals.
* Real-world experience with system architecture, requirements tracking, developing and tracking system budgets, and performing system-level analyses in support of trade studies.
* Experience with orbital dynamics, attitude control systems, orbital visualization, and other spacecraft modelling tools.
* Understanding of principles for spacecraft design, build, test, and operation.
* Experience with CONOPS design and mission modeling.
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills are required enabling an effective leadership interface with other departments, all levels of management, professional and support staff, customers, potential customers, and government representatives.
* Customer focused, formulates plans based on the development of innovative new designs in resolving advanced technical engineering problems.
* Must be able to work on a self-initiated basis and in a team environment.
* Able to work extended hours as required.
* US Citizenship is required as is the ability to maintain a Top Secret Security Cleara

Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
