Why This Role Is Critical:

As the need for nuclear energy grows, the future couldn’t be brighter. Join our vital mission to create lasting solutions for our planet’s greatest challenges. In this role, you are ready to shape the future of clean energy and make a long-lasting global impact. With us, anticipate engaging and challenging projects that deliver innovative solutions and value-added technologies helping power more than 38 million North American homes.

In this role you will build and test autonomy and perception features to enhance teleoperated mobile robots for non-destructive inspection. The role blends hands‑on software development with system integration while working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams. You’ll own meaningful subsystems early on and gradually influence how future robots are designed, tested, and deployed.

For more on Framatome robotic solutions, visit https://www.framatome.com/solutions-portfolio/basket/robotics-for-safer-smarter-nuclear-inspection-and-maintenance-2/

What You’ll Do Day-To-Day:

* Independently design, debug, test, and review robotics systems, including hardware-in-the-loop and sim-to-real environments.
* Build, configure, and integrate subsystems responsible for sensor fusion, perception, and remote autonomous deployment.
* Prototype and mature robot localization and state estimation, including visual-inertial odometry and SLAM.
* Develop and tune trajectory planning solutions for mobile robots, leveraging cost maps, planners, and behavior trees.
* Diagnose and resolve issues related to sensor integration, timing, frame inconsistencies, and system failures.
* As you grow in the role, assume ownership of a specific application, including operational and strategic leadership, creating and defending system design, and technical leadership at the interface with internal and external partners.
* As you grow in your role, teach and provide guidance to less experienced software engineers.

What You'll Bring:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
* Minimum of 2 years of related experience.
* Hands-on experience developing and deploying robotics software on Windows and Linux, using Git, package management, logging, profiling, and containerized deployment. Experience with ROS2 is strongly preferred, although not required.
* Direct experience in mobile robotics and one or more of: robotic vision, state estimation and localization, sensor fusion. Other mechanical and electrical engineering experience, as relevant for robotics, is welcome, but not required.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to work effectively with all levels of staff and management.
* Ability to develop and maintain good interpersonal relationships; work collaboratively within a team environment.
* Aptitude to change priorities quickly, confront issues directly and work well as part of a team.

Total Rewards Package:

* **Salary:** $77,000- $100,000, and may also include annual incentives and performance bonuses. The base salary range is a guideline. Individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies and work location.
* **Health & Wellness:** Multiple medical plan options, dental & vision coverage, life insurance, long- and short-term disability, and optional supplemental plans (critical illness, accident, hospital indemnity, dependent life).
* **Retirement:** 401(k) with employer match.
* **Paid Time Off:** Up to 3 weeks of vacation, 8 sick days, and 13 paid holidays annually.
* **Extra Perks:** Lifestyle spending account, employer paid mental health support, education reimbursement, professional development opportunities, adoption assistance, parental leave, and employee assistance programs.

About Framatome:

Framatome has been shaping the future of nuclear energy in the U.S. for more than 60 years. Framatome Inc. is headquartered in Lynchburg, Virginia, with more than 2,400+ employees across North America supporting nearly every nuclear plant in the nation.

From our facilities in Virginia, Washington, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Massachusetts and beyond, we deliver outage services, advanced nuclear fuel technologies, and next-gen reactor innovations that keep the lights on.

At Framatome, you will join a global team committed to creating reliable, carbon-free energy. Here, you can:

* **Solve complex nuclear challenges** that directly impact the climate.
* **Build your career** through technical fellowships, leadership roles, and global opportunities.
* **Do your best work** in a culture that values safety, innovation, and well-being.

Framatome is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including Veterans, and Individuals with Disabilities.

Offers are contingent on background check and drug screen (where applicable). Positions may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control regulations; applicants must meet eligibility requirements (see DOE 810 Appendix A).

jobs.title: Principal Systems Engineer – Space Superiority Missions
jobs.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be availableCLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: YesCLEARANCE TYPE: Top SecretTRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Space Systems in Dulles, Virginia, is seeking an experienced Systems Engineer to join the rapidly growing Space Superiority Division. Space is no longer a sanctuary— it is increasingly contested and operationally complex, and the need for resilient, responsive spacecraft and mission capabilities has never been greater. This is a chance to work on some of the most consequential technical challenges in the space domain and to see your work fly.

You’ll join a cross-disciplinary team that develops, integrates, tests, and delivers advanced spacecraft and mission systems for space security missions, while building expertise in and contributing to Northrop Grumman’s rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO) capabilities. RPO is routine work for this team, backed by hands-on operational experience and a proven on-orbit track record. Northrop Grumman leads the industry in this capability, and joining this team means working alongside the people who helped make that true. As a Systems Engineer, you'll apply systems engineering principles across the full mission lifecycle, from early concept development and analysis through integration, test, launch, and on-orbit mission execution.

Prior space experience is not required, but demonstrated experience developing, integrating, testing, or operating complex technical systems is essential. Some of our strongest engineers came from naval systems, aircraft, missiles, electronics, autonomous vehicles, robotics, and other engineering fields. If you know how to make complex systems work and you want to apply those skills to one of the most important and fastest growing areas of national security, we want to hear from you.

**Primary responsibilities include:**

* Supporting major program milestones and readiness reviews by developing technical content and translating complex information into clear presentations for key stakeholders.
* Authoring and contributing to program data products, systems engineering artifacts, and other critical deliverables.
* Collaborating with mission partners to develop and mature the system with a focus on successful mission execution.
* Supporting the development of new spacecraft or modification of existing spacecraft to enable an accelerated path from concept to launch.
* Developing and applying an understanding of spacecraft operations and design reference missions, particularly missions involving RPO in a contested space domain.
* Developing analysis and modeling tools to evaluate mission concepts and spacecraft performance.
* Managing requirements, including decomposing mission-level objectives into system and subsystem requirements and maintaining traceability throughout the development lifecycle.
* Managing internal and external interfaces, particularly payloads, host vehicles, and RPO sensor suites.

This position is contingent upon the candidate obtaining final clearances and program access(es) within a reasonable period of time determined by the company.

This position is 100% on site.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field and 5 years of applicable experience, or a Master’s Degree and 3 years of applicable experience, or a PhD and 1 years of applicable experience
* Demonstrated experience applying systems engineering principles to the design, development, integration, test, or operation of complex aerospace, defense, or similarly complex technical systems.
* Experience collaborating across multiple engineering disciplines to resolve technical issues and develop integrated system solutions.
* Demonstrated experience performing one or more core systems-engineering functions, such as requirements development and management, interface definition and control, system architecture, mission analysis, mission operations, technical trade studies, or system verification and validation.
* **Requires an active U.S. Government Top Secret clearance at time of application.**

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* An active or current TS/SCI Clearance.

* Experience supporting the design, development, integration, test, or operation of spacecraft or related systems.
* Experience with system architecture and concept of operations (CONOP) development.
* Experience developing technical briefings and communicating complex engineering information to senior technical, program, customer, or executive stakeholders.
* Experience with model-based systems engineering (MBSE).
* Technical experience in one or more of the following areas: orbital mechanics, astrodynamics, or mission design; spacecraft guidance, navigation, and control; relative navigation, sensor fusion, or RPO sensing; spacecraft autonomy and fault management; mission operations, spacecraft operations, or ground systems; avionics, payloads, or digital electronics; RF communications or link analysis; spacecraft integration and test; launch and on-orbit operations; or other technical disciplines applicable to complex space missions.

Bachelor's with 8+ years (or commensurate experience)

* Clearance Required: Top Secret/SCI
* Minimum 5 years of experience performing network/system engineering services for the US Navy
* Experience with unclassified, Secret, and Top Secret networks.
* Experience with SharePoint, Active Directory, MS Visio, Cisco ISE, and DNA Center.

Preferred Skills and Experience

* Experience operating on networks within the Naval Criminal Investigative Service (NCIS)

jobs.title: J2EE Software Engineer
jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton is seeking a **Software Engineer**.

  

**This position is onsite in Herndon, VA.**

  

This role will perform the following but not limited too:

* Conducts research in design, development, testing and utilization of electronic data processing software.
* Designs, develops, documents, tests and debugs applications software and systems that contain logical and mathematical solutions.
* Conducts multidisciplinary research and collaborates with equipment designers and/or hardware engineers in the planning, design, development, and utilization of electronic data processing systems for product and commercial software.
* Determines computer user needs; analyzes system capabilities to resolve problems on program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques and controls; prepares operating instructions; designs and develops compilers and assemblers, utility programs, and operating systems.
* Ensures software standards are met.
* Analyzes user needs and software requirements to determine feasibility of design within time and cost constraints.
* Confers with systems analysts, engineers, programmers, and others to design system and to obtain information on project limitations and capabilities, performance requirements and interfaces.
* Designs, develops, and modifies software systems, using scientific analysis and mathematical models to predict and measure outcomes and consequences of design.
* Coordinates software system installations and monitors equipment functioning to ensure specifications are met.

##### **Qualifications**

* 5 years with BS/BA; 3 years with MS/MA; 0 years with PhD
* Must have Security + certification.
* Must have active clearance or ability to obtain Public Trust
* Must be a U.S. Citizen
* Experience with Java, J2EE software engineering
* Experience with design and development
* Experience with system installations

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $80,000 - $128,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

**Application Statements:** The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

**EEO:** Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**(Job ID# ASM26EE034)**

**Location: Hampton, VA**

**Type: On Site, Full Time**

**Salary Range: $85,000 - 110,000**

**Description**

AS&M has an exciting opportunity for a **Electrical Engineer** to join the team in Hampton, Virginia, supporting the Maintenance Services group for the Center Maintenance, Operations, and Engineering (CMOE) contract at NASA Langley Research Center. This position reports directly to the Electrical Engineering Project Manager.

**Responsibilities**

Performs specific and limited engineering tasks of a broader assignment, under the direction of an experienced engineer.

* Prepare computations, specifications, and report of limited scope and complexity
* Applies standard practices and techniques in specific situations.
* Capable of designing power distribution, lighting, fire alarm, communication systems. General experience in controls and instrumentation, prepare engineering analysis, studies, reports, construction cost estimates and construction troubleshooting.
* Independently make decisions on engineering problems and methods and ability to resolve important technical questions through the use of advanced techniques and the extension or modification of standard practices.
* Conducts analysis and evaluation or design of unique and complex tasks through the development of new or improved methods and procedures.
* Accomplishes assignments by defining requirements, developing criteria, searching for information, developing concepts, coordinating intra or interdisciplinary interfaces and controlling allocated resources.
* May plan, schedule, and coordinate the work of others on a large engineering project or on smaller projects containing many complex features or requiring detailed analysis.
* Perform power distribution system design including high-medium-low voltage substation, utilities and facilities design, substation relaying, protection device coordination analysis using software (ETAP) preferred, adjustable/variable speed controllers design from low to high HP machines.
* Prepare engineering studies, reports, design review presentations, construction cost estimates & construction management services. Knowledge of code compliance.
* General experience in process control and automation. Allen Bradley PLC and LabVIEW experience preferred.
* General experience with AutoCAD, REVIT, MS 365 including MS project.
* PE License preferred.

**Qualifications**

Electrical Engineer degree from an accredited engineering school and three (3) to five (5) years related engineering experience, or MS degree from an accredited engineering school and two (2) to three (3) years of related engineering experience, or Ph.D. from an accredited engineering school.

U.S. Citizenship required.

Valid Real ID compliant identification - www.dhs.gov/real-id

**Work Environment**

Industrial Environment- May be exposed to areas of high noise levels, hazardous propellants, explosives, chemicals, steam, high pressure lines, and industrial facilities (90%)

Travel between various facilities and during test operations may be required and may bring exposure to loud noise and potentially hazardous equipment operation (10%)

**Physical Requirements**

Visual and physical (hands on) contact of industrial related systems, hardware, and articles. Requires climbing, crawling, bending, and body mobility (30%)

Ability to distinguish basic colors (10%) Corrected vision (100%) Hearing (100%)

Requires lifting, carrying, exerting pressure up to 35lbs. (10%)

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Stateful Systems
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **About the work**

Lattice is the software platform behind Anduril's autonomous systems. The Stateful Systems team owns its data layer: the time-series and storage systems that hold every track, sensor reading, and tasking record the platform produces. This runs in the field on real deployments, so performance and reliability here directly affect whether operators can do their jobs.

The team is small and the current focus is a rebuild of the core systems. It's a good time to join if you want a large surface area and real ownership.

### **What you'll do**

* Time-Series: We're redesigning the time-series engine from the ground up to scale horizontally across many writers and nodes. The near-term requirement is concrete: 350+ sensor towers and tens of thousands of camera feeds, ingesting continuously, with both live and historical queries.
* Distributed storage. High-availability durability (WAL replication, leader election), a pluggable storage-engine layer, and a zero-downtime path to migrate between backends.
* Correctness under partition. These systems sometimes run disconnected. Getting consistency and convergence right when the network is unreliable is a central part of the job.
* Hard distributed-systems problems. Consistency models, replication protocols, compaction and deletion at scale, back pressure, and durability guarantees.

### **What we're looking for**

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or relevant field, or equivalent experience
* 6+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on distributed systems or robotics
* Deep experience with Python, Go lang, C++, Rust, or similar systems programming languages
* Solid distributed-systems fundamentals. You can reason about replication, consistency, partition behavior, and failure modes, and explain why a given design does or doesn't converge.
* Production experience building or operating storage engines, databases, or large-scale data infrastructure.
* Comfort in a systems language. Depth matters more than the specific language you've used.
* A bias toward shipping and owning your work. The team is small and what you build is load-bearing.

Nice to have:

* Time-series systems, LSM or B-tree storage internals, or experience with FoundationDB, RocksDB, Pebble, or similar KV stores.
* Experience with systems that run in resource-constrained or intermittently-connected environments.

  

### **Why join**

You get the ownership and pace of an early team, with a redesign in front of you and a lot of latitude to shape the architecture, backed by a real mission and the resources to do it well. The team is small enough that your work is visible and matters, and we put effort into supporting the people on it.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
  + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
  + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately

jobs.title: Automation Controls Engineer, Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services' Hardware Engineering team is looking for experienced professionals to help build the world's premier cloud computing platform. The Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering team designs, validates, and deploys automation solutions, including robotics, cobots, vision inspection, AI-powered quality systems, and automated assembly workflows, across contract manufacturer sites worldwide.  
  
About the Role: You will define the controls and electrical systems architecture for all automated assembly lines, creating the standard control platform that scales across all platforms and all contract manufacturer sites. You own PLC programming standards, HMI development frameworks, safety system architecture, and industrial network design. You define how automated cells communicate with each other, with MES, and with data collection systems. You are the architect of the nervous system that connects every robot, sensor, actuator, and inspection system into a coordinated, data-generating production line. You establish reusable control system templates that ensure consistency and reduce deployment time globally.  
  
The scope covers all server and rack assembly across all architectures and platforms, including compute, AI/ML accelerators, storage, and networking. The team designs intelligent, predictive-analytics-driven production systems where every station is sensor-driven, AI-optimized, and self-correcting, turning assembly lines into programmable, data-generating platforms that scale capacity without scaling headcount. This role requires the engineer to operate in a fast-paced, multi-platform international manufacturing environment with travel to contract manufacturer sites (up to 25-30% travel anticipated).  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define controls systems architecture: PLC programming standards, HMI frameworks, safety system design, network topology
* Design and program PLC-based control systems for automated assembly lines
* Develop standardized HMI interfaces for operator interaction and production monitoring
* Architect industrial network infrastructure (e.g., EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT) for automated lines
* Design safety system architecture per ISO 13849 and IEC 62443 (functional safety and cybersecurity)
* Create reusable control system templates and code libraries for global deployment standardization
* Define MES integration specifications and data exchange protocols between automation cells and enterprise systems
* Lead controls architecture reviews for automation projects and vendor-supplied systems

  
About the team  
About the team: The Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering team is building a centralized automation Center of Excellence that owns the process specification and IP for how AWS hardware gets assembled. The team is responsible for engineering, defining automated process requirements, designing and proving solutions at proof-of-concept, and maintaining AWS-owned intellectual property that scales globally. The team works within a collaborative framework across Hardware Engineering (product design for automation), Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering (process specification and validation), and Manufacturing Operations (deployment and scaling), ensuring automation is engineered once, proven once, and deployed everywhere.

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent
* 7+ years designing industrial control systems for automated manufacturing
* Proficiency in PLC programming (e.g., Siemens TIA Portal, Allen-Bradley Studio 5000, Beckhoff TwinCAT)
* Experience with industrial safety system design (e.g., ISO 13849, safety PLCs, safety networks)
* Experience with industrial network protocols (e.g., EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT, OPC-UA)
* Track record of defining control system standards for multi-site deployment

* Experience with MES integration and manufacturing data exchange
* HMI/SCADA development experience (e.g., Ignition, WinCC, FactoryTalk)
* Industrial cybersecurity knowledge (e.g., IEC 62443)
* Experience with servo motion control and multi-axis coordination
* Electronics, server, or precision hardware manufacturing environment

jobs.title: Datacenter Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**  

Cloud Operations + Innovation (CO+I) is the organization that builds, operates, and continuously evolves the infrastructure behind the Microsoft Cloud, powering services used by more than 95% of Fortune 500 companies. CO+I is responsible for the full datacenter lifecycle from global planning and site acquisition through design, construction, deployment, operations, and eventual decommissioning, spanning 400+ datacenters across more than 70 Azure regions, connected by over 600,000 kilometers of fiber. As the engine that enables Microsoft’s cloud-first mission, CO+I delivers reliable, trusted, secure, and sustainable cloud and AI infrastructure, ensuring capacity is available on time, every time, to meet customer growth and support Microsoft’s broader mission to empower every person and organization to achieve more.

The Systems Engineering, Test, and Integration (SETI) team serves as Microsoft's technical proving ground for next-generation datacenter infrastructure. As a **Datacenter Electrical Engineer** in SETI, you will evaluate emerging power and electrical infrastructure technologies, determine whether they can meet Microsoft's requirements for reliability, scalability, and operational readiness, and help mature promising concepts into deployment-ready solutions. Projects may include medium-voltage architectures, HVDC distribution, power electronics, energy storage systems, advanced protection schemes, grid-interactive technologies, and other first-of-a-kind infrastructure innovations.

Success in this role requires more than technical analysis. You will be expected to define ambiguous problems, design and execute validation strategies, identify technical and operational risks, work directly with suppliers and internal engineering teams, and provide clear recommendations that influence Microsoft's long-term datacenter architecture. Our team is expected to develop evidence-based recommendations regarding technology readiness, deployment suitability, technical risks, and investment priorities. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on learning quickly, solving complex technical problems, and helping Microsoft make informed decisions about the future of datacenter infrastructure.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Employees come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize shared goals. We build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive.

  
**Responsibilities**

* Evaluate, develop, and integrate next-generation electrical infrastructure technologies for Microsoft's datacenter portfolio.
* Define system requirements, technical specifications, architectures, interfaces, and verification strategies for emerging power and infrastructure solutions.
* Develop design documentation, engineering specifications, schematics, analysis, and technical recommendations that support technology maturation and deployment.
* Create and execute test, validation, and verification plans to assess system performance, reliability, scalability, and operational readiness.
* Perform technical due diligence on new technologies, supplier solutions, and industry developments to inform engineering and deployment decisions.
* Analyze complex technical issues using modeling, testing, data analysis, and root cause investigation to improve system performance and reliability.
* Evaluate design alternatives and make engineering recommendations based on technical performance, risk, cost, schedule, reliability, and operational impact.
* Collaborate with internal engineering teams, suppliers, partners, and research organizations to develop and mature new electrical infrastructure solutions.
* Support prototype development, laboratory testing, and system integration activities for first-of-a-kind infrastructure technologies.
* Embody our culture and values.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required/ Minimum Qualifications:**

* Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field AND 3+ years power systems and utility experience in mission critical environment OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field AND 5+ years power systems and utility experience in mission critical environment OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements:**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Additional/Preferred qualifications:**

* Doctorate in Electrical Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years power systems and utility experience in mission critical environment OR Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, or related field AND 8+ years power systems and utility experience in mission critical environment OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineeringor related field AND 12+ years power systems and utility experience in mission critical environment OR equivalent experience.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license.
* Experience with power system modeling and analysis tools such as PSCAD, PSS®E, or similar platforms.
* Experience with datacenter electrical infrastructure, critical power systems, utility-scale power systems, or industrial power systems.
* Experience with power distribution, power electronics, HVDC, medium-voltage systems, energy storage, protection systems, or emerging power architectures.
* Experience developing technical specifications, design documentation, testing, or verification plans for complex electrical systems.
* Experience evaluating, integrating, or qualifying new technologies and translating them into scalable, deployment-ready solutions.

* Work effectively with globally distributed teams and contribute to consistent design and architectural improvements.

**What You Will Bring:**

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience, in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 5+ years of professional experience developing embedded or firmware software.
* Strong C++ programming skills, including object-oriented design, memory management, concurrency fundamentals, debugging, and writing maintainable production code.
* Hands-on experience developing software that interacts with hardware, real-time systems, device interfaces, or resource-constrained embedded platforms.
* Proven ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and codebases independently, break down ambiguous problems, and deliver results with minimal guidance.
* Experience with embedded development and diagnostic tools such as debuggers, emulators, protocol or logic analyzers, and system logs.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions, raise risks, and collaborate across functions.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a real-time operating system and multi-threaded or concurrent software.
* Experience with hardware bring-up, board-level debugging, device drivers, communication protocols, or FPGA and firmware integration.
* Experience working in a regulated, safety-critical, or quality-controlled product-development environment.
* Experience working in Agile teams and planning work through user stories and iterative delivery.

This role is considered an on-site position located in **Waukesha, WI**

jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a software engineer who is fluent in numerical computing to build the software foundation of our electromagnetic warfare product line. Our Spectrum Sensing team is transforming CHAOS radar systems into distributed sensing systems that detect, classify, and geolocate RF emissions — and the algorithms that do it only matter if they run correctly, quickly, and reliably in production.

This is a software engineering role first. You will own how our numerical and signal processing code is architected, integrated, tested, and accelerated. You do not need a background in RF or radar; you do need to be the person on the team who knows why a Python implementation is slow, what to do about it, and how to build a codebase that other engineers can safely extend. You will work alongside signal processing and RF engineers who supply the algorithms, and you will be the reason those algorithms become dependable software.

**Responsibilities:**

As a key contributor to the Spectrum Sensing team, you will shape the software architecture and engineering practices behind our sensing stack. The day-to-day will be diverse, engaging, and intellectually stimulating, with direct impact on pushing the boundaries of sensing technology and application. Key responsibilities include:

* Design, develop, and maintain production-quality numerical software in Python, with an emphasis on clear interfaces, composability, and long-term maintainability
* Integrate third-party software and hardware into the CHAOS platform via APIs, and own the abstractions that keep those integrations from leaking into the rest of the codebase
* Profile and accelerate signal processing implementations — through vectorization, array-programming frameworks, JIT compilation, GPU offload, or bindings to compiled code — and quantify the improvement
* Define and drive test and CI hygiene for numerical code: numerical regression tests, tolerance and reproducibility strategy, property-based and reference-implementation testing, and automation that catches breakage before a field demonstration does
* Partner with signal processing engineers to turn algorithms from papers, prototypes, and MATLAB into software that ships
* Contribute to overall software architecture decisions for the sensing product line, including how components compose across the platform
* This role will require periodic travel, up to 30%

**Minimum Requirements:**

* B.S. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related field
* 5+ years of professional software development experience
* Demonstrated proficiency in Python for numerical computing, including writing, maintaining, testing, and debugging production-quality codebases — not analysis scripts or notebooks alone
* Strong command of array-based numerical computing (NumPy, SciPy, or equivalent), including an understanding of where and why Python performance breaks down
* Demonstrated experience making numerical code fast through at least one of: array/tensor DSLs and JIT compilation (JAX, Numba, PyTorch, Triton, Halide, or similar), GPU-accelerated computing (CUDA or equivalent), or bindings between Python and compiled languages (pybind11, nanobind, Cython, or similar)
* Demonstrated experience contributing to a large, multi-team codebase — working within existing architecture, navigating unfamiliar code, and shipping changes that other teams depend on
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: version control workflow, code review, automated testing, and CI
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly document technical details and present findings
* Must be able to work on-site 4 days per week in Washington, D.C.
* U.S. citizen
* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance

**Preferred Requirements**

* M.S. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field
* Meaningful open-source contributions to numerical, scientific computing, or signal processing software (we will read your commit history, not just your repository list)
* Exposure to digital signal processing — filtering, FFT-based processing, detection and estimation, or beamforming — whether from coursework, research, or industry
* Experience with software-defined radios (SDRs) or associated signal processing toolkits (e.g., GNU Radio)
* Experience with real-time, streaming, or throughput-constrained data processing systems
* Experience designing APIs or libraries consumed by other engineering teams
* Familiarity with MATLAB, sufficient to read and port existing algorithm prototypes
* Current U.S. security clearance
* Experience with agile development tools like JIRA and Confluence
* Experience in DoD, military, or other Government environment in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

new_jobs.title: Hardware Engineer (Electrical)
new_jobs.description:
Navi captures everything a pilot sees and hears. The Wave is how we do it — the hardware that lives in the cockpit, captures flight data, and streams it to the cloud in real time. You're building the next generation of that device.

**About the role**
==================

This is a founding hardware role. You own the entire physical product — from bare-metal architecture through PCB design, ruggedized enclosure, embedded firmware, environmental certification, fleet deployment, and cloud integration. This is Version 2 of the Wave, and you are the definitive technical voice for every decision that shapes it.

The device has to survive cockpit environments — heat, vibration, RF noise — while continuously streaming high-bandwidth audio and telemetry over wireless networks without dropping a frame. It has to be deployable across hundreds of aircraft and manageable as a fleet. It has to meet certification standards for operating in aircraft. And it has to be built fast, because Navi is already live at flight schools and the U.S. Air Force and demand is accelerating.

If you thrive in high-autonomy environments and love building mission-critical edge devices that work in the real world — not on a bench — this is your role.

**What you'll do**
==================

* Lead the end-to-end technical design of Navi's next-generation edge compute node — architecture, component selection, PCB layout, and mechanical enclosure
* Build hardware that is ruggedized for cockpit environments — thermal, vibrational, and environmental stress — and optimized for continuous wireless data transmission
* Architect real-time data pipelines for processing and streaming high-fidelity audio and complex telemetry from the edge to the cloud with minimal latency
* Own the hardware validation lifecycle — environmental testing, quality assurance, and securing regulatory and industry-specific certifications for hardware operating in aircraft
* Develop and oversee embedded firmware and edge processing logic — real-time operating systems, on-device compute, and fleet-wide OTA update infrastructure
* Guide the architecture of live cloud-based telemetry dashboards to ensure seamless data ingestion and real-time visibility from deployed devices
* Collaborate with software and ML engineers to ensure the hardware captures exactly what the intelligence layer needs to generate automated debriefs

**About you**
=============

* 7+ years of experience in systems engineering, embedded edge compute, or connected hardware development — with a track record of bringing a complex device to market, not just prototyping one
* Deep understanding of electronics design — PCB schematics, microcontrollers, wireless communication modules (cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth)
* Experience collaborating with industrial or mechanical designers to build ruggedized enclosures that survive challenging thermal, vibrational, and environmental conditions
* Strong proficiency in embedded C/C++ or Python for edge applications, with experience running RTOS or embedded Linux
* Familiarity with edge-to-cloud architecture, device fleet management, and building scalable live data infrastructure
* Hands-on experience navigating rigorous hardware certification processes and environmental testing standards
* You own projects end to end in ambiguous, fast-moving environments — and you ship

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience with edge processing and lossless streaming of high-bandwidth data — real-time audio, complex signal processing, or continuous telemetry
* Background building hardware for aviation, defense, or other safety-critical regulated industries
* Familiarity with avionics data formats, cockpit audio systems, or aircraft electrical environments

**Why this role matters**
=========================

Every piece of intelligence Navi generates starts with the Wave. The AI is only as good as the data the hardware captures — and in a cockpit, there are no second chances. A dropped audio frame is a missed instructor callout. A connectivity gap is a blind spot in the debrief. You're building the device that makes the entire platform possible, and it has to work perfectly every single flight.

**What you'll get**
===================

* Flight training — earn your pilot's license and build with true domain expertise
* Impact you can see — the device you build will be in cockpits at flight schools, airlines, and the U.S. Air Force
* A role that scales into hardware leadership as we grow

**How we work**
===============

* **Find a way.** We don't wait for permission or perfect information. Ideas come from anywhere regardless of title. Figure it out, ship it, iterate.
* **Creativity over control.** First principles over process. We'd rather have a creative solution that's 80% right today than a perfect one next quarter.
* **Update fast.** Come in with a hypothesis, throw it away when the data says otherwise. Ego has no place here.
* **Intensity with focus.** We work hard because the mission demands it. Clarity on what matters is how we make that sustainable.

### **About Subsense**

Subsense is a deep-tech company developing the world’s first non-surgical, bidirectional brain-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. Our mission is to unlock direct communication between the human brain and AI - starting with medical applications such as stroke recovery and moving toward cognitive enhancement for healthy users. Headquartered in Palo Alto, Subsense brings together leading scientists and engineers to redefine the future of human–machine interaction.

### **The Opportunity**

Design and develop electronics and integrated hardware for emerging neurotechnology and medical-device systems. Initial work may include focused ultrasound platforms, while the role is expected to support and adapt to other stimulation, sensing, and experimental hardware approaches as technical needs evolve. You will take hardware from early concepts and laboratory prototypes through characterization, verification, and preparation for manufacturing. Working closely with specialists in neuroscience, mechanical engineering, and software, you will translate experimental requirements into reliable, measurable system performance.

This role suits a hands-on engineer who enjoys building and troubleshooting hardware, working across disciplines, and making sound engineering decisions as requirements evolve.

### **What You'll Own**

* Design drive, control, and interface electronics for neurotechnology and medical-device systems, including waveform generation, power amplification, impedance matching, sensing, and transducer or actuator interfaces.
* Develop analog, digital, and mixed-signal circuits, owning schematic capture, PCB layout collaboration, board bring-up, and debugging.
* Translate application and experimental requirements into electrical specifications, including operating frequency, output power, timing, duty cycle, channel synchronization, and sensing requirements.
* Integrate transducers or other stimulation/sensing hardware, power supplies, embedded controllers, sensors, and software into working prototypes.
* Build automated test setups to characterize electrical performance, transducer loading, efficiency, thermal behavior, and repeatability.
* Partner with acoustics specialists to correlate electrical measurements with acoustic output and identify the causes of performance variation.
* Implement monitoring, fault detection, interlocks, and protective circuitry appropriate to the device’s intended use.
* Document design decisions, test methods, and verification results; contribute to risk analysis and design reviews.
* Work with suppliers and manufacturing partners to improve component selection, assembly, testability, and reliability.

### **Who You Are**

### **Must-have experience**

* Master’s degree in electrical engineering, biomedical engineering with a strong electronics focus, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience developing electronics for medical devices, neurotechnology, instrumentation, or related experimental hardware systems; experience with ultrasound systems is a plus.
* Strong grounding in analog and mixed-signal design, power electronics, signal integrity, grounding, and noise reduction.
* Experience designing drive, interface, or impedance-matching circuits for transducers, actuators, sensors, or other electrically driven hardware, with an understanding of how electrical loading affects system performance.
* Ability to take a PCB from schematic through bring-up and systematic troubleshooting.
* Proficiency with oscilloscopes, signal generators, and relevant impedance, network, or spectrum measurement equipment.
* Experience using Python, MATLAB, or similar tools for instrument control, data analysis, and test automation.
* Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into practical experiments and clearly communicate findings across engineering and scientific teams.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience with focused ultrasound, neuromodulation, neural interfaces, bioelectronic systems, or other therapeutic or diagnostic medical-device technologies.
* Multichannel or phased-array systems, beamforming electronics, and precise phase and amplitude control.
* FPGA, microcontroller, or embedded firmware development for waveform generation, timing, and system control.
* Low-noise receive electronics, transmit/receive switching, or ultrasound signal acquisition.
* Experience with system characterization and calibration, such as hydrophone measurements, acoustic field mapping, electro-acoustic calibration, or analogous measurement methods for other sensing/stimulation modalities.

### **Why You’ll Thrive**

You'd be joining a small team developing a non-surgical, bidirectional brain-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. You’ll help translate early research into working technology, with the opportunity to influence both the platform and how we build it.

**A few things that make this different:**

* **Own meaningful technical work:** Take projects from early R&D through functional prototypes, with room to test ideas, solve complex problems, and shape design decisions.
* **Build across disciplines:** Work hands-on with ultrasound, electronics, and instrumentation alongside scientists and engineers in neuroscience, nanotechnology, and AI.
* **Help shape a novel platform:** Contribute to technology with the potential to restore neurological function and, over time, enable direct brain-to-AI communication.
* **Make a visible impact:** Join a team where your contributions directly influence technical progress, with equity that lets you share in the company’s growth.

Our work takes place across labs in Palo Alto and Mountain View. We offer a competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k), commuter benefits, and paid time off.

Hardware

**About Sesame**

Sesame believes in a future where computers are lifelike - with the ability to see, hear, and collaborate with us in ways that feel natural and human. With this vision, we're designing a new kind of computer, focused on making voice agents part of our daily lives. Our team brings together founders from Oculus and Ubiquity6, alongside proven leaders from Meta, Google, and Apple, with deep expertise spanning hardware and software. Join us in shaping a future where computers truly come alive.

**About the Role**

We're building smart wearables where the speaker gets a fraction of a cubic centimeter and has to be loud at the ear and quiet to everyone around you. We're looking for a Speaker Systems Engineer to own the speaker system in our products end to end: choosing and specifying the transducers, designing the acoustic path around them in very little space, setting their limits and protection, partnering with the Audio Lead on tuning, and getting them built and tested at volume.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the speaker path of a shipping consumer electronics product, from transducer selection through enclosure design and factory test
* Translate product-level requirements into speaker system and transducer requirements: bandwidth, level, distortion, leakage, and power budget in the volume available.
* Select, specify, and qualify speakers with suppliers, including evaluation of new and unconventional transducer technologies where they fit the product better than a conventional driver.
* Design and simulate the acoustic path: back volume, ports and leaks, front acoustics, open-ear leakage control, mesh and sealing, in close partnership with mechanical and industrial design.
* Build and measure prototypes; characterize frequency response, distortion, maximum output, far-field leakage, and excursion and thermal limits, and turn the results into design changes and better models.
* Own speaker limits and protection parameters; partner with the Audio Lead on tuning and with firmware on implementation.
* Work with the audio DSP team to minimize speaker-to-mic coupling through the frame.
* Qualify the speaker system for reliability: sweat and ingress, temperature and humidity, drop, mesh clogging, and drift over life.
* Set up and maintain speaker measurement methods in the lab and at the factory, including golden units, limits, and end-of-line acoustic test.
* Support builds and factory ramps, root-cause acoustic yield and quality issues, and drive fixes with suppliers and the CM.
* Work with the cross-functional team (EE, ME, FW, PD) to trade off acoustic performance against size, cost, and power.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Acoustics, Physics, or similar.

* 5+ years of experience integrating speakers into consumer electronics hardware, with at least one shipped product where you owned the speaker system.
* Strong grounding in electroacoustics: lumped-parameter modeling, Thiele/Small parameters, enclosure and port design, and the behavior of small drivers at their limits.
* Hands-on experience specifying and qualifying miniature speakers with transducer suppliers.
* Extensive experience with audio test systems (e.g., SoundCheck, Klippel, Audio Precision) and with measuring distortion, maximum SPL, and rub-and-buzz.
* A record of using acoustic simulation (lumped-parameter and FEM, e.g., COMSOL) to make design decisions, checked against measured hardware.
* Working knowledge of speaker tuning and protection (EQ, limiting, excursion and thermal protection) and how to partner with a DSP team on it.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Masters or Ph.D. in EE, ME, Acoustics, or related disciplines.
* 8+ years of experience in speaker or transducer development for consumer electronics.
* Experience with wearables, hearables, or other products where the speaker sits close to the ear and the acoustic volume is measured in fractions of a cubic centimeter, including open-ear designs.
* Hands-on experience with a range of transducer technologies beyond conventional moving-coil drivers, and a view on where each one fits.
* Transducer design experience: motor, diaphragm, and suspension design, or close work with a supplier’s design team.
* Proficiency in a high-level programming language (e.g., MATLAB, Python) for measurement automation and analysis.
* Familiarity with human perception of sound and psychoacoustic evaluation of speech quality and intelligibility.
* Experience with factory acoustic test development and yield analysis at a contract manufacturer.

Sesame is committed to a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We welcome all qualified applicants, embracing diversity in race, gender, identity, orientation, ability, and more. We provide reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Contact careers@sesame.com for assistance.

**Full-time Employee Benefits:**

* 401 (k) max employer match: 3.5% of compensation
* 100% employer-paid health, vision, and dental benefits for you and your dependents
* Unlimited PTO and sick time
* Flexible spending account with employer matching up to $1,650/year (medical FSA)
* Guardian Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Opportunity to share in the company's success with competitive stock options

Benefits do not apply to contingent/contract workers.

Compensation Range: $175K - $280K

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software
new_jobs.description:
Meta designs and deploys its own AI systems. MTIA — the Meta Training and Inference Accelerator — is Meta's family of in-house AI accelerator ASICs, running recommendation and ranking workloads in production across Meta's data centers today and expanding into generative AI inference and training as successive silicon generations land (see [https://bit.ly/metamtia](https://bit.ly/metamtia)).The MTIA Software team is part of the \*\*AI & Compute Foundation (ACF)\*\* organization within Meta Infrastructure. Because the hardware is ours, the software is ours too: we build the entire stack a chip vendor would normally supply — compiler and LLVM toolchain, runtime, kernel authoring frameworks and libraries, developer tooling, and deep PyTorch integration — and we co-design it with the silicon teams generation over generation.Within that stack, the AI kernel and optimization software development team drives the layer where architecture meets arithmetic. Our mission is performance \*and\* programmability at scale: hit roofline enablements on the workloads that matter, and make kernel authoring accessible enough that the whole organization can close coverage gaps without funneling every problem through a handful of experts. We do this by shipping high-performance kernel libraries with broad PyTorch operator coverage, by building the C++ and Python kernel authoring frameworks and DSL surfaces that others build on, and by writing production kernels against new architectures long before first silicon — turning hardware proposals into measured roofline evidence while the design can still change.We are hiring an experienced kernel and performance engineer to take on this role at a senior level. You will own the performance of workloads that serve billions of people, from the innermost loop of a fused attention kernel to the numeric decisions that determine whether a model converges. You will read hardware specifications and RTL-adjacent documentation as easily as you read code, and you will be expected to say clearly when the hardware — not the software — is the problem. Your findings will change what gets built next.This is a hands-on engineering role with wide latitude. The problems aren't incremental.## What you'll work on- \*\*Roofline-level kernels.\*\* GEMM and attention variants, normalization, collectives, elementwise and reduction fusions, sparse and quantized paths — implemented against novel architectural features (matrix engines, on-chip reduction fabrics, software-managed memory hierarchies) and tuned until the remaining gap to the machine's limit is explainable in a sentence.- \*\*Numerics under precision constraints.\*\* Low-precision formats (FP8, MX-style block-scaled types, integer quantization) where the difference between a correct scale choice and a plausible one is several decibels of signal, and where the fix has to work on silicon that has already been taped out.- \*\*Kernel authoring frameworks.\*\* Templateized, composable C++ kernel SDKs in the spirit of CUTLASS, Python DSLs in the spirit of Triton and CuTe, and the compiler-facing interfaces that let automated codegen reach performance that used to require a specialist.- \*\*Pre-silicon and bring-up.\*\* Kernels on simulators and emulators, validating architectural features and rooflines before tapeout, then first-light bring-up on real parts.- \*\*Software mitigations for hardware realities.\*\* Every chip ships with something you wish were different. Finding the workaround that recovers most of the lost performance — and generalizing it so nobody rediscovers it — is core to the job.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software Responsibilities:**

* Design, implement, and optimize high-performance compute and communication kernels for MTIA accelerators, taking ownership from architectural analysis through production deployment
* Profile and root-cause performance across the full stack — instruction scheduling, memory hierarchy and DMA behavior, on-chip interconnect, multi-device collectives — and drive the fixes to the right layer, whether that is the kernel, the compiler, the runtime, or the hardware
* Build and extend kernel authoring frameworks, templates, and libraries so that other engineers can reach high performance without deep architectural expertise
* raise the ceiling and lower the floor at the same time
* Deliver and maintain broad kernel coverage for PyTorch operators across recommendation, ranking, and generative AI workloads, in both eager and compiled execution paths
* Partner with silicon architecture and design teams on hardware/software co-design: quantify the value of proposed features with real kernels, characterize rooflines pre-silicon, and advocate for the changes the software stack actually needs
* Work with compiler, runtime, framework, and product-facing teams to land end-to-end wins on production models rather than isolated microbenchmark improvements
* Investigate numerics and precision trade-offs, and design software mitigations that recover performance or accuracy lost to hardware limitations
* Set technical direction for a kernel domain, write the design documents that align cross-functional partners, and mentor engineers on performance methodology and accelerator programming

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Proficiency in C++ and Python, including low-level systems programming, templates and generic programming, and comfort reading and writing performance-critical code
* Demonstrated experience writing and optimizing kernels for a parallel architecture — GPU (CUDA, ROCm/HIP, SYCL/OpenCL), TPU or other AI ASICs, or SIMD/vector CPU targets
* Working knowledge of computer architecture as it applies to performance: memory hierarchies and bandwidth, latency hiding, occupancy and scheduling, vectorization, and synchronization

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.

  
  
**What you'll do**  
  
  

We are looking for an Information Assurance (IA) Systems Security Engineer who is eager to contribute to a small, fast-paced team! You will have a systems architecture background to support security design and certification on U.S. Government High Assurance communications programs. Provide technical support and oversight as part of a program team's system engineering effort for IA design and development, including security architecture analysis, security requirements definition and allocation and identification of potential security vulnerabilities. Requires generation of security-related documentation per Department of Defense (DOD) standards and leading system security architecture design in a team environment. Background in High Assurance (NSA) Communications Security (COMSEC) and Transmission Security (TRANSEC) design, certification requirements and techniques are required. High Assurance Computer Security (COMPUSEC) requirements background a plus. Support for new security related business development, including proposals, white papers, and presentations, as well as interfacing with Government customers, is required.

  
  
**The day-to-day**  
  
  

* Derive, develop and document system, software and hardware requirements from customer specifications
* Own system requirements and system design activities on next generation network encryption devices
* Prepare system level material and present at internal and customer reviews
* Work with Agile scrum teams to identify develop and prioritize spiral based product features
* Knowledge of model based system engineering practices (CAMEO) desired
* Collaborate with large geographically diverse multi-disciplinary teams to create next generation products
* Generate and collaborate on required design documents, development requirements, specifications and verification protocols
* Support qualification of new design by supporting an reviewing system test activities

  
**What you'll need**  
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in Engineering Discipline
* 5+ years communication systems design experience
* Deep understanding of system engineering processes from requirements to test with experience in managing process activities
* Strong understanding of networking protocols highly desired
* Must be able to prioritize, be detail oriented, and have history of managing time well to accomplish multiple tasks in parallel
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, ability to work with a temporally and geographically diverse team
* Ability to document and report on technical solutions/findings
* Good working knowledge of MS Office products for documentation creation and modification
* Desire to be part of a multidisciplinary team to evaluate and troubleshoot production related issues
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, take ownership of tasks and results
* US citizenship and current SECRET security clearance is required
* Ability to travel up to 10%
* Must be able to work out of our offices in Carlsbad, CA, Tempe, AZ, Linthicum Heights, MD or Marlborough, MA.

  
**What will help you on the job**  
  
  

* System security design experience with focus on NSA related efforts, including cryptographic engine embedment
* Strong system, software, or test background including design and implementation
* Familiarity with design and certification to the latest NSA security requirements and specifications, as well as working knowledge of NSA High Assurance Device (Formerly Type 1) certification and documentation requirements
* Familiarity with NIST and FIPS 140-2 Design and Certification

* Support debugging of hardware/software integration issues

* Contribute to software documentation, interface definitions, and test procedures

* Familiarity with C/C++ programming
* Exposure to Linux development environments
* Understand code and source repository management
* Basic understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, UDP, sockets, etc.)
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment
* Must be clearance eligible and able to maintain an active Secret Clearance or higher

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer - Simulation Integration and Test
new_jobs.description:
York Space Systems was founded to radically improve spacecraft affordability and reliability, transforming, and enabling next- generation space mission operations worldwide. Today, York is one of the most innovative aerospace companies, specializing in end-to-end customer solutions and the rapid production of spacecraft platforms. York’s complete Space Segment Solution includes spacecraft production, payload integration, system integration & test, launch services, ground segment services, and mission operations, enabling customers to leverage York’s existing technology solutions to get to orbit rapidly and responsively. We’re looking to expand our team across the board.
  
  
York is seeking a talented and enthusiastic Software Engineer to join the Simulation, Integration and Test Department with a passion for launching hardware into space and a desire to revolutionize the space industry. Our ideal candidate thrives in a highly collaborative environment and enjoys finding ways to innovate and make processes more efficient.
  
This team builds new simulation capabilities, proves they are correct, and authors the mission scenarios that exercise them. In this role you will write the models that stand in for a real spacecraft, including the dynamics, the avionics interfaces, and the telemetry, and you will be responsible for their accuracy. When a regression test passes against your simulator, the flight software team needs to be able to trust that result. You will work closely with the Systems Architecture and FSW teams as new vehicle components come online, building the simulation capability to match and validating that it behaves the way the real hardware does.
  
  
Responsibilities
  

* Develop and maintain the physics simulator, improving both model fidelity and runtime performance
* Develop new simulation capabilities in step with new vehicle components, and validate that they model real behavior correctly
* Author, develop, and integrate mission test scenarios, including fault and off-nominal cases
* Build and maintain interface emulator logic
* Model telemetry accurately enough to support meaningful regression testing
* Support and extend development targeting the hardware interface with the simulation environment
* Collaborate with the Systems Architecture and FSW teams on new component development
* Collaborate with other teams on simulation health
* Support internal users directly and incorporate their feedback into the simulation models
* Follow SIT software development processes to ensure fast and quality releases

new_jobs.description:

widget: Full-Time

Other

No - Teleworking not available for this position

$103977.88-$173296.47

  

### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

Serco seeks a **Simulation Systems and Test Engineer** for its Combat Air Force Distributed Mission Operations (CAF DMO) 3.0 program in Orlando, FL. The CAF DMO 3.0 program, via its Distributed Mission Operations Network (DMON), provides world-class integration training in large force and small team formats to combat units around the globe against cutting-edge threats in a boundless virtual battlespace. The U.S. Air Force can only utilize its full capability against modern threats in a virtual environment. Be a part of that environment and continue to make the USAF the best air force in the world.

You will be part of a focused team of engineers to perform test, integration, and evaluation of disparate M&S systems and applications to support 5th and 6th generation training interoperability.

The team will work closely with the DoD customer and other Serco teams at Langley AFB and Orlando, FL to deliver quality test services.

**In this role, you will:**

* Support military simulation system and application integration, evaluation, and interoperability test to support DMON and JSE training operations.
* Use industry-standard tools for simulation test and evaluation to include Wireshark, simulation protocol analysis, and GFE and Commercial Computer Generated Forces (CGFs).
* Assist in detailed analysis of network and computational system performance including latency, bandwidth, jitter, and system occupancy measures.
* Help develop and maintain test plans and procedures to document and drive test activities.
* Draft comprehensive test reports based on completed integration, test, evaluation, and verification tasks performed.
* Assist in the development of CONOPS and multiple COAs for implementation and deployment of the evaluated simulation capabilities.
* Contribute to other areas of the engineering life cycle to include requirements review and assessment, training operations support, and basic system administration functions.
* Produce well-defined, concise, and directed test procedures and test cases under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Support program and team processes by using tools from the Atlassian Suite of products to include JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket, Bamboo, and X-Ray.
* Participate in peer reviews, test bed maintenance and updates, and programming, testing, and debugging activities.
* Write and maintain scripts and support application (PowerShell, Cygwin, VBasic, etc.) programs, to enable efficiencies in test artifact creation and task execution.
* Help identify production and non-production application issues, assist in developing solutions, and implement necessary changes.

  

**To be successful in this role, you will have:**

* A bachelor’s degree in an applicable STEM curriculum (e.g., Data Analysis, System Engineering, Math, Computer Science, Physics, etc.) or similar.
* 8 years of engineering experience performing test, integration, SW development, or embedded systems engineering activities.
* Experience with military simulation integration test DIS IEEE1278.1 or HLA IEEE 1516 protocols, or similar communications or data protocols (SIP, VOIP, JREAP, etc).

* The ability to obtain a TS/SCI and SAP/SAR.

* Experience supporting DoD customers and personnel in a technical capacity.
* Familiarity or experience with development, test and evaluation of military simulation training or operational systems.
* Must possess, or obtain within six months, a DoD 8140 IAT Level II or higher (i.e. Security+, CySA+, CISSP)
* Up to 10% travel

  

**This position is contingent upon your ability to obtain/maintain/transfer your Secret clearance.**

**Additional desired experience and skills:**

* An active DoD Secret Clearance with ability to obtain TS/SCI and SAP/SAR.
* Familiarity with tactical Military training systems, products, and capabilities.
* Exposure to or experience in M&S development, test, and integration for constructive simulation systems and models.
* Knowledge of or experience with the Joint Simulation Environment (JSE).
* Possess or obtain within six months, a Linux OS certification (i.e., Linux+, RHCSA etc.).
  

  

### **Company Overview**

  
  

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our clients deliver vital services more efficiently while increasing the satisfaction of their end customers. Serco serves every branch of the U.S. military, numerous U.S. Federal civilian agencies, the Intelligence Community, the Canadian government, state, provincial and local governments, and commercial clients. While your place may look a little different depending on your role, we know you will find yours here. Wherever you work and whatever you do, we invite you to discover your place in our world. Serco is a place you can count on and where you can make an impact because every contribution matters.
  
  
To review Serco benefits please visit: https://careers.serco-na.com/us/en/what-we-offer. If you require an accommodation with the application process please email: careers@serco-na.com or call the HR Service Desk at 800-628-6458, option 1. Please note, due to EEOC/OFCCP compliance, Serco is unable to accept resumes by email.
  
  
Candidates may be asked to present proof of identity during the selection process. If requested, this will require presentation of a government-issued I.D. (with photo) with name and address that match the information entered on the application. Serco will not take possession of or retain/store the information provided as proof of identity.
