Chromalloy is a global engineering & solutions company. We are a leading provider of aftermarket parts, repairs, and solutions that safely & reliably extend the life of aircraft engines and gas turbines. We develop, manufacture and repair critical turbine components for a range of engine platforms. Our solutions support the engines running the aerospace, energy and defense industries around the world.
  
**Video:** What We Do
  
Why work at Chromalloy?
  
Chromalloy employees are proud, passionate problem-solvers who strive to live our values every day. A career with Chromalloy is an opportunity to learn from top industry experts, work with important technologies, and unlock a passion for innovation. Join our team of experts, innovators and problem-solvers delivering world-class solutions for our customers. As a global company, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees feel represented, heard, and able to bring their best selves to work every day. Be part of something bigger with Chromalloy!
  
Our Total Rewards Program is designed to support you today and in the future.
  

* Comprehensive and flexible benefit options starting on day one, including medical, dental, vision, EAP, wellness incentives, and 401(k) with employer matching.
* Development & progression opportunities for every employee – regular performance conversations, training and development curriculum, and engineering fellowship programs.
* Paid time off, including vacation, sick time, paid holidays, and parental leave—all eligible on your first day of employment!
* Competitive pay, including eligibility for quarterly and annual bonuses, depending on role and site.

Eligibility for individual benefit plans may vary based on employment status.
  
  
Job Summary
  
We’re looking for a Mechanical Design Automation Engineer to help design, deploy, and continuously improve robotic automation solutions across Chromalloy’s global manufacturing network. You’ll create practical, production-ready systems that strengthen safety, quality, productivity, and process consistency in critical aerospace manufacturing and repair operations.
  
  
Work That Matter
  
  
At Chromalloy, your work directly supports aviation safety and reliability. Our teams repair and manufacture critical aerospace components used across the global aviation industry. Whether you're improving processes, supporting operations, solving technical challenges, or driving business performance, your contributions help keep aircraft flying safely around the world.
  
  
**Location:** Oldsmar, FL
  
  
**Travel:** Up to 25% as needed
  
  
**Schedule:** On-site
  
  
What You’ll Be Doing
  
  
Support the mechanical design and development of robotic automation cells for aerospace manufacturing and repair operations.
  
  
Develop work cell layouts, robotic end-of-arm tooling (EOAT), fixtures, part presentation systems, safety guarding, and process-specific tooling.
  
  
Perform concept development, feasibility studies, design reviews, and risk assessments for new automation opportunities.
  
  
Create detailed 3D models, mechanical drawings, assemblies, and technical documentation using CAD software.
  
  
Design flexible, reusable tooling and automation concepts that can be deployed across multiple facilities.
  
  
Partner with manufacturing and production teams to automate welding, inspection, masking, blending, material handling, surface preparation, and other processes.
  
  
Troubleshoot mechanical and process-related issues during equipment integration, implementation, and startup.
  
  
Support ergonomic evaluations, machine safety reviews, system validation, and process qualification activities.
  
  
Contribute to automation design standards, best practices, and reusable system architectures.
  
  
What We’re Looking For
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  
  
Experience designing robotic work cells from concept through production deployment.
  
  
Advanced proficiency in 3D CAD software; Siemens NX is preferred.
  
  
Strong knowledge of automation, control systems, robotics principles, and robotic work cell design.
  
  
Experience designing robotic tooling and EOAT, automation fixtures, part handling systems, safety guarding, or automated manufacturing equipment.
  
  
Understanding of GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis, and Design for Manufacturing (DFM).
  
  
Familiarity with industrial robotics platforms, machine vision, laser systems, sensors, and industrial automation equipment.
  
  
Knowledge of machine safety standards and risk assessment methodologies.
  
  
Experience working directly with manufacturing operations and production teams.
  
  
Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently across multiple sites and shifting priorities.
  
  
Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% to support automation builds and deployments.
  
  
Nice to Have
  
  
Experience with aerospace manufacturing or repair operations.
  
  
Knowledge of FANUC or ABB robotic platforms.
  
  
Experience automating welding, coating, inspection, machining, or material finishing processes.
  
  
Experience with additive manufacturing design principles.
  
  
Exposure to PLCs, HMI systems, industrial networking, and controls integration.
  
  
Experience with simulation software, offline robotic programming, or digital twin development.
  
  
Experience using AI tools to accelerate work.
  
  
Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma exposure.
  
  
Physical Requirements
  
  
Work in a production floor environment with ventilation, climate control, moderate lighting, and moderate noise.

**Position Summary**

Since the doors opened in 1972, our Atlanta factory has grown dramatically into a state-of-the-art facility. With safety at the forefront of our minds, our Atlanta factory proudly and passionately produces 460,000 tons a year of our dry pet food brands, including Alpo®, Beneful®, Cat Chow®, Dog Chow®, Friskies®, Purina ONE®, and Pro Plan®. Our factory also does its part for the environment by conserving water, investing in renewable electricity, maintaining zero waste for disposal and more. This plant location is situated along the southern crescent of Metro Atlanta—an area that nearly 6 million residents and many of our associates call home. Atlanta is considered the major commercial and financial center of the Southeast, and together, we contribute to the growth of businesses and population, building the city's strong logistics, entertainment and film, and health services industries.

As a Controls Engineer, you’ll provide controls engineering leadership and support to the production, engineering, and maintenance teams. In this role, you’ll work directly with the Plant Controls Group, specifically with PLC programming, project execution, HMI/SCADA, and instrument calibrations to drive continuous improvement on automated processes and equipment. Prepare to design and approve electrical installations per codes and standards, ensuring the reliability and performance of site power distribution systems through technical oversight.

* Maintain current and complete electrical and controls as-built documentation
* Assist in maintenance staff training and development

OR

* Associate’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 5+ years’ of experience with electrical troubleshooting, PLC logic system design, technical data interpretation, and hardware application specification in an industrial manufacturing environment.

new_jobs.description:

Engineering

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Hear about the Caterpillar Experience for yourself**

Caterpillar is seeking a highly motivated **Control System Engineering Specialist** to join the **Drivetrain Controls System Simulation and Validation (DCSSV)** organization to support machines with powershift transmissions. This role is focused on **New Product Introduction (NPI) drivetrain controls development and product delivery**, **validation planning and execution**, and **technology transformation project execution** that enables robust, scalable drivetrain control solutions for current and future machine platforms using powershift transmissions and torque converters.

The successful candidate will own the software design for powershift transmission controls with responsibility for technical leadership across software, controls, and development activities, partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver drivetrain controls solutions from concept through production readiness. new_jobs.title: RF Hardware Engineer - Radar
new_jobs.description:
Description:

**ABOUT PROTORA**

**Protora** (formerly *C Speed*) builds radar and surveillance systems that give military and government customers eyes on their airspace, borders, and critical sites. Our name draws from the *Praetorian Guard*, elite soldiers whose job was to **watch and protect**. That history shapes our mission today: we take first watch, so the people we protect don't have to. We are a growing company with a new brand and a clear direction. **This role is an important part of designing, developing, and testing the radar technology behind our mission**.

**THE ROLE**

**Protora** is seeking a mid-level **RF Hardware Engineer** to design, build and test the RF hardware at the heart of our radar systems, including receivers, exciters and transmitters. In this role, you will own discrete technical work packages end to end—from block diagram and component selection through simulation, bring-up, integration and field test—with guidance from senior staff on program-level architecture. You will work alongside antenna, signal processing, software, and systems engineering teams to turn performance requirements into demonstrated capability.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Design, build and test radar receiver, exciter and transmitter subsystems, from block diagram and component selection through schematic capture, board and subsystem bring-up and verification.
* Perform RF cascade analysis (gain, noise figure, linearity, dynamic range and phase noise) and allocate system-level requirements to hardware specifications.
* Simulate RF circuits and assemblies using RF toolsets and validate models against measured performance.
* Work with antenna, signal processing and systems engineers on interfaces, calibration approaches and system-level performance trades.
* Lead hardware bring-up, debug and troubleshooting; plan and execute laboratory, chamber, and field test and analyze measured data against predicted performance.
* Support environmental and EMI/EMC qualification (e.g., MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461) and transition designs to production, including acceptance test procedures.
* Author technical documentation, including hardware specifications, design documentation, trade studies, test plans and procedures, and test reports.
* Present analysis and test results at internal design reviews and customer technical exchanges.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* **B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Physics**, or a related technical field.
* **4–7 years of professional experience** designing, building and testing RF/microwave hardware, preferably for radar or other sensor systems.
* Solid grasp of RF and microwave fundamentals, including S-parameters, impedance matching, noise figure, linearity (P1dB, IP3), and phase noise, along with working knowledge of radar theory such as radar range equation.
* Demonstrated ability to apply RF and radar theory to hardware design, integration, and troubleshooting.
* Demonstrated ability to work **collaboratively in a lean, cross-functional engineering environment** with a positive, solutions-oriented approach.
* Disciplined **engineering mindset** with an understanding of engineering processes, including requirements, design, documentation, integration, test, and validation.
* Proficiency in **MATLAB** or **Python** for analysis, test automation, and data reduction.
* Experience with RF design and simulation tools and schematic capture and layout tools (OrCAD).
* Hands-on experience with hardware bring-up, integration, and test, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, vector network analyzers, oscilloscopes, power meters, and noise figure and phase noise measurement equipment.
* Demonstrated ability to document and present technical work to engineering and customer audiences.
* U.S. person status and the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. DoD Secret clearance.
* Ability to work across office, laboratory, anechoic chamber, and outdoor test range environments, including occasional testing outside standard business hours to meet range scheduling constraints.
* Ability to lift and move test equipment and hardware and work outdoors in varying weather conditions during field testing.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, RF/Microwave Engineering, electromagnetics, or related discipline.
* Active DoD Secret or Top-Secret clearance.
* Experience with active electronically scanned arrays (**AESA**), T/R modules, or phased array calibration.
* Experience designing amplifiers, low-noise receivers, frequency synthesizers or LO distribution networks.
* Experience with air surveillance, counter-UAS, or weapon-locating radar.
* Embedded or **FPGA/DSP** implementation experience (**VHDL, Verilog, or C/C++** on real-time targets).
* Prior work under **MIL-STD-461/464, MIL-STD-810**, or comparable qualification standards.
* Experience with RF PCB layout and taking RF hardware from prototype into production including design for manufacturability.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

* **Compensation Range**: $120,000 - $130,000 commensurate with experience.
* **Benefits**: Health, Dental & Vision Insurance | Paid Time Off (**PTO**) | Retirement Plan Package.

**WHY JOIN PROTORA**

* **Direct impact**. Your engineering work directly contributes to radar systems designed to support critical missions.
* **Hands-on engineering**. You will design hardware, bring it up on the bench, see it perform in the lab and out in the field.
* **Work that supports people who protect others**. The systems you build help the people on watch see threats coming.

**READY TO JOIN THE MISSION?**

**Protora** is always looking for talented professionals who want to do meaningful work with a team that treats every challenge like a mission.

For more information about **Protora**, please visit our website: http://protoratech.com

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Integrations
new_jobs.description:
We're Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.

We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.

We’re looking for a **Senior Software Engineer, Fulfillment,** at an exciting time — we’ve successfully launched multiple platforms and products, raised over $100m in VC funding, reached profitability, and have a growth trajectory of over 100% YoY.

  

Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL BE GETTING INVOLVED IN**
----------------------------------------

Scan.com's integration layer is mission-critical infrastructure. We interface with hundreds of imaging centers and health systems operating disparate, often decades-old systems — RIS platforms built on legacy protocols, HL7 v2 feeds with idiosyncratic vendor dialects, and hardware gateways running in constrained clinical environments. On the demand side, we connect to modern EHR APIs, third-party referral networks, and portal integrations that must work reliably at scale.

As a **Senior Software Engineer, Integrations**, you will architect and build the systems that make these connections robust, observable, and extensible. This problem area requires genuine passion for legacy system integration patterns, message transformation pipelines, and the operational discipline to maintain high-reliability infrastructure against the entropy of the real world.

As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:

* Build and maintain REST API integrations with third-party referral sources, attorney platforms, and demand aggregators, including OAuth flows, rate limiting, retry logic, and schema versioning. Design and implement HL7 v2 transformation pipelines — parsing, normalizing, enriching, and routing ADT, ORM, ORU, SIU, and MDM message types across heterogeneous RIS and EHR systems with non-standard vendor extensions.
* Build and maintain integration connectors for modern and legacy imaging center RIS systems.
* Architect fault-tolerant message queuing and delivery infrastructure for inbound and outbound HL7 and API traffic.
* Develop interfaces for demand-side EHR integrations, including mapping from internal data models to FHIR-compliant (and other standards) representations.
* Own the observability layer for the integration infrastructure: structured logging, alerting on message processing latency/failures, and dashboards that surface issues before they reach the operations teams.
* Contribute to the design of integration onboarding tooling that reduces time-to-live for new imaging center and referral source connections
* Provide technical mentorship to mid-level engineers and participate in architecture reviews across the broader Engineering org

**WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE**
-------------------------------------

You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

* Strong command of message transformation architecture: you can design pipelines that are observable, replayable, and extensible without requiring a full rewrite every time a new vendor is onboarded
* Proficiency in at least one backend language used in high-reliability integration contexts (Python, Ruby, Java, C# are all relevant; language is less important than architectural rigor).
* Familiarity with RESTful API integration patterns, including schema versioning, backward compatibility, and API contract management
* Strong operational instincts: you instrument what you build, you think about failure modes before they happen, and you treat on-call escalations as a signal about systemic gaps
* Experience in healthcare is a plus, but not required. We care far more about your integration engineering depth and legacy system fluency than your industry background

**A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE**
-------------------------

We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here.

  

**HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU**
-----------------------------

We keep our interview process short and sweet, and we're a nimble team that can progress at pace. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order depending on team availability:

* Introductory video call with our Senior Talent Partner, approximately 30 minutes.
* Video call and coding exercise with a software engineer on the team, approximately 60 minutes. This will be a live assessment of your technical skill.
* Assessment stage. This will be cross functional in nature, and will assess your systems design skills along with your ability to evolve a feature with your future teammates.
* Final round with our Chief Technology Officer and Chief Product Officer. This round will assess alignment with our company values.
* Offer!

**WHAT WE OFFER**
-----------------

We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. Here’s what you can
  
expect from us:

* Salary range of **$180,000 - $200,000**
* Equity
* Flexible hybrid work options
* Dedicated personal dev

new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our Edge team building the software platform behind these products. You will design, build, and operate the distributed edge-to-cloud pipeline that runs on IoT devices on the production floor, ingesting high-rate sensor and controller data and reliably forwarding it to the cloud over intermittent connectivity.

This is a hands-on backend-focused role spanning containerized .NET services, relational and document data stores, pub/sub messaging, and industrial protocol integration. You will own features end-to-end and collaborate closely with Controls, HMI, Manufacturing, and Field Support to ship reliable, production-grade systems to our customers.

**Key Job Responsibilities**

* Design and implement backend services in C# on modern .NET / ASP.NET Core for the edge platform - REST APIs, background workers, message handlers, telemetry aggregators, and long-running device services.
* Own the data pipeline from device ingest to cloud archive: schema design, repository / data-access layer, database migrations, partitioning and retention strategy, and durable store-and-forward upload to cloud object storage.
* Build and maintain containerized services and their deployment manifests, configuration, and orchestration.
* Integrate with industrial controllers over standard fieldbus and industrial communication protocols - designing message contracts, register maps, warning/error codes, and controls-side handshakes for coordinated operation.
* Deliver features end-to-end, from work-item breakdown through implementation, unit and integration tests, CI, code review, deployment, and field validation on live equipment.
* Contribute to architecture: write and review architecture docs, evaluate new patterns, and drive refactors that keep the codebase maintainable as the team and product line grow.
* Mentor and collaborate: raise the bar in code review, pair with junior engineers, and coordinate with Controls, HMI, DevOps, and Field Support to ship releases. Mentor junior software developers and provide guidance on best practices and advanced analytical techniques.
* Communicate complex data insights and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders effectively.

**Key Competencies & Skills**

**Required**

* Strong professional experience with C# and modern .NET building ASP.NET Core REST APIs, hosted / background services, and worker services.
* Solid database engineering skills: relational schema design, indexing, migrations, and query tuning. Comfort writing and reviewing raw SQL is expected.
* Practical experience with containerization
* Comfort with Linux as a deployment target (systemd services, log management, networking, device troubleshooting) and shell scripting.
* Proficiency with Git, pull-request workflows, and CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, or similar), including running unit and integration tests in the pipeline.
* Strong grounding in software engineering fundamentals: automated testing, code review, refactoring, API design, and writing clear technical documentation.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, data analysis, and test automation (pytest); ability to move fluently between C# and Python codebases.
* Experience integrating with industrial control systems via standard fieldbus or SCADA protocols (e.g., EtherCAT, MODBUS, OPC UA, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP), or otherwise interoperating with PLCs.
* Azure cloud services: Blob Storage, IoT Hub, Container Registry, Managed Identity, and Azure DevOps. Equivalent experience on AWS or GCP is also welcome.
* Experience with Kubernetes for orchestrating containerized workloads, including deployments, services, and Helm charts; lightweight distributions such as K3s or MicroK8s at the edge are a plus.
* Experience building IoT device software - long-lived services on embedded / ARM64 hardware, remote deployment, module or fleet management, and safe over-the-air updates.
* Familiarity with columnar / analytics formats such as Parquet and downstream analytics engines (Fabric, Synapse, Databricks, DuckDB).
* Familiarity with visualization / dashboard tools (Grafana or similar) and time-series data modeling.

**Education and Experience Requirements**

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience shipping production systems.
* Demonstrated experience delivering distributed backend systems in production, ideally at the edge or in an IoT / industrial context, with responsibility for reliability, observability, and on-call or field-support obligations.
* Track record of cross-functional collaboration with hardware, controls, or research teams, and of translating ambiguous product requirements into well-scoped, testable engineering work.

**Working Conditions**

Work is performed inside a flex space building consisting of offices, open desk space, laboratory, machine shop, and a manufacturing floor. Level of noise is usually quiet in the office environment and temperature controlled. Noise levels are elevated in the warehouse space where temperatures can vary depending on the outside elements and weather. Travel may be required, including up to 2-8 trips per year to visit suppliers, attend conferences, meetings (customer, investor, and business) and customer sites (hatcheries).

### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

If you want to work on cutting-edge DoD programs, Serco has a great opportunity for you! As a SME Software Engineer, you will be supporting the Special Programs Division (AFLCMC/WAG) at Wright Patterson AFB, OH.

**This position is contingent upon the ability to maintain/transfer active Department of War (DoW) Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI.**

The Fighters and Advanced Aircraft Directorate, Special Programs Division develops, tests, and rapidly fields classified USAF aeronautical capabilities. AFLCMC/WAG conducts studies to identify new capabilities; transitions laboratory technologies to operational platforms; executes demonstrations; and develops, tests, rapidly fields, sustains, and demilitarizes capabilities for the warfighter.

In this role, you will:

* Oversee software engineering architecture of prime DoD contractors that are implementing Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) for a software pipeline in the acquisition, development, and sustainment of prototypes, aircraft, subsystems, and/or support equipment

* Using DevSecOps, evaluate prime contractor proposed software design changes and solutions for aircraft/test equipment, perform systems analyses and technological/trade-off study assessments

* Assess the interfaces and interaction of a computer system’s software, firmware, and hardware

* Actively participate in software-centric technical reviews and transitioning efforts from traditional methodologies to CI/CD

* Using MBSE, translate operational user requirements into contract system requirements documents to improve traceability
* Analyze software performance deficiencies; make recommendations for corrective action

* Audit DoD contractors for software configuration and control measures and verify appropriate quality accreditation

* Review the system design software architecture and interoperability requirements

* Evaluate system software test plans and participate in the conduct of system, subsystem, and component testing; review and analyze test data; make recommendations

* Support development and review of program and contract technical documentation
* Provide technical and programmatic feedback, develop and present technical briefings, and develop engineering strategies/analyses
* Conduct technical evaluations of contractor proposals
* Interface with weapons system contractors, vendors, and Government representatives on software engineering activities; independently apply software and engineering principles to investigate, analyze, plan, oversee, and evaluate weapons system development and sustainment
* Assess AFRL technology initiatives to guide investments and shape transition strategies
* Assess contractor product capabilities in achieving system design requirements and specifications
* Perform technical risk assessments and develop mitigation plans
* Develop request for proposal (RFP) technical documents and conduct technical evaluations of contractor proposals to include software design feasibility and system compatibility

  

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* An active TOP-SECRET security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and access to Special Access Programs (SAP) and have a background investigation current within the past 5 years or under Continuous Vetting
* Masters Degree in an Engineering discipline with a minimum of 20 years relevant experience with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Minimum 3 years of SAP or SCI experience within the last 5 years
* Ability to travel up to 10% (CONUS)

  

Additional desired experience and skills:

* Bachelor’s or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering
* In-depth knowledge of DoD acquisition software engineering support to include software architecture, design, integration, configuration, test/evaluation, and certification
* Current knowledge of software development methodology and tools to include Agile and CI/CD
* Experienced with real-time operating systems, software languages, computer hardware platforms
* Experience in integrating DevSecOps, MBSE, and DoD cybersecurity considerations into software architectures
* In-depth knowledge of DoD acquisition engineering and test support

If you are interested in supporting and working with our Air Force and airmen and a dedicated Serco team, then submit your application now for immediate consideration. It only takes a few minutes!

  
  

### **Company Overview**

  
  

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our clients deliver vital services more efficiently while increasing the satisfaction of their end customers. Serco serves every branch of the U.S. military, numerous U.S. Federal civilian agencies, the Intelligence Community, the Canadian government, state, provincial and local governments, and commercial clients. new_jobs.description:
Description:

Enovation Controls is a turnkey technology company that solves complex problems and delivers innovative solutions. People who find their place here tend to stay. Many of our team members have decades of tenure, evidence of a culture where people feel valued and want to build a career. We’re proud to be recognized by Great Place to Work as one of the **Best Workplaces in Manufacturing & Production for seven consecutive years** and recognized for **Top U.S. Benefits by Mployer Advisor.** This recognition comes directly from employee feedback, not marketing, and reflects a workplace where people feel trusted, supported, and empowered. We live our core values every day in a collaborative, high-performance environment that balances complex technical work with real camaraderie, accessible leadership, and traditions that bring teams together.

**Description**

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Software Engineer who brings deep Bluetooth protocol expertise, takes ownership of complex technical problems, and partners across software, architecture, product, and project teams to deliver robust solutions. This is a software-centric role focused on implementing and extending Bluetooth features across Classic (BR/EDR) and Low Energy (BLE) profiles on embedded Linux, while maintaining support for a legacy QNX 6.6 platform.

Our primary Bluetooth stack is BlueZ on Linux, with an application layer built in C# on .NET. You’ll work across C#, C, and C++ and lead new Bluetooth development on Linux while supporting our legacy QNX 6.6 platform using Searan’s HCI stack on the QNX 6.6 armv7-le platform. The role requires the ability to work at the protocol and stack level, troubleshoot complex issues, and, when needed, read and modify the underlying Bluetooth stack.

**What you’ll lead and own**

**Bluetooth Features & Platform Support**

* Design, implement, and maintain Bluetooth profile features across Classic (BR/EDR) and BLE on embedded Linux using BlueZ and GCC ARM.
* Maintain feature parity and support across the legacy QNX 6.6 armv7-le platform using Searan’s HCI stack.
* Troubleshoot and resolve Bluetooth issues at the protocol and stack level, not just at the application layer.

**Software Architecture & Development**

* Design and implement robust, maintainable software components using C# on .NET and C/C++ for lower-level stack integration and legacy platform support.
* Contribute to the design of system modules and partner with Software Architects to develop scalable solutions for the Enovation Control Platform Software.
* Apply and promote Software and Enovation Best Practices to strengthen code quality, maintainability, and development efficiency.

**Roadmap, Delivery & Collaboration**

* Partner with the Bluetooth Team Lead to develop and maintain the Bluetooth feature roadmap across a monthly release cadence using Azure DevOps SCRUM.
* Accurately estimate work, provide technical insight, and collaborate with Project and Product Management to align development efforts with business objectives.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to translate customer needs and technical requirements into reliable software solutions.

**Engineering Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify and advocate for software, development, and tooling improvements that support customer use cases and strategic goals.
* Expand static analysis coverage on the Linux platform to improve code quality and reduce technical risk.
* Mentor Software Engineers through knowledge-sharing, technical guidance, and practical application of engineering best practices.
* Stay current with Bluetooth technologies, software development practices, and industry trends to bring new ideas and capabilities to the team.

Requirements:

**What we’re looking for**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 5+ years of professional software development experience.
* Hands-on experience with an embedded or RTOS-based Bluetooth protocol stack at the HCI, L2CAP, RFCOMM, or profile-implementation level (e.g., BlueZ on Linux, SEARAN dotstack, BlueKitchen BTstack, Zephyr Bluetooth, or equivalent).
* Strong working knowledge of Bluetooth Classic (BR/EDR) profiles, including A2DP, AVRCP, HFP, PBAP, MAP, and SPP, as well as Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE).
* Strong proficiency in C# on .NET as the primary application language, along with C/C++ for stack integration and legacy platform support.
* Experience with embedded Linux development, including Yocto or equivalent, and cross-compilation toolchains such as GCC ARM.
* Experience with Agile/SCRUM development methodologies.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills at the protocol and stack level.

**Preferred**

* Experience working with multiple Bluetooth stacks and applying a cross-platform perspective to resolve stack-level limitations.
* Depth in BlueZ sufficient to read, trace, and modify stack source code directly.
* Familiarity with QNX RTOS, particularly QNX 6.6 on armv7-le.
* Experience with BLE Audio (LE Audio / LC3).
* Experience with D-Bus and Linux inter-process communication patterns relevant to BlueZ integration.
* Familiarity with Yocto Project / OpenEmbedded build systems.
* Experience expanding static analysis coverage on Linux C/C++ codebases using tools such as cppcheck, clang-tidy, or equivalent.
* Background with mobile platforms (iOS/Android) for Bluetooth testing and protocol-level diagnostics.

**Why Enovation Controls**

We tackle complex work with high expectations and a learning mindset. Our culture is fun and rewarding, and we consistently rank among the best places to work in manufacturing. We back that culture with solid benefits: a strong 401(k) match, cost-effective healthcare options that meaningfully reduce out-of-pocket costs, wellness support, and profit-sharing that rewards collective success.

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. All employment decisions a

At PLEXSYS, we’re all about creating Live, Virtual, and Constructive (LVC) training solutions for our customers worldwide. With over 200 employees spread across fifteen states and four countries, we’re dedicated to enhancing training experiences every day, everywhere.

**Why PLEXSYS?**

At PLEXSYS, you’ll be part of a dynamic and supportive culture that encourages you to reach your professional goals, put forth your best effort, and collaborate with other enthusiastic and driven individuals. Our core values – integrity, excellence, teamwork, and agility – are at the heart of everything we do, guiding our decisions and shaping our vibrant organizational culture.

PLEXSYS is an amazing place to work, but you don’t have to take our word for it. We invite you to check out what our team members are saying about working at PLEXSYS on Glassdoor. Discover why PLEXSYS could be the perfect place for the next step in your career.

**GENERAL DESCRIPTION**  
PLEXSYS is seeking a qualified candidate to support the E-3G Gen 2 Block 40/45 AWACS (Airborne Warning and Control System) Mission Crew Training Set (MCTS) program.  
The E-3G Gen 2 AWACS MCTS provides a fully functional aircrew mission crew simulator that accurately models the software functionality of the USAF E-3G Sentry aircraft. The MCTS is a non-articulated simulator that is designed to provide training for Air Battle Managers and their respective crew positions through nine different system locations worldwide. The MCTS is a device that provides capabilities to train up to 15 crew members at Operator Workstations (OWS); also known as crew consoles and 8 Instructor Operator Stations (IOS) for Instructor Cadre. The trainer uses aircraft software developed by Boeing and supported by the 558th Software Engineering Squadron (SWES) that includes PLEXSYS’ and other COTS training software to facilitate three simultaneous instances function as an independent AWACS.

Jam Works Automation is hiring a Robotics Engineer II to design, program, integrate, and commission robotic systems for custom automated manufacturing equipment.

This exempt role reports to the Senior Controls Engineer. You’ll own the robotics portion of assigned projects, working independently from simulation and programming through testing and customer-site start-up.

**Why Join Jam Works Automation?**

* Take ownership of robotics work on custom automation projects.
* Combine engineering design with hands-on integration and troubleshooting.
* Build deeper robotics expertise and mentor less-experienced engineers.

**What You’ll Do**

* Develop, debug, and maintain robot programs and simulations using FANUC RoboGuide or similar tools.
* Integrate robots with tooling, sensors, vision systems, safety devices, PLCs, HMIs, and industrial networks.
* Troubleshoot robotics, electrical, controls, and communication issues; support PLC/HMI programming within your capabilities.
* Lead assigned robotics activities during factory and site acceptance testing, installation, and commissioning.
* Coordinate with engineering, project management, manufacturing, and customers to complete assigned project work.
* Maintain programs, backups, and project documentation; provide technical input for proposals and estimates.
* Mentor less-experienced team members and travel to customer sites for commissioning, training, and technical support.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electrical, Automation, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant education and experience may be considered.
* Typically 3–5 years of relevant experience in robotics, industrial automation, controls, or machine integration.
* Proficiency in industrial robot programming, integration, troubleshooting, simulation, and offline programming; FANUC experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of robotic tooling, sensors, vision systems, and safety devices.
* Working knowledge of PLC/HMI programming, electrical controls, and robot-to-PLC integration; Rockwell/Allen-Bradley or AutomationDirect experience preferred.
* Ability to interpret electrical schematics and mechanical drawings, solve technical problems, and manage assigned work independently.
* Strong communication, teamwork, and organizational skills.

**Work Environment and Physical Requirements**

* Work in office, manufacturing, assembly, and customer-site environments around automated equipment.

* Travel as required. Schedules may vary based on project and customer needs.

Jam Works Automation LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer (M/F/D/V).

In this role, you will work at the intersection of AI silicon, server systems, and data center operations, partnering with hardware design, firmware, software, and capacity engineering teams to bring AI accelerators and GPU-based server platforms from new product introduction through full-scale deployment. Your work will directly influence the reliability, scalability, and performance of the AI infrastructure that powers Meta's machine learning and AI initiatives.  
  
  

### **Hardware Systems Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Lead hardware system validation and qualification activities for AI server platforms, GPU clusters, and AI accelerator systems entering Meta's production data center environment
* Drive new product introduction efforts for AI/HPC hardware by defining acceptance criteria, coordinating bring-up activities, and managing cross-functional readiness reviews with silicon, firmware, and software teams
* Develop and execute test plans covering thermal, power, and electrical characterization of AI server systems at component, board, and rack levels
* Investigate and root-cause complex hardware failures across the full stack, including AI silicon, firmware, system software, and thermal subsystems
* Collaborate with AI silicon vendors and original design manufacturers to resolve hardware issues, drive engineering change orders, and ensure production quality standards are met
* Define and improve hardware qualification methodologies and failure analysis processes for AI/HPC platforms to scale across large fleet deployments
* Partner with AI platform and capacity engineering teams to support hardware deployment planning, rack integration, and production ramp execution for GPU and AI accelerator systems
* Analyze fleet telemetry, failure rate data, and field return trends to identify systemic reliability risks in AI infrastructure and drive corrective actions
* Contribute to AI hardware design reviews and provide feedback on system architecture, component selection, and manufacturability to improve production outcomes
* Communicate hardware qualification status, risk assessments, and deployment readiness for AI/HPC systems to cross-functional stakeholders and engineering leadership

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 6+ years of experience in hardware engineering with a focus on AI servers, GPUs, AI accelerators, or high-performance computing systems in a data center environment
* 6+ years of experience in hardware validation, system bring-up, or new product introduction for AI/HPC platforms
* Experience debugging hardware failures across multiple domains including power delivery, thermal management, signal integrity, or high-speed interconnects such as PCIe, NVLink, or HBM in AI systems
* Experience developing test specifications, qualification procedures, and failure analysis documentation for AI/HPC hardware systems
* Experience collaborating with silicon vendors, original design manufacturers, or contract manufacturers to resolve hardware quality and reliability issues for AI infrastructure

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with scripting or automation for hardware test workflows, data collection, and failure triage in a Linux-based environment
* Familiarity with hardware telemetry frameworks, out-of-band management protocols such as IPMI or Redfish, and fleet-level diagnostics tooling for AI infrastructure
* Experience with AI/HPC hardware platforms including GPU clusters, AI accelerators, or custom AI server designs at rack or pod scale
* Knowledge of high-speed interconnect standards such as PCIe Gen 4/5, NVLink, CXL, or high-bandwidth memory in the context of AI/HPC system validation

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  
  
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.

new_jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**\*This position is contingent upon contract award\***

Amentum is seeking a skilled and driven **Senior Electrical Engineer** to join our engineering team based in Houston, TX. This is a design-focused role that spans the full product lifecycle — from early concept development through hardware design, fabrication, installation, and on-site operation.

The ideal candidate is a licensed or degree-qualified electrical or systems engineer who brings expertise in low voltage electronics, wiring systems, sensor integration, and harness design, and who communicates and collaborates effectively across engineering and operations teams.

This position offers the opportunity to lead and participate in design reviews, work alongside vendors to bring electrical hardware from schematic to reality, and provide direct technical support during field installation and testing. If you are looking for a role where your engineering decisions have real, visible consequences on mission-critical systems, this is the opportunity for you.

This team supports multiple US Navy research and development facilities associated with top priority submarine weapon system development programs. The facilities are one-of-a-kind and provide a capability not found anywhere else in the DoD. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic and fast-paced environment and is willing to tackle problems that span the hardware lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
**Electrical Design & Analysis**

* Lead electrical design efforts from concept development through detailed design, fabrication support, and on-site commissioning.
* Develop and review wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, harness drawings, and interconnect documentation using CAD/EDA tools (AutoCAD Electrical, SOLIDWORKS Electrical, Zuken, or equivalent).
* Perform electrical analysis including power budgets, voltage drop, signal integrity, and harness load calculations to validate designs meet system requirements.
* Evaluate designs for manufacturability, reliability, and compliance with applicable electrical standards and codes.
* Drive projects through the full lifecycle — from initial concept and requirements definition through fabrication, installation, testing, and operational turnover.

**Low Voltage Systems, Sensors & Harnesses**

* Apply engineering expertise in low voltage circuit design, sensor integration, signal conditioning, and wiring harness development for complex system applications.
* Develop and review harness and cable assembly drawings, connector specifications, and routing layouts that comply with applicable workmanship and design standards.
* Troubleshoot low voltage circuits, sensor faults, and harness anomalies using standard test equipment (multimeters, oscilloscopes, data acquisition systems, and signal analyzers).
* Select and specify sensors, connectors, cables, and associated hardware appropriate for the operating environment and system requirements.

**Design Review & Work Package Support**

* Lead and actively participate in formal design reviews (PDR, CDR, and peer reviews), ensuring technical rigor, safety compliance, and design completeness.
* Review work packages, installation procedures, and test plans for electrical systems to confirm accuracy, completeness, and alignment with engineering intent prior to field execution.
* Evaluate proposed design changes and engineering change orders for technical feasibility, signal integrity impact, and compliance with applicable standards.
* Collaborate with mechanical, systems, and software engineers to ensure electrical designs integrate effectively within the broader system architecture.

**Vendor Coordination & Fabrication Support**

* Work directly with vendors and harness fabricators to communicate design intent, clarify wiring and connector requirements, and ensure hardware is manufactured to specification.
* Review vendor submittals, harness drawings, and material certifications to verify conformance with design and workmanship requirements (IPC/WHMA-A-620 or equivalent).
* Support procurement activities by developing specifications, statements of work, and technical evaluation criteria for electrical hardware and fabrication services.

new_jobs.title: Applied AI/Automation Engineer

Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, which was built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career!

We are seeking an Applied AI/Automation Engineer to design, build, deploy, and support practical AI solutions that improve internal engineering workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and make technical information easier to find and use. This role will apply the latest AI techniques within scalable software solutions, helping move promising ideas from experimentation into reliable, maintainable tools that deliver measurable value. * Hands-on experience designing and building AI-enabled applications using large language model APIs, AI application frameworks, enterprise AI platforms, or similar technologies
* Experience integrating software with APIs, cloud services, enterprise data sources, data pipelines, and knowledge repositories
* Experience with AI evaluation, measurement, monitoring, observability, or feedback practices

LVT is redefining how businesses operate in the physical world, moving beyond traditional security solutions to deliver AI-driven, actionable intelligence that makes sites smarter, safer, and more secure. This is your chance to join a cutting-edge team that isn't just watching the world change, but actively building the technology that is changing it.

* **Product & Software Excellence:** We were named one of *The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies of 2023* and are a winner of the *Security Today Govies Award* for 2025.

**ABOUT THIS ROLE**
-------------------

As a Senior Staff Embedded Software Engineer, you will provide overall technical leadership for our embedded cameras ecosystem, owning the architecture, design, and hands-on implementation of features for our next-generation video streaming products. * **Tactical Execution & Mentorship:** Drive rigorous architecture and code reviews, manage complex schedule planning, and proactively mentor engineers to raise the technical floor of the organization.
* **Edge Analytics & AI Integration:** Direct the integration of on-camera analytics that turn raw video into actionable signals, including model deployment to the SoC's inference accelerator and managing the memory, latency, and accuracy trade-offs involved.

**OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE**
-----------------------

* **Senior Technical Leadership:** Proven track record as a Staff or Senior Staff Embedded Software Engineer capable of navigating high ambiguity and turning complex architectural problems into scoped, prioritized work (10+ years of total experience).
* **Embedded Systems Mastery:** Deep expertise in embedded Linux environments (BSP, device drivers, HAL, bootloaders, system bring-up) and custom Yocto distributions, complemented by a foundational understanding of low-level hardware and MCU/RTOS.
* **Advanced Programming:** Expert-level proficiency in embedded C and C++. Experience with Go is a plus.
* **Advanced Debugging:** Demonstrated ability to debug complex hardware/software interactions using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, and JTAG debuggers.
* **Video Domain Depth:** Comprehensive experience designing systems involving video, audio, image processing, and streaming technologies (H.264/H.265).
* **JDM & Partner Leadership:** Demonstrated success driving technical outcomes within a JDM framework, evaluating vendor capabilities, and holding third-party partners to high engineering standards.
* **Analytics Integration:** Experience architecting edge-based camera analytics and deploying resource-efficient computer vision or Edge AI models.
* **Engineering Multiplier:** Recognized as a technical authority whose judgment generalizes across teams; a leader who actively shapes engineering culture, drives schedule planning, and raises the talent floor.
* **AI Tooling Efficiency:** Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools to enhance design, coding, and automated testing across the software development lifecycle.

We believe you do your best work when your whole life is supported. new_jobs.title: Founding Embedded Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Orbital Robotics is looking for engineers who have deployed embedded software for safety critical systems at scale. While we are deploying spacecraft with robotic arms to space, any engineer experienced with robotic systems, autonomous vehicles, or avionics will be a great fit.

**Responsibilities**

* Architect, implement, test, and deploy real-time embedded C/C++ software from bare-metal bring-up to production hardware.
* Develop device drivers and high-speed communication protocols to tightly integrate actuators, motor controllers, and complex sensor payloads.
* Optimize low-level firmware and RTOS to guarantee the strict timing and latencies required for high-bandwidth robotic control, dynamic movement, and manipulation.
* Design fault-tolerant software architectures and safety systems that gracefully handle hardware degradation, thermal limits, and unexpected physical disturbances.
* Integrate and debug embedded systems directly on full-scale robots and hardware-in-the-loop test frameworks.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Due to ITAR regulations, must be a U.S. person (citizen, permanent resident, or designated asylee/refugee).
* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer science, physics, robotics, or related engineering discipline.
* Software development experience in C, C++ and Linux.
* 3+ years of full-time, working experience in embedded systems.

**Desired Experience**
======================

**Firmware & Embedded Systems**

* **Bare-Metal & RTOS:** Experience implementing low-level software on bare-metal systems and RTOS.
* **Motor Control:** Experience with brushless motor controllers and FOC algorithm implementation.

**Safety-Critical & Real-Time Systems**

* **Safety-Critical Software:** Experience deploying for safety critical systems including aircraft avionics or autonomous vehicles.
* **Real-Time Processors:** Experience targeting high-reliability, real-time processors used in automotive powertrain, aerospace avionics, or robotic actuation.

**ITAR Requirements**
---------------------

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Compensation Range: $120K - $220K

new_jobs.description:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

As part of a hardworking team of spacecraft development engineers, you will contribute to the hardware engineering activities for the Guidance Navigation and Control (GN&C) subsystem and its components. Your responsibilities will include the development of navigation hardware requirements, executing trade studies on performance, reliability, and configuration while supporting the integration, test installation alignment and verification compliance throughout the entire program lifecycle. You will collaborate with the vehicle systems engineering, mechanical design, mission operations, AI&T, and dynamics teams to ensure design coordination to meet the vehicle performance deliverables. You will need to be able to communicate technical information clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

  

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Contribute to the development of navigation hardware requirements from system level specifications with flow downs to subsystem and component levels, and companion verification methods
* Support the design of the navigation hardware configuration with design studies, and execute performance trades
* Contribute to the procurement, vendor coordination, delivery, acceptance, installation, verification, validation, qualification, and certification of the navigation hardware
* Guide and perform testing and analyses such as flight tests, thermal vacuum tests, vibration tests, etc. to validate top-level system specifications and requirements, and to establish performance specifications of the sensors
* Support the test and verification campaign of the navigation hardware
* Support the development and execution of component-level navigation test programs, including sensor characterization, sensor modeling, and integrated on-vehicle testing
Support hardware-in-the-loop testing, on-vehicle functional testing, and flight testing  

**Qualifications:**
